en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163711_18_1: Who is the Brume King of Brume Realm?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163712_1: Brume King lies dormant on Temple Island, who has brought both prosperity and decline to the kingdom. He is the spiritual pillar of the islanders, but has caused them much suffering.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163712_2: Simply put, Brume King can determine the rise and fall of Brume Realm?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163712_2_1: Who is the princess of the kingdom?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_1: The princess` name is Selna, who is of great fame.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_2: Selna? That thief the Blank Island is hunting for?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_3: Selna is responsible and knowledgeable. Do not speak ill of her. That`s all I know. Dello can tell you more.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_4: But Dello seems hostile to us. Please come with us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_6: Why haven`t you left yet? Old Cole? Why are you with them?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_7: The chosen hero and the priest. They helped me once.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_8: Chosen hero? Priest? Aren`t they adventurers?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_9: Well, we were participating in the Anniversary Revelry on Blank Island...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_10: You were sent by Blank Island? As a guard of the princess, I warn you to leave this area immediately! Otherwise...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_11: Hey, easy! They mean no harm.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163713_12: They could be evil knights sent by Blank Island to kill the princess!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_1: We came from Blank Island, but it doesn`t mean we belong to Blank Island. In fact, we knew nothing about this place before coming here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_2: With the purpose of exploration, we helped Old Cole get to Lighthouse Island. We return here just because we are curious about Selna.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_4: Yes. What are you going to do next?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_5: Continue our exploration. But before that, could you tell us more about Selna?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_6: Selna is the princess of Brume Realm. She is humble and kind. I am here by her order to evacuate the residents of Lighthouse Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_7: I heard a thief named Selna appeared on Blank Island not long ago. That... doesn`t refer to the princess, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_8: Does it count as stealing if the princess retrieves her rightful treasure?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_10: It is said that the treasure is related to the revival of Brume King. But I do not know what it is exactly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163714_12: Perhaps she has returned to Temple Island. There is a connection between the princess and Brume King, so she should not be lost in the mist.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_1: I am Heloise, a priest from Positive Facet, and this is the chosen hero from Primeval Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_2: We came here just for exploration, with no ill intentions.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_4: Yes. What are you going to do next?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_5: Continue our exploration. But before that, could you tell us more about Selna?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_6: Selna is the princess of Brume Realm. She is humble and kind. I am here by her order to evacuate the residents of Lighthouse Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_7: I heard a thief named Selna appeared on Blank Island not long ago. That... doesn`t refer to the princess, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_8: Does it count as stealing if the princess retrieves her rightful treasure?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_10: It is said that the treasure is related to the revival of Brume King. But I do not know what it is exactly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163715_12: Perhaps she has returned to Temple Island. There is a connection between the princess and Brume King, so she should not be lost in the mist.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163716_1: Now that Lighthouse Island has been restored, do you have any recommended places for exploration, Old Cole?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163716_2: Dello is from Ancestor Island. It would be good to go with her.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163716_3: Although I should not be absent without leave, I want to find the princess as soon as possible. Shall we go directly to Temple Island?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163716_4: No. That`s the source of the mist, and we don`t have enough Aquamarines to power the lighthouse and penetrate the mist.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163716_5: Then let`s go to Ancestor Island to search for Aquamarines!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_1: Dello, didn`t you say that it`s always spring-like here? It`s too hot!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_2: I don`t know what`s going on. I was away for just two years. Does this portend the future of Brume Realm?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_3: The climate underwent such a big change in less than two years. Is it because it is the closest to Temple Island?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_4: Brume King is dormant on Temple Island. Could this change have something to do with the Brume King?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_5: It seems we need to find Aquamarines as soon as possible.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_6: Right. The mist on Temple Island has become so thick that it cannot be passed through. We need to bring back Aquamarines to power the lighthouse so that its light could penetrate the mist in the temple.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_7: Since you come from Ancestor Island, what should we do next?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_8: Follow me to meet Shamans here. They may know where we could find Aquamarines.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_9: I didn`t expect to see so many colleagues on this trip.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_10: Finally some cool air. Is this the place where ritual ceremonies were held?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_12: But the surroundings seem unaffected. Why?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_16: Yes, it is. Wait! Who are you!?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_17: Did I take you guys aback? I`m Lysa from Rift Island. What should I call you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_18: I`m Dello, the princess` guard. These two are adventurers from another Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163717_19: Nice to meet you. Hey, I have to say it`s very weird here. I`ve walked around the island for three days and haven`t seen anyone alive.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163717_19_2: Are you a human or a ghost?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_1: Do I have any reason to lie to you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_2: How come! My dad, mom, uncles... Are they all gone?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_3: Who knows? But don`t worry. Although the climate here is somewhat strange, it cannot be counted as a disaster. Maybe the islanders have migrated to other places.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_4: By the way, how did you guys get here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_6: Oh, from Blank Island. As for me, it`s a secret!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_7: They`re not from Blank Island. This is a long story... What are you here for?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_8: For Aquamarines, of course. You can see that Lighthouse Island has been lit up through the mist, can`t you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_10: Why that face? Don`t you know Lighthouse Island is the key to self-rescue? Are you the princess` guard?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_11: I`m not sure if Lighthouse Island is the key. If Brume King cannot wake up, the mist will eventually swallow up the islands, and all our efforts will be in vain.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_12: That`s true, but no one knows why the Brume King is dormant. Who knows if he can wake up or not?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_13: If he doesn`t wake up, we`ll just sit around waiting for our doom?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_14: How dare you! Are you still a citizen of Brume Realm?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_15: Whoa, calm down! I think Lysa is right. We should take control of our own fate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_17: So, Miss Lysa, have you found Aquamarines?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_18: Not yet, but I`m sure Aquamarines should be somewhere in this ritual site. Only Aquamarines can make the surroundings unaffected.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163718_20: Found it! There is a hidden entrance here!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163719_2: How come! My dad, mom, uncles... Are they all gone?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163719_3: Who knows? But don`t worry. Although the climate here is somewhat strange, it cannot be counted as a disaster. Maybe the islanders have migrated to other places.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163719_18: Not yet, but I`m sure Aquamarines should be somewhere in this ritual site. Only Aquamarines can make the surroundings unaffected.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163719_20: Found it! There is a hidden entrance here!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_1: Lysa, is there anyone inside? Is this a temporary shelter?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_2: No one, but plenty of Aquamarines.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_3: Don`t worry too much, Dello. The islanders must have migrated to other islands.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_4: Since we`ve found Aquamarines, I`ll head back first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_5: Wait! You can`t take all the Aquamarines!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_6: I know the rules. We`ll split them 50-50, and no one will lose out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_7: No, they will all be sent to Lighthouse Island. With so many Aquamarines, we can definitely disperse the mist outside the temple.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_8: Excuse me? You want them all? I need Aquamarines, too.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_9: This concerns the future of Brume Realm. Don`t you care at all?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_10: Don`t take the high road. If it weren`t for my alchemy workshop, I would have moved to Blank Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163720_11: Why are they arguing again? Which side should we take this time?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_1: Miss Lysa, may I ask what you need so many Aquamarines for?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_2: For my great alchemical research! My latest airship is about to be completed!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_3: The reason why Lighthouse Island can disperse the mist and this area is not affected by the mist is because of Aquamarines! If my airship uses Aquamarines as its energy source, we can directly disperse all the mist!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_5: Of course! Although I failed. But a qualified alchemist cannot flinch! I have optimized the energy compartment. I will succeed with these Aquamarines!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_6: Your research is very meaningful, but Aquamarines are limited. If you fail again...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_7: By the way, can your airship reach Blank Island?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_9: Then you must know how to improve it. Our next destination is Rift Island. You can conduct close research on our airship while riding on it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_10: The fare is giving all the Aquamarines to Dello. What do you think?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_11: Let me think about it. Can I enter the cockpit?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_14: No problem. As long as you don`t break it down!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_15: You are not kidding me? This... This is just... Great! Let`s go! Now!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_16: My airship is parked by the dock. Dello can use it. Remember to return it afterwards!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_17: Okay. So I can take the Aquamarines now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163721_18: You go to Lighthouse Island first, Dello. If these Aquamarines cannot disperse the mist outside the temple, then use them on the mist on Rift Island first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_1: Miss Lysa, are these Aquamarines really that important to you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_2: Of course! As an alchemist, I have already developed an airship. That`s why I could get here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_3: Brume Realm`s alchemists must keep doing experiments if we want to take control of the air.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_4: But now the sea is covered in mist, and you have seen the changes on Ancestor Island. Aquamarines are an important energy source for the lighthouse. Is it important for your experiments?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_5: Significant! The reason why Lighthouse Island can disperse the mist and this area is not affected by the mist is because of Aquamarines!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_6: If my airship uses Aquamarines as its energy source, isn`t it a movable lighthouse?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_7: You are too naive. Even a real Airship cannot replace the role of the lighthouse, let alone your prototype invention.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_8: Only this small area of Ancestor Island has not been affected, which means we need a large number of Aquamarines to achieve what you said. But can an Airship carry their weight?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_9: We should at least give it a try! Alchemists must overcome their fear of the unknown!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_10: By the time you figure it out, Brume Realm would have sunk to the bottom of the ocean!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_11: I don`t care! I discovered these Aquamarines first!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_12: Well... How about this? Miss Lysa takes some samples to continue her research. At the same time, she rides with us on Blank Island`s Airship to Rift Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_13: During this time, Miss Lysa can conduct close research on our airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_14: I don`t want to... Um? Can I enter the cockpit?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_17: No problem. As long as you don`t break it down!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_18: Well... I am a reasonable person, so yes. When can we set off?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_19: So you don`t need the Aquamarines?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_20: Oh right, Aquamarines. I`ll just take a few! I can lend you my airship by the dock to transport Aquamarines. Don`t drive it violently.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_21: Do you hear me, Princess Guard?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_22: Oh...okay. There`s no problem taking a few. Thank you all for your help.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163722_23: You go to Lighthouse Island first, Dello. If these Aquamarines cannot disperse the mist outside the temple, then use them on the mist on Rift Island first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163723_1: It`s my first time overlooking Rift Island from such a height.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163723_2: Thanks to Dello, otherwise we would still be wandering in the clouds.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163723_3: Yeah! Dello is quite nice, but a bit rigid.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163723_4: Where should we go next? We`ve circled around Rift Island for a while now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163723_5: What`s the rush? I want to study this Airship some more. After all, I`ve given up so many Aquamarines.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_3: Do you feel anything? Why do I have a bad feeling?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_5: Rumbling! Lysa`s scream and a loud noise came from the energy compartment. The Airship shook violently and plummeted towards Rift Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_8: With Heloise`s help, the airship made a thrilling emergency landing on a flat mountaintop.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_11: Sorry, sorry, sorry! I didn`t mean to! You`ll believe me, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_13: Don`t panic. Let me check the damage of the airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_14: It`s okay. Just some dents on the bottom. Fortunately we landed here. If we fell into the valley, it would be a disaster.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_15: I`m a priest of Positive Facet. It`s not difficult for me to control an airship. So what did you do just now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_16: Uh... I accidentally broke the energy supply pipe.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_18: But don`t worry! See those buildings? That`s where my alchemy workshop is. As an alchemist, repairing this kind of damage is no problem for me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_19: Alright then, we`ll leave the repair work to you. Let`s go explore the island first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_21: You and Heloise trekked through beautiful landscapes and had a rest under a large rock.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_22: This terrain of Rift Island is really peculiar! I didn`t expect the trip to this facet could be so fascinating.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_23: Not only that, what was with that goat-deer-like creature just now? It disappeared in the blink of an eye.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_24: I don`t know. I`ve never seen a similar creature in Positive Facet. Maybe we can ask a local.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_25: It`s hard in this kind of wilderness, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_26: A little girl comes over from a distance.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_27: Hi! I`m Lyna, a friend of Lysa. She asked me to tell you the airship has been repaired.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_28: Hello. Are you a local here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_30: Have you ever seen a creature looking like a goat and deer?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_31: Yes, it`s a special kind of elf. People call it Elder of Rift.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_32: I thought it was just a kind of whimsical creature.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163724_33: It is whimsical. Many islanders pray to it and their wishes are occasionally answered.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163725_1: Since the airship has been repaired, let`s go find Lysa. Is Lyna coming?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163725_2: You guys go ahead. I`ll think about it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_2: The airship is over there and it`s been repaired. The repair was crucial this time!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_3: What do you mean? Did you discover any hidden problems of the airship?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_4: No, but I have understood Blank Island`s technology through this repair. I have to say they are smart about energy application.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_5: After all, the airship is the only option for traveling between islands.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_6: Yes, every senior alchemist deserves respect. By the way, did you meet Lady Lyna?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_8: Lady Lyna is not a kid. She`s an elf and has been around for a very long time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_9: She is the Elder of Rift? That goat-deer-like creature?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_10: It`s not so surprising for an elf to have some power that ordinary people can`t understand, is it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_11: Indeed, considering I`ve also been alive for thousands of years.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_12: That is too long even for an elf. Could you tell me the secret of longevity?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_13: We are different species, so my secret doesn`t work for you. Now that the airship is fixed and we`ve explored Rift Island, let`s move on to other islands!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_14: Alright. I still want to confirm one thing. Lysa, did you really use up all the Aquamarines here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_15: Yes. Otherwise, I don`t need to go to Ancestor Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_16: Then let`s head to Barren Island!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163726_17: After bidding farewell to Lysa, you and Heloise didn`t notice that a little girl had climbed to the top of the airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_2: The airship is over there and it`s been repaired. The repair was crucial this time!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_3: What do you mean? Did you discover any hidden problems of the airship?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_4: No, but I have understood Blank Island`s technology through this repair. I have to say they are smart about energy application.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_5: After all, the airship is the only option for traveling between islands.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_6: Yes, every senior alchemist deserves respect. By the way, did you meet Lady Lyna?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_8: Lady Lyna is not a kid. She`s an elf and has been around for a very long time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_9: She is the Elder of Rift? That goat-deer-like creature?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_10: It`s not so surprising for an elf to have some power that ordinary people can`t understand, is it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_11: Indeed, considering I`ve also been alive for thousands of years.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_12: That is too long even for an elf. Could you tell me the secret of longevity?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_13: We are different species, so my secret doesn`t work for you. Now that the airship is fixed and we`ve explored Rift Island, let`s move on to other islands!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_14: Alright. I still want to confirm one thing. Lysa, did you really use up all the Aquamarines here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_15: Yes. Otherwise, I don`t need to go to Ancestor Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_16: Then let`s head to Barren Island!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163727_17: After bidding farewell to Lysa, you and Heloise didn`t notice that a little girl had climbed to the top of the airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163728_1: The desolate Barren Island is in stark contrast to the beautiful Rift Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163728_2: Yeah, did you hear it? The wind blowing through the caves sounds like someone crying out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163728_4: A little girl climbs down from the top of the airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163729_1: I didn`t mean to startle you. But before the mist appeared, I sensed the presence of our race on Barren Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163729_2: The voice sounds as if someone is crying out for help.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163729_3: But you were unable to come here earlier because of the mist?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163729_4: Yes, the mist that shrouded Rift Island had a strong elf scent, which prevented me from figuring out the source of the distress call.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163729_6: Are you saying that the mist covering the realm has a strong elf scent?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163729_8: So the mist is likely not a natural phenomenon, but a living organism with its own consciousness. Or, it is created by a powerful creature.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163729_9: Yes, you are very close to the answer now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_1: Right. It`s highly likely that this mist is created unconsciously by the sleeping Brume King.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_2: Yes. But the scent of that help seeker is somewhat strange.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_4: Yes. It`s praying to me. But why would an elf pray to another elf?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_5: It is strange. Can you hear the prayer now? If so, let`s go take a look!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_8: What kind of prayers do you usually hear, Lyna?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_9: All kinds, such as longing for love, wishing for children`s health, and praying for safe travels.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_11: Tons of! Some hope to get rich overnight, some wish for the death of their rivals, and even some wish to become the king. Some humans are really foolish.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_12: I agree with that. Some humans are foolish, selfish and greedy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_13: Exactly! Once, a human got lost in the rift and prayed to find an exit. When I fulfilled his wish, he prayed again to discover treasures! I made him lose his way again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_15: There used to be a guy named Duncan who prayed every day to become a professional. The point is, he didn`t just pray to me, but to everything from dragons, stone statues, to springs.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_16: I was upset, so I directly summoned a dragon for him. He was freaked out!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_17: Good move! I recalled one more thing! That human... His shoes were missing later.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163730_19: Come on! Any topic for a human?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_1: What kind of king is that? Do you remember what Dello said? The mist will eventually engulf the islands if Brume King doesn`t revive. I never thought Brume King would be an elf.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_2: Yes. But the scent of that help seeker is somewhat strange.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_4: Yes. It`s praying to me. But why would an elf pray to another elf?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_5: It is strange. Can you hear the prayer now? If so, let`s go take a look!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_8: What kind of prayers do you usually hear, Lyna?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_9: All kinds, such as longing for love, wishing for children`s health, and praying for safe travels.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_11: Tons of! Some hope to get rich overnight, some wish for the death of their rivals, and even some wish to become the king. Some humans are really foolish.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_12: I agree with that. Some humans are foolish, selfish and greedy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_13: Exactly! Once, a human got lost in the rift and prayed to find an exit. When I fulfilled his wish, he prayed again to discover treasures! I made him lose his way again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_15: There used to be a guy named Duncan who prayed every day to become a professional. The point is, he didn`t just pray to me, but to everything from dragons, stone statues, to springs.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_16: I was upset, so I directly summoned a dragon for him. He was freaked out!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_17: Good move! I recalled one more thing! That human... His shoes were missing later.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163731_19: Come on! Any topic for a human?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_1: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to repel Blank Knights.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_2: The great Elder of Rift, the Symbol of Wisdom and Life, the Gentle Forest Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to repel Blank Knights!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_3: (I never thought that I could see such an ancient prayer ceremony in this facet.)
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_5: I`m Lyna, Elder of Rift. Why do you have an elf scent?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_6: Elder of Rift!? No way! Elder of Rift is an elf, not a kid!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_7: We came from Rift Island and Lyna followed the race connection to find you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_8: Race connection? That`s impossible! You must be sent by Blank Island. I have already thrown the key into the desert! You can`t get it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_9: Calm down! Lyna once sensed a prayer from Barren Island before the mist appeared. I believe you can tell words of truth from lies.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_11: Tell me what happened. What`s with the elf scent on you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_12: If only you were the Elder of Rift!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_13: My name is Soren, one of the Forbidden Island guards. Before the mist appeared, Forbidden Island had been attacked by Blank Knights.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_14: They took away one key from King Island. Shortly after that, the sea was covered with mist. One of my companions hasn`t returned from Temple Island when Blank Knight came again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_15: Captain Elby ordered me to take another key and go to Rift Island for help. But before I could leave Barren Island, the mist had already blocked the surrounding waters.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163732_16: So the source of the clan scent should be that key.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163733_1: I don`t know. It`s a secret of the royal family and Brume King.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163733_1_1: What is the situation on Forbidden Island now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163734_1: After the mist dissipated, those knights should have left. But I`m not sure of the situation of Captain Elby and the team.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163734_2: They are probably in grave danger. Given that what we have seen along the way, Blank Knights must come to Forbidden Island for the second key.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163734_3: What do you think they would do if they couldn`t find the key when Forbidden Island was shrouded in mist?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163734_4: Don`t be too pessimistic. Now that the mist has dispersed and we haven`t encountered Blank Knights along the way, I think they have not launched a large-scale search.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163734_6: Then let`s go to Forbidden Island. Barren Island is too desolate to have Aquamarines.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163735_1: There were many poisonous insects in this swamp before. Why can`t we see them now? Is it because of the mist?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163735_2: It`s because of Lyna. She is an elf, so poisonous insects and wild beasts dare not approach her.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163735_3: Soren, I`m curious why the key to King Island is on Forbidden Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163735_4: Forbidden Island is unfrequented and full of miasma, which makes it a good place to hide treasures. But most of the treasures are strange.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_1: Yeah, like a boat made of a giant skull, or a rusty sword that blooms poisonous flowers around it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_3: We`ll explore afterwards. Let`s find Captain Elby first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_5: It`s deep in the jungle. We should be close.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_6: It seems that this camp has been abandoned.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_8: What are the odds of their survival according to your understanding of them?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_9: They are familiar with the environment here, so I think they should not have been fully wiped out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_10: Do you have any other camps?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_11: Yes, but that camp is near, so I don`t think they would be there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_13: There are no human traces in this area.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163736_14: It looks like we can only try our luck on the mid-lake island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163737_1: Yes. There is a mid-lake island on Forbidden Island, which countless poisonous snakes inhabit. Would you like to have a try?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163738_1: Let`s go. My intuition tells me that our target is there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163738_2: On the other side of the mid-lake island, there is a small boat moored. When you rowed to the island, water snakes made way for you. The scene is eerie and shocking.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163738_3: This is the antidote for the hallucinogenic gas in the air on the island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163739_1: Don`t be afraid. With Lyna here, snakes dare not come near us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163739_2: On the other side of the mid-lake island, there is a small boat moored. When you rowed to the island, water snakes made way for you. The scene is eerie and shocking.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163739_3: This is the antidote for the hallucinogenic gas in the air on the island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163740_1: You have it. Lyna and I don`t need it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163740_3: Hearing some noise, two people came out from the mid-lake island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163740_8: I am Elby, Captain of the Forbidden Island Security Team. May I know your names?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163741_3: Hearing some noise, two people came out from the mid-lake island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163741_8: I am Elby, Captain of the Forbidden Island Security Team. May I know your names?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163742_1: I`m the chosen hero from Primeval Facet and this is Explorer I.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163743_1: I`m the chosen hero from Primeval Facet, and they are Heloise and Explorer I.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_1: Lyna, the Elder of Rift from Rift Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_2: Elder of Rift? Please forgive my offense.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_3: These adventurers are honored guests from another world. It`s them who lit up Lighthouse Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_5: You`re welcome. What happened after Soren left?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_6: Blank Knights were defeated and fled thanks to the thick mist. They couldn`t distinguish between the mist and the poisonous miasma.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_7: Well done! What about the others?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_8: According to the Tree Presbyter`s instructions, some of them are hiding in Forbidden Island to guard the treasures. Some have gone to Giant Tree Island for shelter, and some have taken Aquamarines to Lighthouse Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_9: Great plan. Let`s talk somewhere else. The air here makes me uncomfortable.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_10: Okay. Let`s go to the open space on the other side.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_11: Why did Bertram come here? Don`t you never leave Giant Tree Island?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_12: I followed the instruction of the Life Tree, which is to put the Life Fruit in place.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163744_13: Life Fruit!? The tale is true?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_1: According to the tale, the heart of the Brume King contains incredible power, so it is called the Life Fruit.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_2: Yes. Two Life Fruits were placed on the altars of King Island. Blank Knights are coming for them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_3: Two hearts? On altars? But I heard that Brume King is still alive? How is that possible?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_4: Only the royal family knows the secret in that. Life Tree guided me to Forbidden Island, saying that there is an opportunity to King Island here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_5: That opportunity should be the keys. So it seems that the keys are used to open the altars on King Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_6: Then we should go to King Island next.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_7: It`s Brume King`s territory. I won`t go there. I`ll go back to Rift Island to search for more Aquamarines.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163745_8: Soren, you stay on Forbidden Island to prevent Blank Knights from attacking again. I`ll take the key and go to King Island with them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163746_1: There`s something I always care about.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_1: When I was listening to the instructions of the Life Tree, I could feel his sadness. But it was calm even when a great war happened decades ago.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_2: Did it foresee a tragic end of Brume Realm?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_3: Cut it out! Bertram, do you know the origin of the ancient tree?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_4: It is said to be related to the mother tree in the Elven Forest, but I don`t know where the Elven Forest is.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_5: I see! The Elven Forest is located in the Positive Facet, which used to be the homeland of the elves. According to Lyna, she and the Brume King are both elves.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_6: That`s why there is a connection between Life Tree and elves. The ancient tree may mourn Brume King`s destiny.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_7: I don`t understand why Brume King put his hearts on the altar.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_8: Let`s continue. Maybe all secrets can be uncovered here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_9: You encountered a girl from Rime Tribe in the snowy mountain.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_11: Hello, I am Bertram, a priest from Giant Tree Island. I came here to put Life Fruits in place according to the instructions of Life Tree.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_12: Hi, I am Roline from the Rime Tribe. We failed to stop Blank Knights, and one Life Fruit has already been stolen.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_13: Then we want to take another Life Fruit to the temple. This is also Life Tree`s suggestion.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163747_14: Since it is so, the Rime Tribe will certainly comply. But other people cannot go to the altar, which is out of respect for Brume King.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163748_1: You go ahead, Bertram. We`ll wait for you here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163748_2: We come here for adventure, and perhaps uncover some secrets along the way. Can you take us around?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163748_4: Roline worried that you didn`t know about the rules here, so she decided to go with you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163748_5: It was you who lit up the lighthouse and dispelled the mist. But I wish Brume Realm would disappear.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163749_1: What if we insisted on going with you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163749_2: It`s not a wise choice to confront the Rime Tribe in King Island. Blank Knights escaped owing to thick mist.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163749_3: Then we`ll do as the Romans do.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163749_4: We come here for adventure, and perhaps uncover some secrets along the way. Can you take us around?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163749_6: Roline worried that you didn`t know about the rules here, so she decided to go with you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163749_7: It was you who lit up the lighthouse and dispelled the mist. But I wish Brume Realm would disappear.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_1: Brume Realm was established by a group of bandits from Brume Tribe. For Rime Tribe, there is no compassion for them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_3: Impossible? Hundreds of years ago, there used to be wide rivers, verdant land, and flourishing lives on King Island. We Rime Tribe lived in the snow-capped mountains and still got copious foods.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_4: Until one day, those bandits came. We were defeated. In order to get the power of the storm, the bandits threatened Brume King with the survival of our tribe and forced him to surrender.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_5: Eventually, Brume King conceded. His two hearts were placed on a mysterious altar and he himself was imprisoned at the bottom of Temple Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_6: That`s how the bandits ruled King Island for hundreds of years. If not for Blank Knights, they might still be reveling now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_7: Why did Blank Knights want to snatch Life Fruits?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_8: For a grand auction to please their guests!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_11: Not now. Selna has one heart now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_13: There`s another question. Why didn`t Princess Selna return the Life Fruit to the altar?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_14: You`ll have to ask her yourself. I have something else to do, so I`ll take my leave.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_15: Roline flew away, leaving you three looking at each other.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_17: Yes. Leave the rest to us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_18: Frankly, I don`t trust Brume Tribe at all.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_19: The instructions of the Life Tree cannot be wrong.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_20: When you arrived, Roline and Bertram were chatting.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_21: Have you got the Life Fruit, Bertram?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_22: Yes. Let`s rest a bit before heading to Temple Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_24: Don`t worry, I`ve got a commitment from the Rime Tribe. Aquamarines will be transported to Lighthouse Island as soon as possible.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_25: Great! Do you join us to go to Temple Island, Roline?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_26: No. You guys go. Oh, Captain Elby will stay here for now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_28: Let`s just call it a hostage.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_31: Alright. You`ll be fine, Elby. Let`s go.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163750_32: Let`s go to Temple Island and meet this princess!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_1: How long does it take to build such a grand and luxurious temple?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_2: According to the records, they have kept expanded the temple since the establishment of Brume Realm.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_3: This is more like a huge castle!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_5: Excuse me, are you Tree Presbyter Bertram?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_8: They are distinguished travelers who dispelled the mist.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_9: Sorry. May I invite you to the reception hall?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_10: This is the reception hall. Please wait a moment. The princess will come to greet you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_11: The Defender left the hall, leaving you in the empty and grandiose hall, which now looks somewhat eerie.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_12: Bertram, why did Roline hold Elby hostage?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_13: Shh! Let`s talk about this later.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_14: It seems that this move relates to the fate of the realm.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_15: I only trust the instructions of the Life Tree. He will give suggestions that are beneficial to everyone.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_16: Footsteps came from outside, and a woman came in.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_17: Sorry for the long wait. Please come to the Selna Hall. We can talk in detail there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_19: I already heard about you two. Please accept my gratitude with the highest courtesy!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_20: My pleasure. At first, I just went on an adventure with him, and we didn`t expect such encounters.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_21: Brume Realm during this period is indeed not a place for adventurers.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_22: Tree Presbyter, have you obtained Brume King`s Life Fruit?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_23: Yes, but Elby from Forbidden Island was held hostage by Rime Tribe.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_24: They still do not trust me. I thought I gained Rime Tribe`s trust last time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_25: Tree Presbyter, please tell me Life Tree`s instructions in detail.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_26: Life Tree is very sad. It sensed Brume King`s death wish and he foresaw the disaster after Brume King`s death.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_27: Then my decision was correct. What our tribe has done to Brume King will lead to retribution from the ocean. However, the nobles and other royal families think we should maintain the status quo.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_28: So what are you going to do next?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_29: Revive Brume King! Or create a new Brume King.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163751_30: I have a few questions regarding Brume King.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163751_31_1: What kind of creature is Brume King?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163751_31_2: Does Brume King have two hearts?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163751_31_3: Does Brume King affect the rise and fall of the kingdom?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163752_1: Brume King is an ocean spirit. Originally, it was just a powerful elf. After gaining consciousness from the faith of islanders, it gradually became a totem of some tribes.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163752_2_1: What kind of creature is Brume King?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163752_2_2: Does Brume King have two hearts?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163752_2_3: Does Brume King affect the rise and fall of the realm?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163753_1: Brume King has three hearts, one main heart and two minor hearts. Our ancestors put two minor hearts into the altar to protect the realm from mist and storms.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163753_2:
The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit...
No wonder Brume King is respected as a totem. It does have some power over a specific area.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163753_3: Yes. Brume King itself could bring peace to the realm.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163753_4_1: What kind of creature is Brume King?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163753_4_2: Does Brume King have two hearts?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163753_4_3: Does Brume King affect the rise and fall of the realm?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163754_1: Elves are magical creatures. As darlings of nature, they have unique abilities. However, elves never seek help from each other.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163754_2: Prior to this, no elf knew about the suffering of Brume King. But now Life Tree has sensed that Brume King intends to give up his life.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163754_3: Once Brume King dies, nature will punish the perpetrator. At that time, the fury of the ocean will engulf the entire Brume Realm.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163754_4_1: What kind of creature is Brume King?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163754_4_2: Does Brume King have two hearts?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_3163754_4_3: Does Brume King affect the rise and fall of the realm?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_1: Now the top priority is to save Brume King.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_2: How? What can we do to stimulate his thirst for life?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_3: Brume King can be revived after the Life Fruits are placed back in the altar. As for how to stimulate his thirst for life... I don`t have a good idea.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_6: A voice rang out in Selna Hall.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_7: Then I will become the new Brume King.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_8: The actions of Brume Tribe are despicable and humans are foolish, but I hate to part with the cute creatures on Rift Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_9: Lyna!? What are you doing here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_10: I felt the call from Life Tree, so I came here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_11: What will happen after you become the new Brume King?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_12: By then, perhaps Lyna won`t be Lyna anymore.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_13: Is it worth it for these foolish humans?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_16: Let`s get started. Maybe Brume King doesn`t want to die now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_18: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to return and rule the realm again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_19: The Giant Tree, the Symbol of Life and Nature, Mother of Elves, I implore you, in my name, to help Brume King regain its life.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_20: Selna`s and Bertram`s singing echoed in the dim hall.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_21: I`ve found the exit. Why do you pull me back into the abyss again?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_22: I apologize for the sins of my ancestors, Brume King! Please return and regain your freedom!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_23: I`ve found the exit. Why do you pull me back into the abyss again?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_24: Life Fruits have been returned to their place, and you have been revived, Brume King!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_25: I`ve found the exit. Why do you pull me back into the abyss again?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_26: I`ve found the exit. Why do you...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_28: It`s over. Brume King is unwilling to return.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163755_29: Brume King`s consciousness was messy. Lyna had to make a choice. Which ending will you choose?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_2: No, there must be another way!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_4: Perhaps rekindling the power of faith would help it regain its consciousness.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_5: It seems we can only try to communicate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_7: A ripple started from Heloise, spreading throughout the entire realm. People on different islands felt that power, and then chanting began.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_8: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to return and rule the realm again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_9: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to return and rule the realm again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_10: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to return and rule the realm again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_11: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to return and rule the realm again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_12: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to return and rule the realm again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_13: The great Brume King, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving Ocean Spirit, I implore you, in my name, to return and rule the realm again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_14: I felt it... I felt the call.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_15: Brume King, please return and regain your freedom!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_19: I`m tired. I`ll go back to Blank Island to have a rest. You can proceed the adventure yourself.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_20: Thank you for resolving the crisis for our kingdom.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163756_21:
With Brume King`s return, the Brume Realm will start a new chapter.
Congratulations on unlocking the ending `Brume King`!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163757_3: Lyna slowly floated up. The three Life Fruits were attracted to Lyna and merged into her body.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163757_5: (sobbing) You are... You are the Brume King.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163757_7: A new Brume King was born, which is undoubtedly good news for the entire Brume Realm. But for islanders of Rift Island, they lost an elder.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163757_8: Congratulations on unlocking the ending `Elder`s Sorrow`.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163758_1: Welcome to Giant Tree Island again. What do you come for this time?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163759_1: There are many hidden dangers on Giant Tree Island. Please be careful.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163759_2: A burly gorilla is in your way. How will you deal with it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163760_1: There is a Life Tree in the depths of Giant Tree Island. You may get some treasures there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163760_2: There is a river ahead. How will you get across?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163761_1: You have successfully defeated the gorilla and entered the depths of the forest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163761_2: The forest is a forbidden zone of Giant Tree Island. Please leave.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163762_1: Your ankle was hit by a stone thrown by the gorilla, but you still manage to run into the depths of the forest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163762_2: You have come to a fork in the road. A wooden signpost indicates the left path is `Thorn Road` and the right one is `Dark Road.`
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163763_1: Moved by your sincerity, Tree Keeper decided to take you to visit the Life Tree. Luckily, you found a Sacred Fruit under the tree.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163764_1: After traversing a thorny road, you successfully arrived at the foot of the Life Tree and found a chest under the tree.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163765_1: You walked farther and farther along the tree-lined path until you reached the coast of Giant Tree Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163766_1: Tree Keeper`s strength is beyond your imagination. You were defeated and sent out of Giant Tree Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163767_1: You were bitten by a venomous snake in the river while swimming, so you had to end the exploration and go back for treatment.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163768_1: The mist is heavy here. How will you protect yourself from the mist?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163769_1: It turned out to be mist that materialized due to the concentration of vital energy and you felt refreshed. Finally, you arrived at the foot of the Life Tree. The ancient tree praised your courage and sent you a blessing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163770_1: The deeper you went, the thicker the mist became. You felt difficulty breathing, and finally lost consciousness. When you woke up, you found yourself back on the Airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163771_1: Have you not continued to explore other islands? What brought you back to Ancestor Island?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163772_1: Ancestor Island does have some mysterious customs that attract outside adventurers, but be careful here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163772_2: This is where the Shamans hold their rituals. You cannot enter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163773_1: If it were two years ago, I could understand if you said you came here for sightseeing. But now... Never mind. Have a good time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163773_2: There is a soldier-like statue ahead. Go to say hi?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163774_1: Impressive! I love strong heroes like you. Go ahead inside!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163774_2: You enter a magnificent hall where the shamans are holding a mysterious ceremony and ask if you want to participate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163775_2: You`re unhappy with Tauren`s attitude when a merchant happens to pass by and turns to run. You can choose to:
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163776_1: The soldier`s name is Leonard, and he introduces you to a sightseeing spot.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163776_2: You enter a magnificent hall where the shamans are holding a mysterious ceremony and ask if you want to participate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163777_1: You silently avoid him, and he seems not to notice you either.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163777_2: You discover a peculiar glowing animal with long ears. It looks like a rabbit. You can choose to:
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163778_1: Although you were not used to it, you chose to follow the customs. This move won the favor of Shaman, who gave you a pure gold statue and invited you to come back to Ancestor Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163779_1: Your refusal seemed to irritate them, and they expelled you from the island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163780_1: The merchant seemed extremely timid. He took out a bottle of water from his backpack and put it in your hands, then fled away hastily.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163781_1: You wandered around for a while and found that there was nothing special here, so you left Ancestor Island and returned to the Airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163782_1: At the moment your weapon touched the peculiar animal, you found the surroundings rapidly receding and saw soldier-like statues and Dello in the desert. Finally you returned to the Airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163783_1: The peculiar animal rubbed its glowing little head against your leg, and you received its blessing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163784_1: You`re back? Did something happen to the airship?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163785_1: I thought you found out that there were missing parts in the airship. Well, have fun!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163785_2: You see a creature that looks like Lyna in the open space below. How do you go there?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163786_1: If you want to buy something really rare, you need to find the fat merchant. He is often wandering in the wild. Good luck.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163786_2: Hello. My father asked me to chop down a tree on the mountain, but I`m afraid I cannot do it on my own. Can you help me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163787_1: The shortcut in the mountain was very steep, but you still successfully arrived. The sheep-and-deer-like creature felt your kindness and bestowed on you the `Mountain Blessing`.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163788_1: He seems to be annoyed by your belated arrival. So he disappeared. You have to explore elsewhere.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163788_2: There is an altar ahead, with golden fruits on it. Take them?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163789_1: Thank you for your help. The view from the top of the mountain is amazing. By the way, my family runs a grocery store at the foot of the mountain. You are welcome to visit us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163789_2: You met a fat merchant at the entrance of the grocery store. He kindly asked if you had helped his child. What is your answer?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163790_1: Well, I guess I have to continue my dad`s devil training.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163790_2: You met a fat merchant who was chopping durian trees halfway up the mountain. He tried to sell a glider that is very popular on Rift Island recently. What is your choice?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163791_1: The golden fruit contained magical power. The moment you held it, you felt comfortable all over.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163792_1: Hesitating a while, you decided not to touch the item on the altar. But the guards nearby noticed you and expelled you from the island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163793_1: Your honesty was not appreciated by the fat merchant. He even reproached you for being officious. You were disappointed and decided to leave Rift Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163794_1: Ellen received your help, but he lied that you saved him from the beast. Your denial made the fat merchant think that you have a noble character, so he gave you a medal as a reward.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163795_1: The hang glider was very sturdy. During the test flight, you encountered a strong updraft and it sent you back to the Airship surprisingly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163796_1: The rejected fat merchant continued to cut down trees without saying anything. Unfortunately, a falling durian hit your head, and you had returned to the Airship when you woke up.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163797_1: Are you a companion of Elder of Rift? What are you doing here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163798_1: After the mist dispersed, many merchants come to Barren Island. Please avoid contact with them as much as possible. Also, there are strange noises on the island recently. Please be careful and may the mountain elf bless you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163798_2: You heard a cry for help and found some merchants. Their camel lay on the ground, and they asked you for some water. What is your choice?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163799_1: I heard there is an ancient teleportation array on Barren Island. Maybe you can try your luck there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163799_2: Hey! You are here for treasure hunting, aren`t you? Want to join me? I`m Cohen, a famous explorer.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163800_1: Your good deed aroused their greed. Obviously, generosity is rare on Barren Island today, so you were robbed.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163801_1: You recalled Soren`s warning and showed your weapon. They realized that you were not someone to mess with, so they patted the camel and left with their cargo.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163801_2: Are you a traveler? Could you help me deliver a letter?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163802_1: Sure! It looks like our treasure hunting will go smoothly!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163802_2: With Cohen`s help, you found the teleportation array and arrived at a palace ruins. There is a locked treasure chest in the center of the ruins. Cohen offers to open it. What is your decision?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163803_1: Well, sadly, you have turned down an experienced partner. I wish you could survive and leave here alive.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163803_2: As it turned out, you can also find treasures without the help of others. There is a locked treasure chest in the center of the ruins. What is your choice?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163804_1: Please deliver this letter to princess to inform Dello of our whereabouts. Thank you for your help, and these coins are your reward. I believe that you are a trustworthy person.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163805_1: I understand that Barren Island is currently perilous, and I know you also want to leave this desert as soon as possible. So take these food and go.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163806_1: This is a chest for teleportation. You accidentally activated the teleportation array. With a flash of light, you found yourself back in the Airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163807_1: Cohen is an experienced adventurer. He recognized the teleportation array on the chest and your decision won his approval. After opening the chest, a pure gold statue was in front of you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163808_1: Although it took some effort, you opened the chest successfully and saw a gold key lying at the bottom. You tried it and it could open the lock on the chest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163809_1: It turns out that carrying a chest on the way can easily attract `friends`. A group of merchants kindly sent you out of Barren Island and offered to keep the chest for you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163810_1: As a chosen hero from Primeval Facet, what brings you to Forbidden Island?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163811_1: I must warn you in advance that most of the dangers here come from mysterious things. Don`t touch things you`re not supposed to touch.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163811_2: An old man dressed in animal skins with his face painted invites you to join him in clearing out snakes on the mid-lake island. What will you choose?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163812_1: There are many treasures on Forbidden Island, but I advise you not to think about the part belonging to the royal family. We have our people guarding that area.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163812_2: There`s a copper coffin ahead, one corner of which is slightly open, and silver light shines from within. Do you want to get closer to take a look?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163813_1: The elderly man introduces himself as a survival expert of Brume Realm. He dresses you up so that you resemble the natives of Forbidden Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163813_2: After arriving at the mid-lake island, you split up to clear out snakes when you find a treasure chest. Will you inform the old man?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163814_1: The old man hands you a bottle of antidote and advises you to take it if you feel dizzy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163814_2: The deeper you go into the swamp, the dizzier you feel. You look at the antidote in your hand and ponder whether to drink it or not.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163815_1: A silver hand reached out from the coffin and covered your face, making you feel weak. When you woke up, you were already lying in the Airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163816_1: It`s too weird to see a coffin here. So you decide to leave.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163816_2: There is a boat in the swamp, sparkling with dazzling lights. But you also notice guards nearby. It might be the royal family`s treasure. Will you choose to forcibly break in?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163817_1: The old man was surprised at your generosity. When he opened the chest, he was bitten by a small snake. The old man did not care too much, and you successfully got an antique bronze scepter. But when you were about to leave the island, the old man died of poisoning.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163818_1: You thought the chest was yours since you found it. When you opened the chest, you were bitten by a small snake. Soon after, you passed out and woke up on the Airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163819_1: The taste of the antidote was extremely bitter. After taking it, you began to have illusions. You stumbled out of the swamp and back to the Airship. When you became sober, you found that the poison was gone.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163820_1: You decided to continue the journey. But obviously, you overestimated yourself. you passed out and woke up on the dock below Airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163821_1: You were lucky enough to enter the boat and got a colorful stone called `Heart of Ocean`.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163822_1: While you were looking at the boat, a guard recognized you and thanked you for dispersing the mist in Brume Realm. He gave you a heavy sword as a gift.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163823_1: Outsider, why are you here instead of meeting the princess in the temple?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163824_1: Do not trespass on the altar. This is a serious warning. By the way, the temperature on the mountain will drop lower after the mist disappears. Prepare well before going there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163824_2: You discover a cave entrance on a cliff. Enter it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163825_1: If it were a few hundred years ago, I might have believed you. Now sightseeing? You`re here to seek treasures, aren`t you? You`d better leave as soon as possible.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163825_2: A wounded snow eagle on the ground in front of you. How will you choose?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163826_1: There is a grand hall hidden in the cave.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163826_2: In the mysterious hall, two things catch your attention: a golden throne and a tungsten iron chest. Which will you choose?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163827_1: Judging from the marks, you suspect that this dwelling was artificially excavated. To avoid disturbing the residents inside, you decide to explore elsewhere.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163827_2: You`re running out of energy and notice an unoccupied house, which is possibly a hunter`s shelter. There are some supplies and dried meat inside. Will you take them?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163828_1: The snow eagle attacked fiercely. You successfully killed it after a long battle, but all your equipment was damaged. Therefore, you had to return to replenish supplies.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163829_1: The snow eagle seems to have intelligence as its sharp eyes softened. After the treatment, it set off into the sky. Not long after, it returned with a treasure map in its beak.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163829_2: Following the treasure map, you discovered an old ship. A huge snow panther took shelter there. Seeing the pile of treasures behind it, what will you choose?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163830_1: The moment you sit on the throne, you seemed to turn into an eagle, overlooking the entire King Island. A powerful force gathered around you, and you received the blessing of Brume King.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163831_1: Compared to the flashy throne, you chose the chest. When it was opened, an alarm rang through the hall. You panicked and fled in a hurry.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163832_1: After replenishing supplies, you set out for exploration again, and finally found a treasure near a mountain stream. But the hunter who went out hunting without any gains met his end.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163833_1: You did not want to go against your conscience, so you left the house despite the cold and hunger. Before long, you became exhausted and decided to return to the Airship to have a rest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163834_1: You approached the sleeping snow panther and ended its life with ease. Afterwards, you found a great sword with icy light among the treasure pile.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163835_1: Without disturbing the sleeping snow panther, you left quietly and wandered on the mountain for a long time. You returned to the Airship after your supplies ran out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163836_1: Honorable traveller, welcome to Brume Realm again. What do you come for this time?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163837_1: I see. The route inside the temple is complicated. If you get lost, remember to ask other guards for directions. Besides, there are some tamed beasts inside the temple. Please do not approach them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163837_2: You followed your memory and ended up in an unfamiliar place. There is a person from Rime Tribe imprisoned in this hall. How would you choose when facing his pleading for help?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163838_1: I see. The temple is divided into two parts, the east belongs to the nobles, and the west belongs to the royal family. Some of the nobles and the royal members do not like to be visited by strangers.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163838_2: You arrived at the fork. The east belongs to the nobles and the west belongs to the royal family. Which way will you go?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163839_1: He was a criminal escorted by Rime Tribe to the temple. The previous king did not execute him in order to ease relations between the two tribes. Obviously, your kindness made no sense to such a villain. He attacked you the moment the shackles were opened. When you woke up, you were already on the Airship
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163840_1: As the saying goes, the pitiful have something hateful. You chose to leave directly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163840_2: A Defender is whipping a tamed lion ahead. Will you go to stop him?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163841_1: The architectural style becomes more and more extravagant. So you are sure that you enter the area of the nobles.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163841_2: Who are you? I haven`t seen a stranger in the temple for a long time. Anyway, come! Have a drink!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163842_1: The architectural style becomes more and more solemn. So you are sure that you are approaching the power center of the realm.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163842_2: The chosen hero? Perfect timing. I have been thinking about a problem. If killing one person can save tens of thousands, what would you choose?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163843_1: Tears of gratitude filled the lioness` eyes as she moved aside, revealing the cub she was protecting. She handed the cub to you, as if telling you not to let her child be enslaved again. You left with the cub and received the blessing from the mother.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163844_1: While you were wandering around in the temple, you always stumbled into a prison or animal training ground. You felt oppressed and returned to the Airship, ending this exploration.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163845_1: Nice! I like to make friends with straightforward guys. Come on, pick anything you want!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163846_1: Hmph! Guards! Get the rat out of here!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163847_1: Rulers should ask themselves before making decisions. Leave! There might be unrest next.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163848_1: You also choose this way? This is the dilemma that rulers must face. Thank you for the answer. This medal is a gift for you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163849_1: You need to collect Driving Power Stones from a crater to drive the airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163849_2: If the Driving Power is insufficient, you have to deal with it on your own. Let`s leave for Giant Tree Island!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163850_1: Good job! You have unlocked the Exploration Degree of Giant Tree Island. Completing each exploration will increase the Exploration Degree by 10 points. Achieving a new ending will also add 20 points to the Exploration Degree and light up a star.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163850_2: When the Exploration Degree of each island reaches 100 points, you can get additional rewards. You`ll get permanent garments after achieving all endings of the islands.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163851_1: Old Cole sent a letter? Let me check.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163851_2: I see. We need to upgrade the lighthouse to disperse the mist.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3163851_3: What? We can join in the lottery after using Aquamarines? Brilliant! Try it! Try it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680311_1_1: Hi, %s, you can call me World Priestess, or just Eloise.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680312_1_1: Recently, there will be some unusual events in Twin City, and you need to prepare.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680312_2_1: Unusual events? Can you be more specific?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680312_1_2: Many forces came to Twin City from Bird Island and Ape City. Also, many practitioners on the continent of Conquer have enhanced their strength, including those Marauders who disturb the order.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680312_2_2: Sounds like you know some inside information.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680312_1_3: Of course, the tide of the times is advancing, and many things you naturally understand.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680312_2_3: So, just these things? What should I prepare for?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680312_1_4: Many practitioners have died mysteriously while practicing recently. I need your help to investigate this matter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680313_1_1: You can go to the outskirts and find someone named Winter; he might know some clues.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680314_2_1: Winter is supposed to be around here. Strange, where is he?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680321_2_1: Winter is capturing some Marauders for human experiments. He mentioned a new cultivation system.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680321_1_2: How do you feel about this?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680321_2_2: You mean the human experiments or the new cultivation system?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680321_1_3: Of course, the Spheres system! As for the human experiments, I will stop them. These people from Bird Island always like to mess around.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680323_1_1: I`m not surprised, considering your first impression of evil human experiments.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680322_1_2: The Spheres system is theoretically perfect, but when new things are implemented, there are always obstacles.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680322_2_1: It sounds like you are familiar with this cultivation system.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680322_1_3: In the near future, the Chosen Ones will also come into contact with the Spheres system.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680322_2_2: Maybe not, that Winter seems to dislike outsiders like me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680322_1_4: Him? The Spheres system is not created by him. Two thousand years of experience tells me that when the wheel of history starts turning, individual alone cannot stop it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680324_1_1: Not exactly, you`ll find out later.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680331_1_1: Hi, %s, you seem uneasy. Is something happening?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680332_1_1: Don`t worry; he`s still alive. Currently discussing cultivation insights with the senior monks in the west of Wind Plain. Are you looking for him?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680332_2_1: I received a commission to find Den Berg; two ladies think he`s missing, and Winter also thinks he may have fallen into Marauders` ambush.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680332_1_2: Interesting. I didn`t expect Den Berg to be quite popular. Well, it`s not surprising; after all, he is knowledgeable, well-spoken, and wealthy, but a bit old-looking.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680332_2_2: Uh, I`ll go tell those two ladies Den Berg is fine.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680332_1_3: This matter is left to me; after all, I sent him to visit various practitioners, which led people to think Den Berg was missing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680332_1_4: Who? Den Berg and me? He can be considered my subordinate, and as for the story between Den Berg and me, you`ll know later.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680341_1_1: %s, there`s a disturbance at the city gate. Can you help mediate?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680342_1_1: Yes, a dwarf from Ape City, stopped by the City Guard. Both sides could erupt into a fight at any moment.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680343_1_1: Not really. On the surface, humans and dwarves live in harmony, but secretly, humans in Twin City look down on dwarves. These City Guards always like to harass dwarves at such times; it`s really boring.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680343_2_1: Well, as the World Priestess, why don`t you step in to mediate the conflict between the two races?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680343_1_2: If I intervene, neither side can be helped; otherwise, this conflict will pass to the leaders of both races. Currently, the strong ones from both races support each other on the Facet battlefields. I don`t want them to have a rift because of this.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680343_2_2: Although I`m not quite clear about the deep-seated reasons, I can help.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680351_1_1: Hi, %s, didn`t expect you to be so righteous.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680351_2_1: So, this dwarf gentleman came to you for what?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680351_3_1: Stranger, you can call me Dwarf Dadar. I like adventure and gemstone identification. This time, I`m here to ask World Priestess Eloise for help in treating my wife Sunia.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680352_3_1: Yes, she suffered a severe injury in the Facet battlefields and withdrew to the dwarf territory, barely alive. I want to ask the World Priestess for help in healing her.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680352_1_1: Well, I just got this news. By the way, Dadar, have you tried finding the elves?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680352_3_2: Yes, I`ve asked the elves; it was the elder of the elves who asked me to find you. They have tried elven holy water, but...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680353_1_1: %s, we`ll talk about other things later. I`ll accompany Dadar to Ape City first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680353_2_1: You two should go quickly, Dadar, hoping your companion can be saved.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680361_1_1: Hi, we`ve had quite a few visitors in Twin City recently. I`ll be introducing you to an interesting person shortly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680362_1_1: I`d rather keep it a surprise. You can look forward to it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680411_1_1: Stranger, thank you again for your help earlier, but I don`t want to see anyone right now. Please leave.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680411_2_1: Be optimistic. At least Sunia`s soul has not dissipated.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680411_1_2: What did you say? I warn you not to joke about Sunia`s death with me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680411_2_2: Didn`t Eloise tell you? Sunia`s soul still has the possibility of recovery.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680411_1_3: No, when Eloise and I came back, Sunia was already gone. Are you saying Sunia can be saved?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680411_2_3: I`m not sure. Eloise mentioned a strange stone; she said that it was that stone that kept Sunia`s soul in a deep sleep. If we have more stones like that, Eloise might have a way to awaken her soul.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680411_1_4: Stone? The one hanging on her neck?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680412_1_1: That`s our token of love! When Sunia and I were young, we accidentally entered a secret realm. We experienced life and death there, and in the end, I gave that stone as a gift to Sunia. She knew my love for gemstones, so she promised to be with me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680413_1_1: Yes! Chosen One, I want to entrust you with something. If Eloise is right, and Sunia needs more of those stones, I remember the location of the secret realm, so...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680414_1_1: Thank you! Those stones can be obtained from monsters, but the monsters there are not weak. Please be careful.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680511_1_1: Chosen One, two ladies recently posted a missing person notice. Can you help?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680511_2_1: Shouldn`t this be a job for a private detective? Also, why doesn`t the guards of Twin City handle this?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680511_1_2: We apologize, Chosen One. We received orders that there are many suspicious individuals from Ape City and Bird Island in Twin City recently, and we are too busy to spare manpower temporarily.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680511_2_2: Okay, where is the missing person notice posted?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680511_1_3: Right next to the craftsman Song Qing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680521_1_1: Chosen One, is there anything I can help you with?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680521_1_2: This dwarf gentleman wants to force his way into Twin City. As a City Guard, I naturally cannot let him in.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680521_3_1: Stranger, don`t listen to this despicable human! I have urgent matters to request assistance from Lady Eloise! Although I`ve agreed to pay a high entrance tax, he still refuses to let me in.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680522_3_1: It`s called an entrance tax, but it`s actually openly soliciting bribes!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680522_1_1: Cough, don`t speak ill of others.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680522_2_1: Tell me, how can he enter the city?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680522_1_2: Since the Chosen One is mediating, I`ll relax my requirements. No entrance tax, but, Mr. Dwarf, I need you to hunt 10 Pheasants outside the city, specifically the small ones.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680522_2_2: (Frowning) I`ll go hunt! Mr. Dwarf, wait for me; I`ll be back soon.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680531_1_1: Chosen One, you actually don`t need to stand up for these dwarves. Besides the blacksmith, no one in the city welcomes them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680531_2_1: Why do you discriminate against the dwarf race?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680531_1_2: This... I don`t know because people just don`t like the dwarves. I don`t need to be different from others.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680531_2_2: What a ridiculous reason. So, next time you encounter dwarves, you won`t let them into the city?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680531_1_3: Of course, these rules are not set by me. I don`t want to be isolated by others.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680531_1_4: Hey, Dwarf, you`re lucky to have the Chosen One helping you, and you can go in now. Next time, you won`t be so fortunate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680531_3_1: Stranger, thank you for your help.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680811_1_1: Outsider! Are you with those Marauders?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680811_2_1: Obviously not. Eloise entrusted me to investigate the mysterious deaths of practitioners, and coincidentally, I heard that you are planning some evil human experiments. I think you should give a reasonable explanation.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680811_1_2: Evil human experiments? Outsider, are you pitying those Marauders with blood on their hands?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680812_2_1: Even Marauders have the right to survive.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680813_2_1: That`s not the point, but your actions are not much different from Marauders.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680812_1_1: Do you know how many people died during the development of the life potions back then? The greatness of the Spheres system far surpasses those trivial things!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680814_1_1: I told you wouldn`t understand. In any case, don`t think of hindering me! Also, you outsiders should stay away from the Spheres system!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680821_1_1: Outsider, how did you find me? Did a Marauder give you information?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680821_2_1: Don`t be nervous; I just want to ask you a question. Do you know Den Berg?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680821_1_2: Of course, we`ve been friends since childhood. As for other things, I won`t tell you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680821_2_2: Listen, Den Berg is missing. I received commissions from two ladies, and he`s been out of contact for two days.
