en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680821_1_3: What? Just a few days ago, he was on Bird Island trying to persuade the high-ups at Yagakbu to promote the Spheres system. How could he be missing now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680821_1_3_1: No need to lie to you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680822_2_1: Could he have been ambushed by Marauders like you, both being related to that Spheres system?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680822_1_1: It`s possible! Outsider, quickly go find Lady Eloise; Den Berg used to meet with her frequently. Maybe Lady Eloise can help!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680911_1_1: Winter! Why leave Bird Island, a good place, to come to Wind Plain and cause trouble for us?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680911_2_1: Since when did marauder become victims? Also, I`m not Winter; you`ve got the wrong person.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680911_1_2: Marauders in Wind Plain never plunder the poor. If you don`t believe it, you can go ask Captain Davis of the City Guard in Twin City.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680911_2_2: Interesting. Answer a few questions for me, and I might consider letting you leave.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680911_1_3: Ask away. Whether we found the right ambush target or not, we lost. We just hope you`ll keep your word like Davis.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680912_1_1: He`s a knight in Bird Island, affiliated with the Yagakbu organization. About this organization, I must say, people from Yagakbu are very resentful of you outsiders.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680912_1_2: I don`t know, perhaps just out of xenophobia. Any more questions?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680913_1_1: He recently obtained a new cultivation system, conducting human experiments on Marauders on the island. Many have died, causing others to hide. Now, he`s in Wind Plain seeking more test subjects!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680914_1_1: Yes, now you understand why we ambushed him, right? As marauders, we must know that seizing the initiative is the key.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3680915_1_1: We also set up an ambush to the north; perhaps he`s over there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_1_1: Hello, Chosen One, the weather is nice today. May I ask what brings you here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_2_1: Hello, Lady Celina. I saw the missing person notice you posted.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_1_2: Really? Do you have any clues about Den Berg?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_2_2: Not yet. I hope to learn more information from you. For example, who is Den Berg exactly, and why are you all looking for him?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_1_3: I`ll share all I know, hoping you find him soon. Den Berg, a noble from Bird Island, is known for his gentility. Others seek him, possibly due to the innovative Spheres system. I`m looking for him simply because I admire him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_2_3: We had planned to discuss the history of the dwarf race together. He has never broken a commitment before, so... I`m worried he might be in danger.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_1_4: Den Berg created the Spheres system?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_2_4: Yes, but I`m not a practitioner, so I`m not interested in that aspect.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681011_1_5: Thank you for the information. I will do my best to find him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681111_1_1: Hey! You`re an outsider practitioner? Oh, sorry, I guess I should call you the Chosen One?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681112_2_1: Yes, I want to know more about it. When Mr. Berg left, did he mention any other destinations?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681112_1_2: No, he only mentioned Twin City. I`ve been looking for him for two days! I should have accompanied him to Twin City; that way, at least I could have protected him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681112_1_3: Yes, he... I don`t mean to belittle Den Berg, but he indeed lacks the means to protect himself.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681112_2_3: Thank you for the information; I will search for Den Berg in Wind Plain. Meanwhile, Lady Dailey, you can continue looking along the line between the two cities.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681112_1_4: I understand. Thank you, Chosen One.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681211_1_1: Respectful Twin City practitioners, I am Dailey. I need to find a historian named Den Berg. He wears a blue-black robe and looks handsome. If there are clues, please find me in the southern Wind Plain.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681212_1_1:
Missing Person Notice:
    Respectful Twin City practitioners, I am Celina. I need to find a gentleman named Den Berg. He is holding a book and looks handsome. If there are clues, please find me in the northern Twin City.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681411_1_1: %s, I have some bad news for you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681412_1_1: Well, unfortunately, she has passed away...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681412_2_1: Ah... I hope her soul finds peace.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681412_1_2: You`re right. Fortunately in misfortune, Sunia`s soul has not dissipated.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681413_1_1: When we returned, Sunia had already passed away, but miraculously, her soul did not dissipate. I carefully examined and found that she had a peculiar stone on her, and that stone`s power is sustaining Sunia`s soul.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681413_1_2: I`m surprised you asked such a cute question. In the continent of Conquer, of course, souls can exist independently. The one in front of you is an example.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681414_1_1: Strictly speaking, I`m a spiritual being. A spiritual being is not a race but a form of existence. In theory, I can turn into anything.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681414_1_1_1: Can you turn into a cat?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681414_1_1_2: Can you turn into a dog?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681415_1_1: Now is not the time to discuss that. I hope you can help me with something.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681416_1_1: Ask Dadar about the origin of that stone. If Sunia`s soul becomes strong enough, I can directly ask her. But currently, the power of that stone is very weak, and she can only preserve it through sleep.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681421_1_1_1: Take a look at this. (Handing over the stone)
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681422_1_1: Where did you get this? Does Dadar know the origin of this stone?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681422_2_1: Well, he once accidentally entered a secret realm, and there were many stones like this there. He asked me to find these stones in the secret realm, and well, you can see the result.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681422_2_2: A strange secret realm with ghost-like monsters.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681422_1_3: Strange, if there`s a Half Facet nearby, I should be able to sense it. Anyway, never mind, now that we have these stones, there`s hope for Sunia`s soul revival.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681422_1_4: Just these stones alone won`t be enough. To awaken Sunia, we need to perform a ritual in the Priest Realm. However, you don`t need to bother with these details.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681422_2_4: Will Sunia become a spiritual being like you after awakening?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681422_1_5: It will be difficult to reach my state, but at least Dadar will have a chance to talk to her again. In Sunia`s current state, ordinary practitioners can`t see her; only spiritual beings like me can.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3681423_1_1: Thank you for your help. If Sunia can wake up, I`ll inform Dadar. If not... never mind, I won`t think about it! I will definitely succeed!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212401_1: I`ve discovered a particularly interesting place!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212402_1: Before answering your question, I have an academic question for you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212402_2: You should ask Dunn. He is better at academic research.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212402_3: Dunn? He`s only good at historical research, and my question is about the space and time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212403_1: Actually, I`ve discovered a new Half Facet, where the spacetime is completely different from the Positive Facet. It is constantly repeating and resetting. It`s really puzzling to me. Do you have any insights into this?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212404_1: No no no, the Half Facet resets according to the sphere of the entrant.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212404_2: Einstein`s theory of relativity explains that spacetime is curved. The distortion of spacetime in the Half Facet may be due to the attraction of the Positive Facet, or perhaps it is due to the sphere of the entrant.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212404_3: Einstein? Theory of relativity? What are you talking about? Anyway, I`ll call it the Cyclical Facet. Based on its characteristics, I have transformed it into a good trial ground.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212404_4: How about giving it a try now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3212405_1: Don`t worry. You will receive some guidance there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_11: Hi, hero! Have you received that invitation?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_21: Yes, any new information about the Enigma Half Facet?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_12: Exactly. Ever since Lady Eloise discovered Enigma Half Facet, various factions have sought to claim a piece. Twin City is no exception, and we invited you here for this matter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_22: Helping you seize Enigma Half Facet?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_13: No, no, no. We`ve already gained a lot from it, and we want to inform you of a newly found Enigma Mine with rich enigma deposits
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_14: Yes, but due to certain reasons, the extraction of Enigma Stones has come to a standstill.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_15: At first, the Enigma Mine was safe, but with ongoing extraction, concentrated magical energy attracted more monsters. Some miners were injured. Security Advisor Walter seeks increased city guard manpower to clear them, but...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_25: But what? And who is Walter?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_16: Truth is, the Twin City guards are too busy with daily affairs, getting no time for monster clearance. Walter, the Security Advisor of the Miners` Guild, was once a battlefield commander in Facet but got reassigned for catching the eye of a noble lady.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_17: We currently offer `Mine Defense`, a daily quest led by Walter to clear mine monsters, and `Mine Conquest`, a bi-weekly event for Chosen Ones.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_18: Guard Chief Luffy decided, with Lady Eloise`s approval, that participants must be vigilant.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677211_19: Well, it`s more like a trade than a quest. You assist us, and we exchange resources from the Enigma Half Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677221_11: Thank you for understanding. If you want to take the Mine Defense quest, consult Walter. If you`re interested in Mine Conquest, find me every Tuesday and Thursday from 21:00 to 22:00
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677311_11: Hello! I am Walter, the safety advisor of Enigma Mine.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677321_11: Davis told me you are interested in Enigma Mine?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_3677331_11: Great! We need heroes as passionate and strong as you! Our miners have been frequently attacked recently. Could you please enter the mine and clear out monsters there?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135073_1: War and chaos are the essence of the world.</color><color=0xff52c769> The Chosen Ones</color><color=0xfffffcee> are summoned to dispel the evil and darkness, and to prevent the tragedy from happening again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135074_1: Chosen Ones are from the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> and more gifted than local heroes. They are chosen by the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dawn Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>The Chosen One is the name given to you!</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135074_2: Well, I don`t resent that. You mentioned </color><color=0xffdf85e3>the tragedy</color><color=0xfffffcee> earlier. What was that?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135074_3: Tragedy? The tragedy I have seen is that when faced with those </color><color=0xffff0000>evil races</color><color=0xfffffcee>, we were unable to fight back, seeing our leaders killed and our homes invaded, but had no choice but to flee. Chosen One, there is a long history and a tortuous story here. To avoid repeating the tragedy, you need to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>strengthen yourself</color><color=0xfffffcee> first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135076_1: Come on, why are you saying these things to a </color><color=0xff52c769>new Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135077_1: Hi, %s. Nice to meet you. I`m </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Welcome to Conquer! I believe you will have a special journey!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135077_2: What`s going on? Why do you suddenly change?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135077_3: Never mind! Let`s get to know this world together!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135081_1: This city is called </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>. The name is said to date back to the previous era.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135082_1: Yes, </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s architectural style is very unique, with a sense of mystery hidden in its simplicity. We have to thank </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Qing</color><color=0xfffffcee> for this, who is a famous architect in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135082_3: Yes. So, the first step to getting to know </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee> is to visit this strange architect. I believe he will give you some pertinent guidance.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135091_1: Hello. You can call me the </color><color=0xff52c769>Arrogant Song Qing</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135091_3: But I can. After the Great Migration, my father and I constructed this city. After my father`s death, they all wanted me to be the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>castellan</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the city, but I have no interest in managing the city.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135092_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> asked you to come, right? She must know that I just ordered a set of equipment. So, how about you do me two favors? Once you`ve completed them, that set of equipment will be yours.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135092_2: Eloise didn`t mention any equipment. But I`m </color><color=0xffdf85e3>happy to accept</color><color=0xfffffcee> this deal.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135092_3: First, fetch me the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>shovel on the roof</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I lost it there after I repaired the roof yesterday.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135101_1: Yes, that`s it. Come down if you have it. Otherwise, I`ll have to repair the roof again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135111_1: Impressive, you jumped on the roof effortlessly. Next, I need you to kill two </color><color=0xffff0000>Pheasants</color><color=0xfffffcee> outside the city. The blacksmith`s wife is about to give birth, so she needs more nutrients.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135112_1: It`s the wild chickens outside the city. Don`t worry, chickens that crow don`t bite. If you`re afraid, you can go find </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Shiyu</color><color=0xfffffcee> first. He will guide you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135121_1: Hello. I am a </color><color=0xff52c769>City Guard</color><color=0xfffffcee> stationed here. Do you need any help?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135121_2: I want to know how to hunt </color><color=0xffff0000>Pheasants</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135121_3: It seems that you are leaving the city for the first time. I have a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Guide for Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee> here. Please take a look.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135123_1: Specifically, you can </color><color=0xffdf85e3>tap or swipe</color><color=0xfffffcee> to cast skills. The Pheasants here are not very threatening, so you can see them as tools for practice.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135141_2: Of course! But I have a question. What does the blacksmith`s wife have to do with you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135141_5: Right! You are smart and observant. Here, this is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>equipment</color><color=0xfffffcee> I promised you. It should fit you well. Try it on! And this </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dwarf Toolkit</color><color=0xfffffcee>! It`s good. You are welcome.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135161_1: Hi, %s. </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Qing</color><color=0xfffffcee> is quite nice, isn`t he?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135161_2: I suspect that he has a relationship with the blacksmith`s...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135161_3: Shh! Don`t spread gossip. As a priestess, I hope to reduce internal conflicts in Twin City.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135161_4: Alright. </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Qing</color><color=0xfffffcee> is kind. I obtained some equipment from him and it has </color><color=0xffdf85e3>improved my strength</color><color=0xfffffcee>. So, what do I need to do next?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135161_5: The vast area outside Twin City is called </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Next, let`s go to explore Wind Plain.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135161_6: What specifically should I do? I can`t just wander around forever.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135161_7: Let me think. Oh, I remember! Recently, the population of </color><color=0xffff0000>Pheasants</color><color=0xfffffcee> outside of Twin City has been growing rapidly. I heard that many people have been pecked by </color><color=0xffff0000>Pheasants</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Hunting some Pheasants regularly can make the ecological environment of </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee> healthier.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135181_1: It looks like these </color><color=0xffff0000>Pheasants</color><color=0xfffffcee> didn`t pose a challenge to you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135181_2: Well, I asked </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Shiyu</color><color=0xfffffcee> about it earlier, and he said that the monsters in the neighborhood don`t pose a threat.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135181_3: Indeed, but </color><color=0xffdf85e3>practicing skills</color><color=0xfffffcee> through them would be a good idea.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135182_1: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Class Skills</color><color=0xfffffcee>. There are different </color><color=0xffdf85e3>classes</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and the different class skills determine the role of each class. As you level up, you will continue to acquire new skills.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135183_1: The classes established by humans are divided into three </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Factions: Attack Faction, Defense Faction, and Watcher Faction</color><color=0xfffffcee>. The corresponding classes for each Faction are: Attack Faction: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Fire Taoist, Windwalker, Archer</color><color=0xfffffcee>; Defense Faction: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Trojan, Warrior, Dragon Warrior, Ninja</color><color=0xfffffcee>; Watcher Faction: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Thunderstriker, Monk, Water Taoist, Pirate.</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135201_1: Hello, Chosen One. Have you heard the story of a hunter becoming friends with his prey?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135202_1: It may sound absurd, but I do have a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Pheasant Friend</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135202_3: It was a rainy night, and I was still a young boy. I went hunting as usual and encountered a giant </color><color=0xffff0000>Mutant Pheasant</color><color=0xfffffcee> on the way. Just when I thought I was doomed, a Pheasant swooped down from the sky and drove away the </color><color=0xffff0000>Mutant Pheasant</color><color=0xfffffcee>. But in the process, it was also injured.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135202_4: We became friends since then. I gave up my job as a hunter and joined the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Twin City Guard</color><color=0xfffffcee>. It follows me every day and has even learned to speak.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135203_1: Now, its enemy is still wandering in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Land</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Could you help me eliminate it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135221_1: My friend wants to thank you personally. It`s just over there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135232_1: You humans look all the same to me, and I can`t even tell your gender. But it doesn`t matter. I </color><color=0xffdf85e3>appreciate your selfless help</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Now that our archenemy is dead, I have to take on the role as the leader of the pheasant flock.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135232_2: I thought only humans told stories, but now it seems that the world is beyond my imagination.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135232_3: I can proudly tell you that our pheasants are harmless to the Wind Plain. But </color><color=0xffff0000>Turtledoves</color><color=0xfffffcee> are different. They encroach on our territory and destroy the land on which pheasants depend for survival. So, they should be expelled! Powerful human, I have a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>request</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135232_4: This is the first time I have received a request from a Pheasant. Tell me about it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135232_5: The tyrant of the pheasant flock has died, and I want to take its place. I need enough battle credits to convince the pheasants, so the request is to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>clean up those Turtledoves</color><color=0xfffffcee>! To show those disobedient pheasants who is the real leader!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135233_1: So typical of humans, thinking about rewards before completing the request. Well, I`ll give you some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dragon Balls and Meteors</color><color=0xfffffcee>. And by the way, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>many monsters carry treasures. Defeat them and you can pick up their treasures</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138901_1: Good job! You completed the request perfectly! I like you, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>my friend</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135251_1: Hey %s, I heard you caused quite a stir in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135251_2: Yes, I helped a soldier defeat a </color><color=0xffff0000>Giant Pheasant</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and unexpectedly discovered a talking </color><color=0xff52c769>Pheasant</color><color=0xfffffcee> during the process. What a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>pheasant</color><color=0xfffffcee>-filled journey…
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135251_3: It sounds like you didn`t know P</color><color=0xffff0000>heasants</color><color=0xfffffcee> could talk?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135252_1: To be precise, some intelligent monsters can learn to speak. No need to be too surprised. The CO world has many unique races.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135253_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Elves, dwarves, giants</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and some evil intelligent races from the Negative Facet, such as </color><color=0xffff0000>Naga, werewolves, vampires</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and so on. I`m not human either. Strictly speaking, I`m a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>spirit</color><color=0xfffffcee>. This world is vast, and you will encounter more strange things in the future.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135253_2: So enlightening! </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dwarves, werewolves, vampires</color><color=0xfffffcee>... Where can these races be found?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135253_3: Dwarves are mainly distributed in</color><color=0xfffe8d2b> Ape City </color><color=0xfffffcee>within Love Canyon. As for evil races like </color><color=0xffff0000>werewolves</color><color=0xfffffcee>, most are in </color><color=0xffff0000>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> or</color><color=0xfffe8d2b> Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Your current strength isn`t sufficient to venture there yet. But there is one place you can go!
en.STR_DLGSELECT_135254_1_1: What kind of place is that?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135255_1: The world of Conquer is vast beyond measure, connecting countless </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facets</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Near the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Portal</color><color=0xfffffcee> exists a Half Facet called the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Twilight Space</color><color=0xfffffcee>. The space is filled with endless towers, divided into two regions: one dense with </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dawn Towers</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the other with </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Towers</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135255_2: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Twilight Space</color><color=0xfffffcee>... Not long ago I entered a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Phoenix Land</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Are they similar places?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135255_3: Legends say the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Twilight Space</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a massive seed vault. Before the end of the last epoch, both Positive and Negative Facets preserved biological seeds here to prevent complete civilization extinction.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135256_1: Although you haven`t yet touched the threshold of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Spheres</color><color=0xfffffcee>, training in </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dawn Towers</color><color=0xfffffcee> shouldn`t be problematic. To unlock </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Towers</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you must first reach </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Apprentices</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Work hard, Chosen One!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135257_1: You`ll understand when the time comes. At your upgrading speed, it won`t take long.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140771_1: How does it feel? When I first discovered</color><color=0xffdf85e3> Twilight Towers</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I knew it was a trial ground tailor-made for</color><color=0xff52c769> Chosen Ones</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140771_2: Although I didn`t encounter intelligent races like </color><color=0xffff0000>werewolves</color><color=0xfffffcee> or </color><color=0xffff0000>vampires</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I obtained </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Meteors</color><color=0xfffffcee> after defeating monsters there. What are Meteors used for?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140771_3: Hmm... To my knowledge, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Meteors</color><color=0xfffffcee> should be materials for </color><color=0xffdf85e3>equipment enhancement</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but I`m unclear on specifics. After all, I don`t need such things.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140772_1: By the way, you could consult </color><color=0xff52c769>Lieutenant Chen</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Among humans, he`s considered a knowledgeable and prestigious expert who might provide more detailed guidance. Next, I`m heading to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Ape City</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Hope you`ll be stronger when we meet again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140773_1: Yes, there have been abnormal activities recently in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Ape City</color><color=0xfffffcee> at</color><color=0xfffe8d2b> Love Canyon</color><color=0xfffffcee>. As </color><color=0xffdf85e3>World Priestess</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I must investigate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135261_1: So you`re the </color><color=0xff52c769>Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee>? You don`t seem very strong!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135261_2: Your </color><color=0xffdf85e3>right hand</color><color=0xfffffcee> is quite peculiar. Are you not human either?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135261_3: Of course, I am human. As for my </color><color=0xffdf85e3>right hand</color><color=0xfffffcee>, it is a gift I received on the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I tore apart a flame demon and my right hand was </color><color=0xffdf85e3>cursed by its blood</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Thanks to the timely treatment from the elves, it just mutated.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135262_1: Those things are still very far away for you. So, what brings you to me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135262_2: I want to know the uses of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Meteors and Dragon Balls</color><color=0xfffffcee>. </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> said I can get answers from you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135262_3: Ah, </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> introduced you to me. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Meteors</color><color=0xfffffcee> are treasures from beyond the sky. They contain materials that can refine equipment. I used to work at a Meteor mine and heard this from the technicians. I have some Meteors that I don`t need for now, so I`ll give them to you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135263_1: No, I don`t have any spare Dragon Balls here. You can ask </color><color=0xff52c769>Blacksmith Li Kui</color><color=0xfffffcee>. He might give you some for the sake of Eloise.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135263_2: I didn`t mean that... Anyway, thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135291_1: Hey, aren`t you the Chosen One? I received the Pheasant that </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Qing</color><color=0xfffffcee> sent me not long ago. Thank you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135292_1: Do you want to buy some weapons? You can find my brother. Our </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Li`s Smithy</color><color=0xfffffcee> values reputation the most, so feel free to make your purchases!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135292_2: No, no, I want to inquire about the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dragon Balls</color><color=0xfffffcee>. </color><color=0xff52c769>Lieutenant Chen</color><color=0xfffffcee> at the city gate recommended you to me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135292_3: I see. </color><color=0xff52c769>Lieutenant Chen</color><color=0xfffffcee> has good character, so I trust him. But we also don`t want to do business at a loss. If you can help me obtain some materials from </color><color=0xffff0000>Robins</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I will definitely assist you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135293_1: Yes, they inhabit the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>southwest of Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee>. The beaks and claws of </color><color=0xffff0000>Robins</color><color=0xfffffcee> are auxiliary materials for forging weapons. My brother and I are skilled in blacksmithing, but not so much in hunting monsters.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135311_1: Hello, Chosen One. Did you get the materials?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135312_1: Good! You have shown me your sincerity, so I will fulfill my promise. For you, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dragon Balls</color><color=0xfffffcee> are just materials for enhancing the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>quality of weapons and equipment</color><color=0xfffffcee>. But as a blacksmith, I see them as magical treasures that can turn decay into wonders!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135312_2: To explain how magical they truly are, you need to understand the classification of weapons and equipment: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Normal, Refined, Unique, Elite, and Super</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Just imagine, an ordinary blacksmith can only forge refined equipment throughout his lifetime. Even </color><color=0xff52c769>dwarf blacksmiths</color><color=0xfffffcee> in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Ape City</color><color=0xfffffcee> can only achieve Elite.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135313_1: Although our relationship with the dwarves is not that good, as a blacksmith, I have to acknowledge their forging skills. The discovery of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dragon Balls</color><color=0xfffffcee> has greatly improved our forging skills. Before this, only the Supreme Blacksmith could forge Super equipment. But now, even an ordinary blacksmith can do it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135313_2: I see. Do you know where the Dragon Balls come from?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135313_3: Not really, but there are rumors that </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dragon Balls come from the depths of the earth</color><color=0xfffffcee> and contain the essence of dragons. But I think it`s all a bunch of nonsense. I`ve never seen what a dragon looks like in all my years. Anyway, I happen to have a few Dragon Balls here. You can have them as the reward for getting me the materials from </color><color=0xffff0000>Robins</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135331_1: Respectable Chosen One, I have a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>request</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Please don`t turn me down.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135332_1: I am Blacksmith Li Gui, </color><color=0xff52c769>Li Kui</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s younger brother. I hope you can help me obtain some materials from </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Robins</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135332_2: I just delivered some Robin materials to your brother.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135332_3: We are different. I admit that he is exceptional, but I am not inferior in every aspect! Why did my sister-in-law choose him in the end? Why was he appointed as the heir to the Li Blacksmith shop? </color><color=0xffdf85e3>I must prove that I am stronger than him!</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135332_4: (So dramatic) So, how can I help you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135332_5: I need the beak and claws of the </color><color=0xffff0000>Robin King</color><color=0xfffffcee>. With them, I am confident that I can surpass him in the upcoming Blacksmith Competition! In return, I will give you my precious </color><color=0xffdf85e3>+Stones</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135333_1: Yes, I`m sure you will be satisfied.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135351_1: Respected Chosen One, do you have the materials?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135352_1: Thank you. I now have enough confidence to obtain the title of Advanced Blacksmith! I will give you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>+Stones</color><color=0xfffffcee> as the reward.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135352_3: Don`t you know? The +Stone is a precious item for </color><color=0xffdf85e3>refining weapons and equipment</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Its effect is slightly inferior to Meteors and Dragon Balls, but as we know, there are limits to the level and grade of weapons and equipment, while the +Stone has almost </color><color=0xffdf85e3>no limits</color><color=0xfffffcee> for additional perfection.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135353_1: Yes, almost none. That`s why it is considered a treasure.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135353_2: Do you know the origin of the +Stone?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135353_3: Of course, it`s common knowledge for all blacksmiths. The +Stone was created in an experimental accident. It is rumored that </color><color=0xff52c769>Dwarf Blacksmith Torr</color><color=0xfffffcee> wanted to create a gem with extremely high hardness. During the alchemical process, the experimental furnace exploded, resulting in the +Stone.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135353_4: </color><color=0xff52c769>Torr</color><color=0xfffffcee> was injured in the accident, but after that, he switched from being a blacksmith to a gemsmith, and he developed a higher purity +Stone. I have some regular +Stones here as a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>reward</color><color=0xfffffcee> for helping me. Please take them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135381_1: Compared to ordinary heroes, the Chosen One is indeed extraordinary, with rapid progress in strength.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_135381_1_1: Thank you, and who are you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135382_1: I am LuFu, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Guard Chief</color><color=0xfffffcee>. </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Qing</color><color=0xfffffcee> has mentioned you to me, saying that you are a reliable person.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135382_2: So, what brings you to me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135382_3: After the Great Migration, humans chose </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> as their bases. In all these years, there has been no large-scale war in Wind Plain. Two years ago, one of my </color><color=0xffdf85e3>guard officers</color><color=0xfffffcee> led a team to go out for inspection and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>has not returned since</color><color=0xfffffcee>. As the Guard Chief, I am still investigating it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135382_4: A large number of </color><color=0xffff0000>ghost soldiers</color><color=0xfffffcee> have emerged in the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>northwest of Wind Plain recently</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and I suspect it is related to the missing guard officer. Please help me figure out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135391_1: This change in the landscape is very strange.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135401_1: There are two opposing auras on the ground, one sacred and one evil.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135411_1: Fresh blood stains, pointing to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>northwest</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135421_1: Who are you? Did those </color><color=0xffff0000>hypocritical monks</color><color=0xfffffcee> send you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135421_2: </color><color=0xff52c769>LuFu</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the Guard Chief of Twin City, requested me to investigate. Is that blood stain yours? And what do you mean by </color><color=0xffff0000>hypocritical monks</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135422_1: A few years ago, the lush western part of Wind Plain turned into scorched earth overnight. </color><color=0xff52c769>Officer</color><color=0xfffffcee> led us here for inspection. When I arrived, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>everyone had disappeared without a trace</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135422_2: I went to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Desert</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but returned empty-handed. It wasn`t until I met </color><color=0xff52c769>Black Priest</color><color=0xfffffcee> in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Love Canyon</color><color=0xfffffcee>, who taught me </color><color=0xffdf85e3>a ritual to summon ghosts</color><color=0xfffffcee>.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135451_1: Amitabha, you have great skills. Will you help us eliminate the </color><color=0xffff0000>lonely ghosts and spirits</color><color=0xfffffcee> in this place? They should have found peace, but they were summoned by that ignorant veteran and now cause trouble in this area.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135484_1: Although your strength is not as good as a knight, it`s better to have a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>mount</color><color=0xfffffcee> when going out. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135491_1: Amitabha, hallelujah! Today, I`m drunk with wine. Selling horses to get money for more wine.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135492_1: Hmm? You look as poor as a beggar. Even if you have money to buy a </color><color=0xff52c769>horse</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I`m afraid you won`t be able to afford to take care of it. Go away. Don`t disturb me.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135501_4: Your reaction tells me the opposite. Give me a bottle of wine, otherwise, I`ll tell </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> that you`re drinking and slacking off!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135531_1: Thank you for helping me out. Am I safe now?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135531_3: I met a romantic </color><color=0xff52c769>bard</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Maple Forest, who asked me to come to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>east of Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee> to meet him, but he left me behind when he saw the </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135532_1: Yes! And I only found out after coming here that he`s a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>drunkard</color><color=0xfffffcee>! Thanks to you, otherwise, I wouldn`t have been able to go back to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135532_2: Go home. There are many </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> here, and I have other things to attend to, so I can`t protect you closely.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135532_3: Thank you for your help! If you have time, you can come to Maple Forest`s </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and I`ll thank you properly then!
en.STR_DLGSELECT_135532_3_1: Alright, take care on the road.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135533_1: Oh, right. Keep this </color><color=0xffdf85e3>letter</color><color=0xfffffcee>. If you really come to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee> in the future, it may be helpful to you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135541_1: Hey! You look somewhat familiar. Have we met before?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135542_1: Oh! I remember now. Are all the </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> dead?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135542_2: Yes, I saved a girl named </color><color=0xff52c769>Mary</color><color=0xfffffcee>, who you should be familiar with.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135542_3: What a nuisance! I used to dream of being a hero who saves the beauty, but I`m just a horse merchant who knows how to sing and write poetry. How is </color><color=0xff52c769>Mary</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135543_1: Well, well. Now it`s my turn to fulfill my promise. I`ll give you a good </color><color=0xffdf85e3>horse</color><color=0xfffffcee> and a set of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>saddle</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135543_2: Don`t worry, can you tell me anything about </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>? Mary said you guys met there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135543_3: </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>, that place was originally the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>domain of elves</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but now it`s full of humans and bandits. The elves can`t stand it, so they opened up a </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>secret zone</color><color=0xfffffcee> and live there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135543_4: </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the entrance to the secret place. I originally went to Maple Forest to see the elves, hoping to inspire my creativity. As you can guess, I didn`t meet any elves, but I met </color><color=0xff52c769>Mary</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135551_1: Chosen One, it`s gratifying to see you grow so quickly. I am entrusted by </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> to challenge you. Do you dare to accept?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135552_1: Eloise is currently deep in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Ape City</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but she sent a letter back, saying that there is a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>facet fluctuation</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Love Canyon, which is not a good sign. Danger may be approaching, so she hopes that you will have the strength to protect yourself in the future, and I will test your strength during this time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135552_2: So this is a trial, not a challenge?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135552_3: No, I`m just an old soldier. I`m actually not qualified to test your strength. This is just a challenge. If you can beat me, it means you should </color><color=0xffdf85e3>go to other areas to explore</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee> is too comfortable, which is not good for your growth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138831_1: Thank you! As a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>veteran</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I`ve had nightmares every night since I retired. Now the nightmares are gone.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138832_1: You are now strong enough to go out and explore. Go to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>. There will be more interesting things there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139221_1: I heard that you are going to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>, Chosen One?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139222_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Lieutenant Chen</color><color=0xfffffcee> is my master. He told me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139222_2: I want to ask you to do something, if you don`t mind.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139223_1: My father, </color><color=0xff52c769>Song Qinghong</color><color=0xfffffcee>, is the Chief Guard of Phoenix Castle. I want to ask you to visit him for me. We haven`t seen each other for two years...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139223_2: Why don`t you go find him?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139223_3: My father is stubborn. When I tried to join the city guards of </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee>, he insisted that I should be a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>hunter</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I know he didn`t want me to be in danger, but no one can live a leisurely life forever in this era. So, I became a guard in Twin City under the recommendation of </color><color=0xff52c769>Lieutenant Chen</color><color=0xfffffcee>, my master.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139224_1: Later, my father learned about this. And then, our relationship completely broke down. Chosen One, I just hope that you can </color><color=0xffdf85e3>help him</color><color=0xfffffcee> within your reach. And please don`t mention me in front of him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139225_1: Thank you. There is a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>portal</color><color=0xfffffcee> in the southeast corner of </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee>. You can go to Maple Forest from there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135571_2: Mary, it`s nice to see you again. That </color><color=0xff52c769>Drunken Horse Merchant</color><color=0xfffffcee>...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135571_3: Please don`t mention him anymore. Let`s go. My </color><color=0xff52c769>father</color><color=0xfffffcee> has known about my experiences, so he wants to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>thank you</color><color=0xfffffcee> in person.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135572_1: My father is a great man. Everyone here respects him and calls him </color><color=0xff52c769>Million John</color><color=0xfffffcee> (whispering). He is the president of the gemstone association on the surface, but in fact, he commands a large number of bandits.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135572_2: That`s why you were so calm when you encountered the bandits. I see.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135572_3: Compared to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the bandits in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee> are like tame rabbits. Let`s go find </color><color=0xff52c769>John</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135581_1: You are the Chosen One mentioned by </color><color=0xff52c769>Mary</color><color=0xfffffcee>? Do you have something to prove your identity? Like a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>letter</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140412_1: No offense. For you, these verification processes may not be necessary, but the </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee> are good at disguises. Everyone who lives here needs to be cautious.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140413_1: To be straightforward, you saved my daughter, so I`ll give you some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>treasures</color><color=0xfffffcee> as a gift. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Do you accept</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140414_1: Hahaha, you`re straightforward! But if you accept so easily, our relationship will end here. I really appreciate you, so what do you think?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140414_2: I understand, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>treasures</color><color=0xfffffcee> you mentioned are just a gift. But if we want to be friends, we must have some form of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>mutual benefits</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Is that what you mean?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140414_3: Smart! I am the president of the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee> Gemstone Association, so I`ll give you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>a Star Drill and a Super Dragon Gem</color><color=0xfffffcee> as the gift! Don`t look down on them, they are treasures for high-level heroes.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135611_1: How about it? Are you satisfied with my gift?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135612_1: What do you think? Do you want to discuss the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>transaction</color><color=0xfffffcee>, or are you not interested?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135612_2: What do you need me to do?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135612_3: </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee> is currently filled with </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and it`s difficult to deal with them directly. So I secretly supported </color><color=0xff52c769>a new force of bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee>, hoping to solve this problem through internal strife.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135612_4: However, the bandit world has always been chaotic, and every faction has a problem where the position of the leader often changes. This leads to short-lived restrictions and treaties reached through negotiations. I have a list of </color><color=0xffff0000>ambitious bandit leaders</color><color=0xfffffcee> here, and I hope you can help me deal with them in the future.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135612_5: Isn`t chaos good? You want the existing leaders to solidify their positions and form warlords? This way, it will be even more difficult to solve the problem.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135612_6: No, no, trust me. </color><color=0xff52c769>Bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> with rules are much better than those </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> who act based on their preferences without any restrictions.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135613_1: Before giving you the list, I hope you can prove your strength through an </color><color=0xffdf85e3>anti-bandit action</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I don`t want to harm the person who saved my daughter, after all. The bandits in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee> are not the same as those in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135631_1: You didn`t disappoint me, Chosen One.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135631_2: Can we continue the transaction now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135631_3: Now I am more and more interested in you. Before executing this list, I want to introduce a </color><color=0xff52c769>friend</color><color=0xfffffcee> to you. She is known as the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>peace envoy between humans and elves</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and I believe you will be interested.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135641_1: Hello, </color><color=0xff52c769>Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I`ve heard of your heroic deeds, but there`s something I don`t understand.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135642_1: Since people only live for a few decades, why should we fill our lives with </color><color=0xffdf85e3>war and strife</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135642_2: Sometimes, the environment affects our life.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135642_3: No, look at me. I live in a place overrun by </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but I`m still happy and carefree?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135642_4: How do you make a living?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135642_5: I`m a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>diplomat</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>dancer</color><color=0xfffffcee>. You see, everyone can have multiple identities. Why can`t you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135643_1: For example, you can start a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>sub-class</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and I can teach you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>dancing</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Are you interested?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135644_1: Hahaha! So cute. Don`t hesitate. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Life is like a game</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and its pace and rhythm need to be controlled by yourself.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135661_1: How are you feeling now? </color><color=0xff52c769>Lisa</color><color=0xfffffcee> knows how to live, and she`s different from me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135661_2: Thank you, I do feel more relaxed. You specially arranged this meeting. Does that mean the next quest is going to be difficult?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135661_3: Don`t worry, all challenges are opportunities. Those </color><color=0xffff0000>careerists</color><color=0xfffffcee> are just senior </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139421_1: Before heading out to eliminate the bandits, you may want to strengthen your equipment first. Then proceed to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Deathtrap</color><color=0xfffffcee> for some training.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135681_1: Hello, Chosen One. Please allow me to express my apologies for the security issues in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135681_2: Why are there so many bandits here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135681_3: In strict terms, </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the territory of </color><color=0xff52c769>elves</color><color=0xfffffcee>. In the past, the elves governed this place well. It has fertile land and dense forests. Elves love peace, even if there are some </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee>, they did not expel them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135681_4: But you know, idleness and greed are human nature. Many </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> who could not survive in their original territory began to ravage this land, taking advantage of elves` kindness. The </color><color=0xff52c769>elves</color><color=0xfffffcee> once carried out a large-scale expelling action, but the bloodshed polluted the forest and rivers, which made the elves unwilling to continue expelling and killing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135682_1: After that, </color><color=0xff52c769>elves</color><color=0xfffffcee> moved away and returned to their </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>secret zone</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Eloise ordered us to guard </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee> in order to avoid the bandits entering the secret zone. Alas, it`s really sad.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135682_2: What do these bandits want? Is there really something valuable here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135682_3: Perhaps there were some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>treasures</color><color=0xfffffcee> in the early years, but now, except for the medicinal value of the </color><color=0xffff0000>Winged Snake</color><color=0xfffffcee>, only the fur of the </color><color=0xffff0000>Ratling</color><color=0xfffffcee> attracts them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135682_4: Thank you for your sharing. Is there anything I can do for you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135682_5: If possible, I hope you can help us collect some materials from </color><color=0xffff0000>Winged Snakes and Ratlings</color><color=0xfffffcee>, which can be exchanged for money to strengthen </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s armed forces.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135711_1: Did you encounter any danger, Chosen One?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135712_1: Thank you for your contribution. </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> has arrived at </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Phoenix Castle</color><color=0xfffffcee> and wants to see you.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135933_1: That is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Portal</color><color=0xfffffcee>, a portal connects the Positive and Negative Facets. The evil races of the </color><color=0xffff0000>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> invade through that portal.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135935_1: We are different. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135941_1: %s, is there anything I can help you with?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135942_1: I want to know who is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>figure</color><color=0xfffffcee> at the center of the mural?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135942_3: Chosen One, you don`t need to know these secrets at present.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135943_1: Sometimes, knowledge is also a curse, and strength is the key to breaking the curse.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135951_4: Yes, and she also speaks strangely.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135951_5: I suddenly feel that giving you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Marco`s Travels</color><color=0xfffffcee> like that before was not well thought out. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135951_6: Yes! Defeat an enemy at the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Squires</color><color=0xfffffcee> to wrap up your journey in the Sphere of Apprentices.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135952_5: I think we should change the topic. Oh, right, let me talk about the divisions of Spheres.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135952_6: There are </color><color=0xffdf85e3>divisions</color><color=0xfffffcee> between each sphere. Since the higher the sphere, the harder it is to break through. Solidifying each division can make your goals more clear.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135952_7: That`s enough for now. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135954_1: Clearing out the bandits is perhaps a bit easy for you. How about this, hunting down a hundred thousand </color><color=0xffff0000>Pheasants</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135955_3: Okay. I heard that there are heroes from </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Squires</color><color=0xfffffcee> among those bandits. Be careful.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135971_1: Have you driven away the bandits?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135971_3: Well, it`s actually quite normal to fail. After all, the opponents are heroes from a higher sphere.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135971_4: Besides the pressure from </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, there is another reason for sending you on this adventure.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135972_1: I mentioned before that there is </color><color=0xffdf85e3>a gap between spheres</color><color=0xfffffcee>. In your future adventures, try to avoid conflicts with strong opponents from higher spheres.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135972_2: Aren`t you afraid that I`ll end up in their hands?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135972_3: Do you remember </color><color=0xff52c769>Canary</color><color=0xfffffcee>? The leader of the bandits was her brother.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135972_4: It seems that this was a planned experience.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135972_5: Well, no matter what, you have shown courage by taking risks. You can take a look at the book </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Marco`s Travels</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and maybe you can understand the true meaning of bravery.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135972_6: Go on. Come find me when you are about to break through the sphere next time. The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>deal</color><color=0xfffffcee> continues.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139561_1: Although the gap in strength between the Spheres is not easy to overcome, I foresee that </color><color=0xffdf85e3>the era of change is imminent</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and Chosen Ones will stand out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135981_1: Respected Chosen One, you can call me </color><color=0xff52c769>Solon Wingley</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I come with the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>instruction</color><color=0xfffffcee> of Lord Eloise.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135982_1: Yes, your level has exceeded </color><color=0xffdf85e3>130</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and you need to undergo </color><color=0xffdf85e3>rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee>. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135982_3: Local heroes generally do not need to undergo rebirth. Lord Eloise said, the Chosen One was the hope for repairing the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee>, so rebirth was a two-way feedback between the Chosen One and Universe Core.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135983_1: In a nutshell, you can see it as the rule of this world. Repairing the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the long-cherished wish of </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and the rebirth of the Chosen One benefits everyone, including yourself. As for the principles and details, I think you will know in the future.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135983_2: Okay, what exactly do I need to do? Do I just stand here to complete the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135983_3: This is your first rebirth, and the procedures are not very complicated. In summary, there are </color><color=0xffdf85e3>two steps</color><color=0xfffffcee>. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>The first</color><color=0xfffffcee> is to resonate with </color><color=0xffdf85e3>seven gems</color><color=0xfffffcee> scattered around the world. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>The Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> power within the gems can assist you in communicating with the altar in Priest Realm.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135983_4: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>The second step</color><color=0xfffffcee> is to kill </color><color=0xffff0000>a Low-level Demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> as a sacrifice for the ritual.  After completing these two steps, you can go to the Priest Realm to complete the ritual.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135983_6: The completion of the ritual means that you have established a connection with the world. But rebirth is related to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lineage and class</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_135984_1: You will know when the time comes. I suggest that you complete the first step. Should I teleport you to the nearest gem?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136001_1: Successfully resonated with the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Fury Gem</color><color=0xfffffcee> and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> inside will lead you to the next gem.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136011_1: Successfully resonated with the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Moon Gem</color><color=0xfffffcee> and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> inside will lead you to the next gem.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136021_1: Successfully resonated with the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Phoenix Gem</color><color=0xfffffcee> and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> inside will lead you to the next gem.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136051_1: Successfully resonated with the seven gems. Now you can communicate with the altar.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136061_1: Dear Chosen One, I`m glad you completed the resonance so quickly. Next, all you need to do is to kill a </color><color=0xffff0000>demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> to complete all the preparations for the ritual.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136091_1: Dear Chosen One, thank you very much for your efforts and cooperation. Next, I will send you to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee> to complete the final step of rebirth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136092_1: Yes, I believe Dunn has introduced the Priest Realm to you. Only there can the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>ritual be arranged</color><color=0xfffffcee> for the rebirth. You can set off when you are ready! Looking forward to meeting again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139361_1: Chosen One, you have completed all the rituals required for the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>first rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Now you just need to unlock your </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lineage</color><color=0xfffffcee> to truly complete the rebirth.

I will tell you after you complete the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lineage inheritance</color><color=0xfffffcee> and the first rebirth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139362_1: Yes. Next you need to go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City Market</color><color=0xfffffcee> and find a young man named </color><color=0xff52c769>Wingley Dain</color><color=0xfffffcee>. He will tell you how to inherit the lineage.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139371_1: Chosen One! Congratulations on completing the 1st rebirth! From now on, you are truly a part of the world!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139372_1: Every time the Chosen One undergoes a rebirth, it helps to repair the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Before this, some people simply saw you as a visitor from another world, but from this moment on, they will accept you more.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139372_2: I see. By the way, you mentioned earlier that the relationship between </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lineage and rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee> is related to the secrets of the Wingley family and the blood-stained history of the human race in the Dark Era. What is that about?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139373_1: Let`s start with the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>. In that hopeless era, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>ten legendary figures</color><color=0xfffffcee> rose among the human race. The souls of the legends turned into </color><color=0xffdf85e3>spirits</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and their bodies turned into </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lineages</color><color=0xfffffcee>! en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139375_1: Later, the </color><color=0xffff0000>Dark Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> did not stop its invasion, and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> became even more fragile. </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> came up with a way to repair the Universe Core...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139376_1: Yes! When the Chosen One inherits the lineage, they need to keep their strength pure. So before that, you need to resonate with </color><color=0xffdf85e3>the source of gems</color><color=0xfffffcee> and communicate with the altar in the realm. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139376_2: I see. What about the secrets of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Wingley family</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_139376_3: Well, the ancestors of the Wingley family were </color><color=0xffff0000>criminals</color><color=0xfffffcee>. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138701_1: I, </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn Burg</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>historian</color><color=0xfffffcee> respected by Lord Eloise and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>collector</color><color=0xfffffcee> who formed a contract with the Chosen One, was recently stolen. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136112_5: Alright, no more jokes. If it was just money, it would be fine, but what was lost this time is very </color><color=0xffdf85e3>important</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Please help me find it.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136121_1: I saw the notice you posted.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136122_1: Any questions? I believe anyone who sees the notice would feel angry!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136122_2: Anyway, what did you lose? </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> said it was something very important.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136124_2: Do you have any clues? Or maybe, does the book have any mysterious marks that can be tracked?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136124_6: Alright then. As a detective, I need to ask you some questions.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_136124_7_1: Did you ask the City Guard?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136126_1: No, according to my 28 years of life experience in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the </color><color=0xff52c769>City Guard</color><color=0xfffffcee> is not as useful as private mercenaries.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136126_2: You`re only </color><color=0xffdf85e3>28 years old</color><color=0xfffffcee>? You don`t look like that.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136126_3: I just have the look of a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>scholar</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Any other questions?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136127_1: It was last night, under the moonlight.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_136127_1_1: Got a list of lost items?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136128_1: The treasures and valuables in the treasure room were not stolen. The thief only took the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Bordeaux Biography</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136128_2: Alright, that`s all for now. It seems that I have to ask the </color><color=0xff52c769>City Guard</color><color=0xfffffcee> first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136131_1: I heard that </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s house was robbed?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136131_4: I dare not say, Chosen One.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136132_1: World Priestess </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> attaches great importance to this theft. If you conceal something, you can imagine the consequences.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136132_3: Actually, this morning we saw that notice. Just as we were about to start the investigation, Guard Officer </color><color=0xff52c769>Davis</color><color=0xfffffcee> stopped us. He claimed that a group of </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> had appeared on the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>west side of Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and he needed us to be prepared for a large-scale operation against them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136132_4: After saying that, Davis left the city. At first, we didn`t think it was strange, until a colleague asked </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> and found out that the lost book is called </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Bordeaux Biography</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136135_1: We all know that the Guard Officer`s full name is </color><color=0xff52c769>Davis Bordeaux</color><color=0xfffffcee>, so now everyone is confused, wondering if this is a coincidence or if Davis embezzled the book himself.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136135_3: He`s in the forest on the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>west side of Wind Plain</color><color=0xfffffcee>. He said he went to gather information about the enemy and hasn`t returned yet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136191_1: Chosen One! Why are you here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136191_2: Enough beating around the bush. Tell me why you colluded with the </color><color=0xffff0000>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136191_3: Colluded with the bandits? I think there`s a misunderstanding.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136191_4: These </color><color=0xff52c769>bandits</color><color=0xfffffcee> were organized by me specifically to train the City Guard.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136192_1: It`s true, we`ve never robbed the poor. We mainly target </color><color=0xffdf85e3>wealthy merchants</color><color=0xfffffcee>. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136192_2: You`re really wasting your talent as the Guard Officer. Anyway, I just want that </color><color=0xffdf85e3>biography</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136192_3: No, I can negotiate on other terms, but I cannot give you that </color><color=0xffdf85e3>biography</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136192_4: Do you think you have the qualifications to negotiate?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136193_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Bazan Bordeaux</color><color=0xfffffcee> is my ancestor, and he is also the author of this biography. Since the beginning of the biography, each generation of clan leaders has continued to write it, so it not only contains the secrets of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but also the rise and fall of the Bordeaux family. Unfortunately, the biography was lost during the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Great Migration</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136193_2: As the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>eighth generation clan leader</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the family, preserving the traditions of the family is more important than life itself. So when I heard that the book was in </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s hands, I had to take a risk!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136201_2: The </color><color=0xff52c769>City Guard</color><color=0xfffffcee> notified me to come here, saying that there are clues about the biography here.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136233_8: Chosen One, what do you think?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136234_1: Just tell me, who do you support!?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136235_1: Stupid! Countless history books were lost during the Great Migration. </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> just knows about the unofficial history! How can you support him!?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136235_2: I know nothing about the history. I suggest you find someone who really knows it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136235_3: </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>? That`s right! She has lived for </color><color=0xffdf85e3>thousands of years</color><color=0xfffffcee> and she is a...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136236_1: Ridiculous! </color><color=0xffff0000>Davis</color><color=0xfffffcee> is simply a guard, thinking he knows the whole history just by reading a few pages of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Bordeaux Biography</color><color=0xfffffcee>. And you support him!?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136236_2: I know nothing about the history. I suggest you find someone who really knows it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136236_3: </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>? That`s right! She has lived for </color><color=0xffdf85e3>thousands of years</color><color=0xfffffcee> and she is a...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136237_1: I mean, </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> is graceful and captivating, innocent yet experienced.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136237_2: I heard that Lord Eloise once read a book called the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>, which contains the true history!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136237_3: Alright, I will go find Eloise.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136251_2: Oh, I see. I`m here to ask you some history-related questions. What are you doing here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136251_3: I see. Lately, I`ve been sensing faint energy of the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> in many </color><color=0xffff0000>Half Facets</color><color=0xfffffcee>. So, I came to investigate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136252_1: Yes, the world is composed of three facets: the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Positive Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, where Twin City is located; the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the stronghold of the evil creatures that invade us; and numerous </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facets</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136252_2: Are the Facet Portals the connections between Positive and Negative Facets?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136252_3: Yes! But besides the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Portals</color><color=0xfffffcee>, there are other channels between the two facets.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136253_1: Yes! It`s similar to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> we`re currently in. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136253_2: After I explain all this, can you help me clear out these </color><color=0xffff0000>monsters</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136261_1: Alright. What historical questions do you want to ask?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136261_2: </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xff52c769>Davis</color><color=0xfffffcee> have been arguing about who was the founder of the class system. They mentioned that you had read the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> and knew the true history recorded in it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136262_1: The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> is not a historical book. Nowadays, there are eleven legends who are considered the pioneers of the ten classes. In order, they are </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Trojan</color><color=0xff52c769> Hector</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Taoist</color><color=0xff52c769> Guiguzi</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Windwalker</color><color=0xff52c769> Dedi</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Monk</color><color=0xff52c769> Dharma</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Warrior</color><color=0xff52c769> Leonida</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Archer</color><color=0xff52c769> Atalante</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Thunderstriker</color><color=0xff52c769> Lancelot</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Ninja</color><color=0xff52c769> Hattori Hanzo</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Pirate</color><color=0xff52c769> Magellan</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dragon Warrior</color><color=0xff52c769> Bruce Lee</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136262_2: As for who is the founder of the class system, none of the ten legends are worthy. Without me, they could not have taken the path they did.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136262_3: However, they did achieve remarkable accomplishments, and their strength has reached the legendary level.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136262_6: Are all ten legends still alive?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136262_9: Go on, focus on your cultivation. Tell </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> that if he has too much free time, he should go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee> to teach.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136271_1: Chosen One, have you found </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136271_10: It seems that we were all wrong, and I was terribly wrong.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136271_11: It seems like I need to travel to revise the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Bordeaux Biography</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136271_12: Actually, you don`t need that biography anymore. What you need to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>protect</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the glory of your family, not any biography!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136271_13: Maybe you`re right. Thank you. I will ask for leave.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136271_14: Chosen One, it`s time for you to leave. Thank you for your help in this matter. Come find me when you`re about to break through again. Our deal will continue!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136281_1: Chosen One, you`re improving your strength at such an alarming rate! It hasn`t been that long since your last breakthrough, has it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136282_1: How moderate you are! By the way, there`s news from </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>. They claim to have found clues about the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136283_2: The leaders of </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> have detected the presence of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> in the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>. And finally, are you trying to send me on another mission?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136283_4: Calm down. Let me tell you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136283_5: First, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a highly regarded book from the Primeval Facet. When I worked with </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, she vaguely mentioned that the book, in a way, rewrites the history of the Positive Facet. The Primeval Threat Theory has been prevalent in Bird Island for several centuries, and they even put the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> at the top of the elimination list.
