en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136286_3: It is said that the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Great Catastrophe</color><color=0xfffffcee> was caused by the people of Primeval Facet two thousand years ago.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136286_5: What? When you get to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you must never say such things.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136287_1: I am different. I have been brainwashed by Lord Eloise.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136288_1: Well, we have to entrust you to investigate in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>, which is part of the...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136288_2: The deal. I see. Thank you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136288_3: I will give you some clues. If there is no result, it doesn`t matter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136291_1: This clue is not reliable. The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dryad</color><color=0xfffffcee> does not have the smell of Primeval Facet...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136301_1: Place the organs of the Pheasant on the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>altar</color><color=0xfffffcee>... It seems that this clue is also not valid...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136311_1: Say `</color><color=0xffdf85e3>abracadabra</color><color=0xfffffcee>` in front of the strange ore in Maple Forest... What is this? It doesn`t work at all...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136313_1: Despicable </color><color=0xffff0000>human thief</color><color=0xfffffcee>, why aren`t you running?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136314_1: Dare to sneak into the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Secret Zone</color><color=0xfffffcee> to steal, but dare not admit it? Today, I will teach you a lesson, you human vermin!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136331_1: If it weren`t for being ambushed and injured earlier...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136331_2: I`ve said it. I`m not a thief! You`ve mistaken me for someone else.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_2: Well, they all call me `Chosen One` in Twin City.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_3: Well, you are different. So you are the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee> mentioned by </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_5: Sorry, I was too rude just now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_6: It`s alright. I came to Maple Forest mainly to investigate the clues of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Do you know anything about this?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_7: As an elf, I am very familiar with every tree and plant in Maple Forest. There has never been any trace of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_8: It seems that the news is indeed a rumor. By the way, who was the thief you mentioned earlier?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_9: Many humans come to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee> under the pretext of exploration, but actually steal treasures. Perhaps it`s because the elves like peace that they dare to act so recklessly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_10: Even though you are the Chosen One, I still have to warn you not to destroy this forest. I have to go and chase that </color><color=0xffff0000>thief</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Maybe we`ll meet again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_11: In your current state, it`s not suitable to continue chasing. Moreover, it`s impossible to locate the target after the delay.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136332_13: I have to return since there is not any trace of the Forbidden Book in the Maple Forest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136341_1: Did you have any difficulty in Maple Forest?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136341_3: Well, I heard from a friend. A </color><color=0xffdf85e3>knight</color><color=0xfffffcee> from Bird Island recently returned from Maple Forest. It seems that they successfully snuck into the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Secret Zone</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the elves and investigated, but found nothing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136342_1: Let`s go to Bird Island. Since the news came from there, they must know something. We will meet up there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136361_1: Chosen One, thank goodness you came in time. If it weren`t for </color><color=0xff00b050>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s </color><color=0xffc879d1>shield</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I might have already been sent to meet my deceased parents by my old friend.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136362_1: We can talk about that later. How is </color><color=0xff52c769>Wendt</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136362_2: He should be fine. After all, he comes from </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Paladins</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I didn`t expect that your old friend was planning to kill you while practicing your </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Spheres</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136362_3: If I hadn`t been injured when fighting against the </color><color=0xffff0000>elves</color><color=0xfffffcee>, how could I have lost to an </color><color=0xffff0000>outsider</color><color=0xfffffcee> from the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Squires</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136362_4: </color><color=0xffff0000>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>, have you forgotten how your parents died? You still help these criminals from the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136362_5: Of course I remember, but being stuck in the past will only hold me back.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136362_6: Chosen One, can you help me gather some herbs? I need to make a potion for him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136364_1: I refuse, your friend clearly has ill intentions. Saving the enemy is harming yourself.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136364_3: I hope you won`t regret it. What kind of herbs do you need?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136364_4: I need some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Cloak Herb Powder</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Agrimony Powder</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>clean water</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136371_1: Cloak Herb, ground into powder, used for stopping bleeding...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136381_1: Agrimony, ground into powder, used for replenishing vitality...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136391_1: Clean water, used for making solvents...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136411_1: I presume you already know, </color><color=0xff52c769>Wendt</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the paladin who snuck into the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Secret Zone</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136412_1: Well, the title of knight is rare in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> still preserves the hierarchical system of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, so a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>knight</color><color=0xfffffcee> can also be considered an aristocrat.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136412_2: Paladins are supposed to be symbols of justice and fairness. How could they willingly turn into thieves?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136412_3: Our factions are different. From my point of view, for the sake of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Yagakbu</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s principles, destroying the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> regardless of means is just.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_1: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Yagakbu</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a force established by </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s upper echelons. Their goal is to destroy everything related to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_2: I have been told since I was young that the world has become a hell because of the </color><color=0xffff0000>Primeval Sinner</color><color=0xfffffcee> and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>. As a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>knight</color><color=0xfffffcee>, eradicating the tumor of the Positive Facet is the embodiment of my </color><color=0xffdf85e3>justice</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_3: To be honest, I admire your will. But as I said before, being entangled in the past would hinder us. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Yagakbu</color><color=0xfffffcee> has been completely blinded by hatred, and such a force is destined to be unable to resist the </color><color=0xffff0000>monsters</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Negative Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_4: Let me ask you, what is your justice?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_5: My justice... I didn`t know what my justice was before. Should I work hard to become a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>hero</color><color=0xfffffcee>? Go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee> to kill a few monsters of the Negative Facet and end up like my parents, simply disappearing?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_6: It wasn`t until I tried and failed, fell into despair, and hated my own powerlessness that the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Spheres</color><color=0xfffffcee> showed me the outline of justice. Since I couldn`t become stronger myself, I decided to help other heroes and the Chosen One become stronger!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_7: Only when we are no longer threatened by the </color><color=0xffff0000>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, will my justice have any meaning.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136413_9: Leave, </color><color=0xff52c769>Wendt</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Chosen One, we should also go back.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136421_1: Although we didn`t find any clues to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you really worked hard this time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136421_2: Are you saying that even though I worked hard, I didn`t accomplish anything?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136421_3: No, that`s not what I mean. You have to believe that every footprint on the path of growth has its meaning.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136421_4: So, should we continue to pursue the Forbidden Book?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136421_5: I will instruct my informant to keep an eye on </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>. For now, your mission is over. It would be dangerous for you to continue investigating the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Yagakbu</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Do you want to continue the investigation?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136421_6: I didn`t mean that at all. So, what do we do next?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136422_1: I see. Since it`s a trade, a reward is essential. The Covenant of Sphere of Paladins is called </color><color=0xffdf85e3>`The Paladin`s Oath`</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Although it`s named that way, the author`s noble title is not just a knight.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136422_2: This book mainly records the growth history of the noble </color><color=0xff52c769>Dantes</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and it also mentions the early experiences of </color><color=0xff52c769>Thunderstriker Lancelot</color><color=0xfffffcee>. In the Dark Era, this was a best-selling book.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136424_1: Actually, I`m quite happy today. Many of those guys from </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> who looked down on me are choosing to cultivate Spheres.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136424_3: Wendt has inspired me a lot. He is undoubtedly a qualified paladin. In the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Paladins</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I hope you can find your own justice and carry it out with determination! I`ll send you to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee> now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140251_1: Chosen One, I heard you went to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> not long ago?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140251_3: Sigh, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Yagakbu</color><color=0xfffffcee> in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> is like that. The external threats are not yet resolved, and they keep thinking about internal strife. Sometimes, I find it hard to understand you humans` way of thinking.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140252_1: By the way, now that you have ascended to the Sphere of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Knights</color><color=0xfffffcee>, it`s time for you to get acquainted with the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rune Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140253_1: Yes, at the end of the Dark Era, a team of wounded veterans from the Facet Battlefield stumbled upon a Half Facet on their way home. When their families didn`t hear from them for a long time, they reported the issue. It was during my subsequent investigation that I discovered the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rune Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140253_2: Unfortunately... by the time I found them, they were all dead.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140254_1: Yes. In fact, each of them could be considered high-level professionals. To be precise, they were assimilated by the power of the Rune Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140254_2: The power of the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rune Peak</color><color=0xfffffcee> is very close to the origin. During the rescue mission, all I saw were the equipment the veterans used to wear. The only thing left behind was a type of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Rune Stone</color><color=0xfffffcee> imbued with the will of the deceased and their lifetime achievements. This kind of Rune Stone allows the wearer to master the secret techniques of the deceased.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140255_1: Yes, after experiencing the initial horror, heroes from the Positive Facet silently remembered this place. Later on, many dying soldiers chose to rest here. Through the assimilation of the Power of Runes, they transformed into </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Rune Stones</color><color=0xfffffcee> that could be used by future generations.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140255_2: Nowadays, the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rune Peak</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Rune Facet has become a holy place in the hearts of many professionals.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140255_3: Yes, a place worthy of respect!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140255_4: Yes, now you have the ability to wield the power of Rune Stones. Go find </color><color=0xff52c769>Bonnie</color><color=0xfffffcee>! She`s the guardian of the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rune Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and she will guide you to learn more.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140261_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Lady Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> mentioned you. They all call you Chosen One?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140261_3: Are you talking about </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>? That`s normal, after all, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primeval Threat Doctrine</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the cornerstone of the Yagakbu.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140262_1: Yes, but I don`t believe in the doctrine they uphold. Since Chosen Ones are also humans, why don`t we all join forces to get rid of those scraps from the </color><color=0xffff0000>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>? Doesn`t that make sense to you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140263_1: Ahem, that`s a bit off-topic. </color><color=0xff52c769>Lady Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> has informed me of your purpose for coming here, but as the guardian of the Rune Facet, I need to test your strength.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140264_1: Consider it fulfilling my brother`s wish. He hoped his secret techniques could assist strong heroes.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140264_3: Defeat the </color><color=0xffff0000>sentry</color><color=0xfffffcee> at the entrance of the Rune Facet to qualify for entry.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140265_1: The entrance is in the Love Canyon. To prevent monsters from entering the Rune Facet, I`ve set up three </color><color=0xffdf85e3>mechanisms</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Once you unlock them, you`ll see the sentry.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140331_1: Chosen One, congratulations! With the help of the </color><color=0xff52c769>World Priestess</color><color=0xfffffcee>, we`ve reorganized the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Rune Space</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Next, she will assist you in understanding it quickly. Go take a look!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140352_1: Previously, you visited the center of the Rune Facet, also known as the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rune Peak</color><color=0xfffffcee>. In other areas of the facet, there are various monsters scattered.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140352_2: To clear those monsters, Lady Eloise has opened up the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Mount Rune Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140353_1: Yes, would you like to challenge it? I heard the rewards are quite good!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140371_1: Chosen One, the spoils from the Mount Rune Battlefield are crucial for nurturing Rune Stones. Next, the World Priestess will help you understand how to cultivate </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Rune Stones</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140391_1: Chosen One, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Rune Space</color><color=0xfffffcee> opened by the World Priestess is impressive, isn`t it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_140392_1: Yes! </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Rune Stones</color><color=0xfffffcee> are relics of the strong. I`m glad they can now assist Chosen Ones. After all, the Negative Facet always threatens us. I hope you continue to grow stronger!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136441_1: Chosen One, you`re here. If only my pace of obtaining historical secrets could keep up with your promotion speed.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136441_2: Why are you sighing like that?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136441_3: I`ve been having trouble sleeping lately. Every time I fall asleep, I dream about the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and then I wake up excitedly and disappointedly lie back down.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136441_4: You remind me of an exercise called </color><color=0xffdf85e3>sit-ups</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136441_5: What`s that? I don`t want to do any exercise now. I just want to figure out what secrets the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> really holds! I`m really worried that it will be destroyed by those brainless members of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Yagakbu</color><color=0xfffffcee> before I can find it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136442_1: Humans are social animals. When faced with unsolvable difficulties, they must learn to seek help from others.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136443_1: We can seek help from </color><color=0xff52c769>Lord Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136443_2: Makes sense. Where can we find her?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136443_3: I don`t know. I haven`t seen the </color><color=0xff52c769>Priestess</color><color=0xfffffcee> for a long time, but there`s someone who should know where she is.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136444_1: No, </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve Trahir</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the Saintess. She has a close relationship with Lord Eloise. She often patrols around </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>. You can find her near the entrance to the Secret Zone.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136451_2: I wonder when the Saintess will return...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136452_1: The Saintess is patrolling in the northeast direction.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136452_2: You can go there to find her.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_2: It`s you? Are you getting better?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_3: I`ve recovered a bit. The elders told me to rest more, but the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>territory inspection</color><color=0xfffffcee> is important, and I don`t want to let my guard down because of my injuries. And you? How did you end up here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_4: A tree told me that I can find the </color><color=0xff52c769>Saintess</color><color=0xfffffcee> here. I have something to discuss with your Saintess.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_5: Nice to meet you again. I am </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve Trahir</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the Saintess. You can just call me Eve. So, what`s the matter?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_6: So you`re the Saintess!? Dunn told me that you should know where </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> is.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_7: Lord Eloise? She has been very busy lately. Why are you looking for her?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_8: To inquire about some historical secrets.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136461_9: I see. Lord Eloise is dealing with something in a </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Half Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>. If you need, I can open the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Gateway</color><color=0xfffffcee> for you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136471_1: Oh? %s, are you here to see me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136471_2: Yes, I have some historical questions I want to ask you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136471_3: Alright, no problem. Just wait for me for a bit!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136473_1: Alright, the annoying monsters have been cleared! Now I can focus on answering your questions.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136473_2: I want to know the secrets related to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136473_3: This question is simple. The Forbidden Book is actually...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136474_1: Chosen One, I sense your doubts and dissatisfactions.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_1: It seems that the instability in the recent Half Facet has diminished my perception.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_2: The book in my hands is known as the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>. It is a treasury containing the primal power, and different individuals reading this book will see different contents.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_4: For instance, </color><color=0xff52c769>Hector</color><color=0xfffffcee> sees the path of a Trojan from this book.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_5: So, you mean Hector was able to establish a sect because he had read the Forbidden Book?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_6: Yes, without exception for the Ten Legends. Of course, more than ten have read it, but only they have the talent to comprehend a completely new class path.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_7: This is insane! This book is so magical, why is it called the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_8: That`s just a label from the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee> by the ignorant. They believe the book is ominous, and Legends who create classes with this book ultimately choose self-sacrifice. Their bodies crumble, and their souls linger in the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Valhalla</color><color=0xfffffcee>, unable to rest after death.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_9: What the ignorant don`t know is that the dissolution of their bodies provides </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Lineage power</color><color=0xfffffcee> for heroes. The soul`s imprisonment is, in fact, suppressing the purgatory beneath the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Valhalla</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136475_10: Actually, I prefer to call it the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Blasphemous Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_1: I`m sorry... %s, she didn`t startle you, did she?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_3: That`s good. Um... do you have any other questions?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_4: Yes. I encountered a knight from Bird Island named </color><color=0xff52c769>Wendt</color><color=0xfffffcee> who claimed that the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> was the root cause of the chaos in Positive Facet. I don`t think he seems foolish, so...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_6: He`s right. In fact, I`ve always known that the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a threat. If the Positive Facet is truly on the brink of destruction one day, I will personally destroy the book.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_7: What would happen if this book is destroyed?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_8: Destroying the Forbidden Book is the only ace to save the Positive Facet, but it will also result in the Positive Facet having no future. I dare not gamble, so I`ve come up with a compromise: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning Chosen Ones from the Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>! At least for now, everything seems to be progressing in a positive direction.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_9: Does that mean the improvement in the strength of Chosen Ones will have a good impact on the world?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136476_11: Go back, I sense some unfavorable changes in the facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136481_1: Chosen One, how`s it going? Any progress?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136481_2: A little. First, I found out where the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> is. Second, I learned what the Forbidden Book is and, oh, the origin of its name. Then, I discovered some secrets of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Valhalla</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Finally, I found out the strongest ace to save the Positive Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136481_3: Well... I want to know all of it! Quickly, tell me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136481_4: Huh? Aren`t you a historian? You don`t know any of these secrets?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136481_5: That`s why I entrusted you! Hurry up and tell me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136481_6: Hmm? What? Your curiosity doesn`t seem very strong.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136481_7: I... I mean, you are truly the Chosen One, with knowledge surpassing me, a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>history enthusiast</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136491_1: Dear Chosen One, we meet again. It`s delightful to see your strength reach new heights. Now, you need to undergo the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>second rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136492_1: I am the Rebirth Master, you can also call me </color><color=0xff52c769>Solon Wingley</color><color=0xfffffcee>. This time, I bring you the truth about rebirth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136492_2: I remember now! You mean the truth about rebirth?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136492_3: Yes, do you still remember this phrase? `Chosen Ones come forth, they are harmless, the hope to restore the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee>. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a two-way feedback between Chosen Ones and the Universe Core.`
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136493_1: Yes, later, I consulted Eloise. She told me that the unique nature of Chosen Ones cannot be replicated. You, coming from the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, do not deplete the world`s energy when absorbing energy from the Positive Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136493_2: This goes against the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>law of energy conservation</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136493_3: Interesting concept. But I believe in </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, as the World Priestess, she doesn`t need to convince people through lies. So, when Chosen Ones rebirth, the Universe Core gains energy replenishment.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136493_4: </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> gave an example, likening the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Positive Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> to a kettle, energy to water, and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Chosen Ones</color><color=0xfffffcee>` bodies to cups. When the water from the kettle is poured into the cup, it does not decrease. Chosen Ones` </color><color=0xffdf85e3>rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee> is like pouring the water from the cup back into the kettle. The result is that the water increases.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136494_1: Yes, what`s even crazier is that the strength of Chosen Ones after rebirth will not be affected. I have to admit, Chosen Ones are indeed so unique that they cannot be replicated. Well, back to the point, let me introduce the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>ritual</color><color=0xfffffcee> you need to prepare for this rebirth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136495_1: The rebirth involves two processes. First, collect the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> power through resonance. Second, prepare the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>sacrificial offering</color><color=0xfffffcee>. In a place called the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Evil Abyss</color><color=0xfffffcee>, a </color><color=0xffff0000>Blood Demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> is imprisoned, and it will become the sacrifice for your bebirth ritual. For more details, you can consult Arthur there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136501_2: This Half Facet looks quite gloomy. How long have you been here?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136501_3: About 20 years. Many </color><color=0xffff0000>creatures</color><color=0xfffffcee> from the Negative Facet are suppressed here, making it particularly eerie.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136502_1: Let me explain the process for you. The </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Evil Abyss</color><color=0xfffffcee> has </color><color=0xffdf85e3>four elemental seals</color><color=0xfffffcee> at its four corners, each containing a trace of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> power. You need to resonate with them. Once completed, the demon seal will loosen. After activating the Seal Crystal, the </color><color=0xffff0000>Blood Demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> will be released, and you may kill it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138611_1: Chosen One, in your opinion, how strong are those sub-demon creatures?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138612_1: You can still quit now because the next opponent is the </color><color=0xffff0000>Blood Demon</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138614_1: Don`t worry, they haven`t become so strong that we can`t handle them yet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138616_1: Next, you need to resonate with the four elemental seals, namely the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Fire Seal, Earth Seal, Wind Seal</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Thunder Seal</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Currently, the Fire Seal has already manifested. Go and resonate with it first!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138621_1: Chosen One, you`re doing great. Currently, the other three elemental seals have not manifested yet, but based on experience, I have a way to find them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138622_1: Near the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Earth Seal</color><color=0xfffffcee>, there will be some terrain anomalies like </color><color=0xffdf85e3>mounds of earth</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Digging into those mounds will reveal something.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138641_1: Chosen One, next is the Wind Seal, similar to the Earth Seal.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138641_2: Do I need to keep digging into mounds of earth?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138641_3: No, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Wind Seal</color><color=0xfffffcee> will create </color><color=0xffdf85e3>tornadoes</color><color=0xfffffcee>. These tornadoes form barriers that hinder people from investigating the seal. You just need to break through these tornadoes. When the balance is disrupted, the Wind Seal will naturally manifest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138661_1: It`s like they are guiding me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138671_1: Huh? The wind has weakened a lot. It seems the seal is nearby!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138681_1: Chosen One, next is the last seal.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138682_1: Yes, it is rumored that the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Thunder Seal</color><color=0xfffffcee> is hidden in the void, but I have a way to bring it out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_138683_1: I obtained a kind of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Thunder Blossom</color><color=0xfffffcee> on the Facet Battlefield before. Place it in an area rich in thunder elements, and it can attract thunderstorms. There is a mutual attraction between thunderstorms, and I believe it can help you find the Thunder Seal.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136551_1: Next, you need to activate the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Seal Crystal</color><color=0xfffffcee>. After the last seal is opened, the </color><color=0xffff0000>Blood Demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> will be released immediately. Please prepare for everything.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136551_2: Is this Blood Demon very powerful?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136551_3: There are many types of demons in the Negative Facet, most of which are inferior subspecies, such as some massive beasts carrying demonic bloodlines. </color><color=0xffff0000>Blood Demons</color><color=0xfffffcee>` blood is similar to that of the </color><color=0xffff0000>high-level demons</color><color=0xfffffcee>, making them much more difficult to deal with.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136552_1: Be cautious, and when you`re ready, go ahead and activate the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Seal Crystal</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136581_1: Respected Chosen One, you`ve done it again!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136583_1: Well, he`s been in that ghostly place for 20 years. Perhaps his persistence is justified.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136583_3: He unintentionally killed two heroes on the Facet Battlefield, and though it wasn`t intentional, he can probably never face the outside world directly. I think he`s trying to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>atone</color><color=0xfffffcee> in his own way.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136583_4: Enough about that. Please allow me to take you to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee> to complete the final step of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>second rebirth</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136601_1: Chosen One, I have two friends in big trouble!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136601_2: How many friends do you actually have?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136601_3: The Burg family`s motto is `</color><color=0xffdf85e3>More friends, more paths</color><color=0xfffffcee>`. Let`s talk about the matter at hand. Do you remember that disturbance in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136603_1: After multiple verifications, the last disturbance was caused by a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facet riot</color><color=0xfffffcee>. It`s said that the chain reaction from the riot resulted in many heroes in the Half Facet losing their lives, leaving many survivors with psychological trauma.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136603_2: Are your two friends trapped in the Half Facet?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136603_3: No, </color><color=0xff52c769>Geis</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xff52c769>Leyla</color><color=0xfffffcee> luckily escaped. It was their near-death experience that made them realize their true feelings and decide to become partners.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136603_5: They are siblings, well... </color><color=0xffdf85e3>cousins</color><color=0xfffffcee>. It`s my fault, I shouldn`t have lent them that book, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Praise to the Elf King</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136604_1: Well... although I don`t endorse such taboo love, they are </color><color=0xffdf85e3>poets</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Do you understand poets? Once they decide on something, not even eight horses can pull them back! They insist on publicly revealing their love to the world and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>holding a wedding</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Twin City.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136604_2: In Twin City, there`s a highly respected veteran, the current chief guard and, in fact, </color><color=0xff52c769>Davis</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s immediate superior. Upon hearing about this, he vehemently opposed the decision of the two siblings and threatened to put them both on the gallows if they insisted on having the wedding.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136604_3: Understood, how can I help you? Deal with the chief guard?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136604_4: Of course not! I want to entrust you to seek the help of </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf King Oropher</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I heard that the Elf Queen is the Elf King`s cousin. If this is true, the Elf King might be willing to intervene and prevent this tragedy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136604_5: Where can I find the Elf King?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136604_6: Well, the Elf King should be on the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee> now. How about this, go find the </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf Saintess</color><color=0xfffffcee>, she can do the same.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136621_2: Quick... go find </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, something... something big is happening!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136621_3: What`s happening? What about those monsters just now? Why have I never seen them before?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136621_4: No time... no time to explain, go find Eloise!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136621_5: Let`s go together, your current condition won`t hold too long, especially if you encounter those monsters again...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136621_6: ... Alright, I need to recuperate a bit. Eloise... is currently in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Desert City</color><color=0xfffffcee>... I`ll set up a teleportation array for you... go and inform her about the </color><color=0xffff0000>demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> manifestation...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136631_2: Elf Saintess </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee> was injured by </color><color=0xffff0000>demons</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Maple Forest. She didn`t explain much, just asked me to convey this message.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136632_1: She is the </color><color=0xff52c769>Red Priestess</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Desert City. Recently, several elderly giants have been brutally murdered, and their bodies bear the aura of the Negative Facet. It seems highly likely that </color><color=0xffff0000>demons</color><color=0xfffffcee> are responsible!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136632_2: And Eve? How is she? Does she have strong elves protecting her?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136632_3: When I found her, she was alone, still in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I don`t know the specifics of her injuries, but she said she would come after a brief recovery.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136632_4: Your Excellency Priestess, given the special status of the Elf Saintess, it`s imperative to have her protected as soon as possible.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136632_5: Hmm, you wait here, I`ll set up a summoning array.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_1: Eve, explain in detail what happened.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_2: Alright! After the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facet riot</color><color=0xfffffcee>, many heroes came to Maple Forest seeking the Holy Water for healing. To prevent thieves from taking advantage, I invited two elders to patrol the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Maple Forest</color><color=0xfffffcee> with me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_3: During the patrol, one elder sensed a disturbance in the sacred ground. Upon arrival, we encountered a </color><color=0xffff0000>high-level demon</color><color=0xfffffcee>. To let me escape, the two elders... have probably returned to the embrace of the Mother Tree... I failed the elves...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_4: Don`t be too hard on yourself. You`re safe, and that`s what matters.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_7: Yes... if the Chosen One hadn`t arrived in time, I`m afraid I would have...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_8: This is troublesome! Lady Priestess, may I ask if you visited the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Desert</color><color=0xfffffcee> recently?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_9: Yes, I did. I discovered some giants cutting down trees during my patrol. Originally, they came to discuss a new </color><color=0xffdf85e3>logging ban</color><color=0xfffffcee> with you, but you weren`t there, so they returned directly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_10: Recently, several giants have been brutally murdered. It seems that the </color><color=0xffff0000>high-level demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> is aware of your identity.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_11: Enough, </color><color=0xff52c769>Red Priestess</color><color=0xfffffcee>, it`s not the time for this discussion now. First, help her heal. Her injuries are severe enough that she can`t rely on her own mobility.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136634_12: Chosen One, there`s something I`d like to entrust to you. Let`s talk outside the city.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136641_1: %s, the intrusion of </color><color=0xffff0000>Negative Facet beings</color><color=0xfffffcee> has disrupted some of my original plans. Can I ask you for a favor?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136642_1: Escort Eve back to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>, where advanced heroes are stationed. Eve is crucial to the Positive Facet, and if she is captured, the Lands of Apex and Abyss will no longer be safe, so...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136642_2: I see, but I want to know what makes </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee> special?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136642_3: She can open </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Gateways</color><color=0xfffffcee>, so I never assign her to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136642_4: Thank you for your willingness to help. I`ll head to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Ape City</color><color=0xfffffcee> first and coordinate the follow-up arrangements with the </color><color=0xff52c769>Black Priest</color><color=0xfffffcee> there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136642_6: No, the priority is to ensure </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s safety.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136651_2: Well, I can move reluctantly, but teleportation is still beyond my capability.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136651_3: The High Priestess has already left. Chosen One, please make sure to escort the </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf Saintess</color><color=0xfffffcee> to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136652_1: Let`s set out. Delay may lead to unforeseen circumstances.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136662_1: You little brat, you can really run.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136662_2: Chosen One, run quickly, seek help from </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136662_3: Run? No, no, no, none of you can escape. Chosen One? Yes, I`ve heard of you, summoned by the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Lock</color><color=0xfffffcee>, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136662_4: Hmm, considering you come from the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I can give you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>two choices</color><color=0xfffffcee>. One is to tie up this little brat next to you, and I can give you a dignified death. As for the other one, oh, just thinking about it makes me excited!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136663_1: Looks like you also enjoy the thrill. Hmm, this should be very interesting! So, let`s begin!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136672_1: Didn`t expect it would be him! </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee>, leader of the 12th Demon Legion!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136672_3: Yes, met him a few hundred years ago on the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee>. He`s quite a sociable madman.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136672_4: Sorry, </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the situation is critical, and I had to request your assistance.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136672_5: No problem, the situation in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Ape City</color><color=0xfffffcee> is far less urgent than I imagined. You must not use life-draining methods to open the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Gateway</color><color=0xfffffcee> again, understand?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136672_6: Understood. How could your strength have declined so much?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136672_7: … We`ll discuss this matter later. Eve, to prevent </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee> from attacking again, I`ll escort you back to Twin City. However, I can`t always protect you. The affairs in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Ape City</color><color=0xfffffcee> need to be continued. So, unless necessary, do not step out of the city!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136681_1: Chosen One, thank you for your help, and thank you for stepping forward at the crucial moment.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136681_2: No worries. First, recover from your injuries, and then... I might need your help with something later.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136691_1: Chosen One, did you find the person?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136691_2: Yes, but... </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee> was injured. I`m worried her condition might not be enough to persuade the </color><color=0xff52c769>chief guard</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136691_3: You injured her? How could you do that?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136691_4: It`s a long story. We`ve been through a lot on this journey.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136691_5: But </color><color=0xff52c769>LuFu</color><color=0xfffffcee>, that chief guard, has issued an ultimatum. </color><color=0xff52c769>Leyla</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xff52c769>Geis</color><color=0xfffffcee> decided to defend their love with their lives...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136691_6: I understand. You go stabilize the chief guard, and I`ll go find the </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf Saintess</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136701_1: Chosen One, I`ve been waiting for you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136701_2: Although it`s a bit difficult to talk about, perhaps only you can help in this matter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136701_3: Hmm, go on. As long as it doesn`t involve betraying the elves, I`ll do my best to help.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136701_4: It`s probably... The situation is like this...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136702_1: I see, I greatly admire </color><color=0xff52c769>Leyla</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xff52c769>Geis</color><color=0xfffffcee>. They remind me of how the Elf King looked when facing the elders of our race.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136702_2: The </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf King</color><color=0xfffffcee> married his cousin, which is considered </color><color=0xffdf85e3>taboo</color><color=0xfffffcee> in our race. But as his adopted daughter in name, I have enough standing to represent him in this matter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>LuFu</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you have been to the Facet Battlefield. You should understand how precious each hero is to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Positive Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_2: </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>, do you think those two poets would willingly go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee> to assist the Positive Facet? I`ll say it again, sibling marriage is unheard of. If they insist on marrying, I can overlook it, as long as the wedding doesn`t take place in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_4: Don`t bring up the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>early days of the Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>. At that time, to perpetuate the race, such taboo acts did occur in some regions. But now, it`s the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dawn Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>! Such scandals must not happen in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_5: Hello, Chief Guard. I am </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve Trahir</color><color=0xfffffcee> from the Elf Race. Have you heard the love story of Elf King Oropher?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_6: No, I`ve only seen him from a distance on the Facet Battlefield.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_7: </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf Queen Luna</color><color=0xfffffcee> is his cousin. Before </color><color=0xff52c769>Oropher</color><color=0xfffffcee> became the Elf King, he and his cousin were in love. Due to opposition from the elders in the race, the Elf King had to reluctantly give up. But his love for Luna did not diminish; it only grew over time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_8: A hundred years later, he, with his strength and remarkable battlefield strategy, became the new Elf King. He held a grand </color><color=0xffdf85e3>bonding ceremony</color><color=0xfffffcee> for his cousin Luna. Although not all elves blessed the ceremony, they still proceeded without hesitation.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_9: Later, the opposition in the race vanished. Not because of the Elf King`s strength or his unwavering commitment to the Queen, but because he had saved elders who once opposed them on the battlefield. Elves realized he was not only a suitable </color><color=0xffdf85e3>partner</color><color=0xfffffcee> but also a qualified </color><color=0xffdf85e3>leader</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_10: That`s right. Back in the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xff52c769>Geis</color><color=0xfffffcee> risked his life to save several heroes, and </color><color=0xff52c769>Leyla</color><color=0xfffffcee> once thought he would die in the process. The mutual dedication forged through life-and-death experiences. </color><color=0xff52c769>LuFu</color><color=0xfffffcee>, can you bear to destroy that?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136711_12: Forget it, maybe I really don`t oppose their stance. But I have one </color><color=0xffdf85e3>request</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and it involves the Chosen One.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136712_1: The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Lands of Apex and Abyss</color><color=0xfffffcee>, known as the last pure land of the Positive Facet, is the closest to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee>. However, I recently received news that advanced beings from the </color><color=0xffff0000>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> have invaded. If a wedding were to take place at this moment, it would not be safe for all parties involved.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136712_2: So, I hope the wedding can be </color><color=0xffdf85e3>postponed</color><color=0xfffffcee> until the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Last Pure Land</color><color=0xfffffcee> is restored to tranquility. Clearing this threat requires the assistance of the Chosen One. Most advanced beings in the Positive Facet are currently engaged in the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee> and cannot easily withdraw.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136713_1: Compared to ordinary heroes, the Chosen One has too many advantages. If you can`t handle it, then this era wouldn`t be called the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dawn Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136721_1: I heard from the </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf Saintess</color><color=0xfffffcee> that a simple commission has unexpectedly led to so many twists and turns.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136721_2: If I`m not mistaken, the Covenant of the Sphere of Victors is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Praise to the Elf King</color><color=0xfffffcee>, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136721_3: Are you in such a hurry to get to the point?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136721_4: This commission is extremely dangerous, so I hope you can be straightforward and be a qualified trading partner.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136721_5: Fine, I`ll give it to you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136723_1: The core spirit of the Sphere of Victors is </color><color=0xffdf85e3>belief</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Some heroes regard their race as their belief, but at times, it can also be called the belief of victors, just like Geis and Leyla.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136723_2: Belief... Huh, what`s the use of belief without power?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136723_3: The path of a hero is fraught with difficulties. With the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>adventurous spirit</color><color=0xfffffcee> of Apprentices, you can face the monsters that make hearts tremble. With the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>guardian spirit</color><color=0xfffffcee> of Squires, you can understand why you become stronger. With the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>justice spirit</color><color=0xfffffcee> of Paladins, you won`t misuse your power. During cultivation, thoughts are usually clear.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136723_4: Similarly, with the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>belief spirit</color><color=0xfffffcee> of a hero, you can unleash the inner power at crucial moments. Each advancement in Sphere is a tempering of the mind. If the will is not firm enough, how can you face </color><color=0xffff0000>demons</color><color=0xfffffcee> skilled in seduction?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136723_5: Alright, enough, don`t lecture me, </color><color=0xff52c769>Master Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136723_6: The last question: do you have someone who can give you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>belief</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136724_2: It`s time to go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Are you ready?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136725_1: Me? Are you making things up just now? You were just complaining about me being annoying. But even so, I`m quite happy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136725_2: It`s time to go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Are you ready?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136726_2: It`s time to go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Are you ready?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136727_1: Hmm, then spend more time with him/her.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136727_2: It`s time to go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Are you ready?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136728_1: Looks like you are someone with a broad mind!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136728_2: It`s time to go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Are you ready?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136741_1: As of today, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Lands of Apex and Abyss</color><color=0xfffffcee> is in a state of emergency. Residents of Twin City should not leave the city unless necessary.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136752_1: This matter can`t be ignored, right? Have you heard about the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lockdown</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Twin City?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136752_2: Well, it`s not exactly a lockdown. At most, it`s just advising everyone not to leave the city.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136752_3: Yes, it`s advice for heroes. For ordinary people like me who value life, it`s a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lockdown notice</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136752_4: Do you have something that requires leaving the city?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136752_11: It seems I need to go and ask Eloise for the truth.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136771_1: %s, fortunately, you arrived just in time. These despicable guys only know how to use the tactic of overwhelming numbers!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136771_3: Alas, now that things have come to this, there`s no need to keep it from you. Actually, it happened back during the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facet riot</color><color=0xfffffcee>...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136772_1: Well, about my identity, I believe you, as the Chosen One, will know some day. Let`s talk about the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>sudden drop in strength</color><color=0xfffffcee>.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136773_3: I see. I was wondering why someone as </color><color=0xffdf85e3>esteemed</color><color=0xfffffcee> as you couldn`t directly obliterate that </color><color=0xffff0000>demon</color><color=0xfffffcee>.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136773_5: (Vexed) It`s really impolite. Every time, I get interrupted. It seems like I`m in control, but every time, I can`t resist her appearance.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136773_6: Why? Why do I have to bear such a fate? Perhaps from the beginning, I shouldn`t have summoned the Chosen One just for survival... en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136774_1: No, Eloise, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the hope of the Positive Facet. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136775_1: (Joyful) Hmm! I understand! Besides destroying the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>, at least, we still have the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee> as an ace in the hole!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136775_2: We were all very worried about you, including </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>. So, don`t give up.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136775_3: Good! This is the happiest day of my life! You all can go back now, and I need to prepare for future battles.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136781_1: Thank you just now. Thank you for helping persuade </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136781_2: No need to thank me. Along this journey, Eloise has helped me a lot.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136781_3: I`ve lived for </color><color=0xffdf85e3>275 years</color><color=0xfffffcee>, known Eloise for over 180 years, and it`s the first time I`ve seen Eloise venting her emotions.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136782_1: Yes, indeed. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>A long life</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a gift from nature to the elves. At 275 years, if converted into the average lifespan of humans, it`s about </color><color=0xffdf85e3>24 years</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136782_3: Well, about the thing you asked me regarding the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Gateway</color><color=0xfffffcee> earlier, I declined because I always felt that you are outsiders, passers-by, without much attachment to this land we`ve lived on for so long, but...

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136784_6: I couldn`t travel with everyone because, at the beginning, I was captured by a </color><color=0xffff0000>high-level Naga</color><color=0xfffffcee>. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136784_8: It wasn`t until we reached the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lands of Apex and Abyss</color><color=0xfffffcee> that I knew how malicious she was. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136784_9: Since then, my eyes changed color. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136784_11: I`m fine, it`s all in the past! Later, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Tragedy of Elven</color><color=0xfffffcee>occurred. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136784_12: Fortunately, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Lands of Apex and Abyss</color><color=0xfffffcee> is close to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Positive Facet, suppressing the strength of the creatures from the Negative Facet significantly. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136784_13: A series of shocks made me collapse, and only the </color><color=0xff52c769>Night Elf Uncle Juvales</color><color=0xfffffcee> defended me. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136785_1: After my father returned, he told the elders that it was due to the withdrawal of the </color><color=0xffff0000>Naga Queen</color><color=0xfffffcee> that Positive Facet gained the upper hand in a crucial battle. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136785_2: After that, the race gradually accepted me. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_136841_2: I am here on behalf of Dunn to investigate the recent situation in Ape City. How is everything here after the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facet riot</color><color=0xfffffcee>?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137041_2: As you can see, I`m about to ascend. I want to find </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> for his assistance, but it seems he`s not in Twin City.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137045_2: </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee>, where there are too many powerful beings, and it`s far from </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lands of Apex and Abyss</color><color=0xfffffcee>. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137046_2: Yes, Dunn is in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>, said to be meeting a friend. He left not long ago and should have arrived by now.

The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> repels anything from other facets. At that time, if creatures from the Negative Facet accidentally entered here, they would be annihilated. However, facing the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primeval Facet...</color><color=0xfffffcee>

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137024_4: Yes, before the strengthening of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>human nature</color><color=0xfffffcee>, she had no emotions or feelings, acting according to the guideline `beneficial to the Positive Facet`. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137024_6: Well, this choice may seem cruel, but from the perspective of the World Priestess, it makes sense. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137024_7: Summoning the Chosen One is also beneficial to Positive Facet? Didn`t you say that things from </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee> would affect the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee>?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137024_10: Understood. You mentioned earlier that as I continue to improve, the balance within you is shifting towards a better direction. What is this </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Balance</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
