en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137054_2: When they return, we can summon </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee> and catch him in the act!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137054_3: Sounds good, then let`s go? Back to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137054_4: Sure, take this. You will assist in setting up the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning array</color><color=0xfffffcee> when the time comes.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137056_1: By the way, there`s another piece of good news. Guess how that powerful hero ascended the Sphere of Legends? Hmm... this question sounds a bit difficult. Let me ask another one. Who pioneered the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Spheres</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137071_1: %s, Dunn, let me introduce. This is </color><color=0xff52c769>Halma</color><color=0xfffffcee>, a human Legend. Halma, these two...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137071_2: I know! This uniquely styled, scholarly middle-aged man should be </color><color=0xff52c769>Master Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>! And this... should be the </color><color=0xff52c769>Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee>, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137071_5: Ahaha... he... he`s like this, quite straightforward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137071_6: Now that you called me Master, I won`t argue with you. By the way, </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I have some good news to tell you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137071_7: Stop! I`ll handle it to save everyone`s time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137071_8: Well, </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you be quiet. Chosen One, you go ahead.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137072_3: We can beat that </color><color=0xffff0000>demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> now, right? Good, good! Where? Let`s go!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137072_4: Did you not understand what the Chosen One said? We need to set up the </color><color=0xff52c769>summoning array</color><color=0xfffffcee> first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137072_5: </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you`ve just returned from the Facet Battlefield. You can rest in Twin City for now, and we`ll need to prepare the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>materials for setting up the array</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137072_6: Alright, </color><color=0xff52c769>Halma</color><color=0xfffffcee>, go and prepare. Dealing with </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee> won`t be as simple as you think.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137081_1: The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning array</color><color=0xfffffcee> requires three materials: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Creature`s Blood</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Illusory Herb</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Elf Dew</color><color=0xfffffcee>. We already have the Elf Dew, just need the other two.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137081_3: Any creature`s blood will do. Just get some nearby, like a </color><color=0xffff0000>Pheasant</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137112_2: Let`s go. I`ve already chosen a location, and </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> and the others should have arrived.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137131_2: I don`t know... It should be fine with the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning ritual</color><color=0xfffffcee>... No, I seem to have forgotten to put in a crucial item...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137131_3: That`s the Chosen One! It was an exciting battle! </color><color=0xff52c769>Master Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>, summon another one! My blood is already boiling!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137131_5: Stop! Dunn, you`re reminding me of some unpleasant memories... Let someone else perform the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning ritual</color><color=0xfffffcee>...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137132_1: Well, this guy once attempted various bizarre rituals to summon the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>. One time, he summoned a </color><color=0xffff0000>high-level beast</color><color=0xfffffcee> from the Negative Facet, just like today. But he`s been lucky. last time, I saved him, and this time, it`s you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137132_2: So, does this guy have a natural </color><color=0xffdf85e3>taunting disposition</color><color=0xfffffcee>? Or is he specifically attracting the hatred of high-level beings from the Negative Facet?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137132_4: Oh, sounds like Master Dunn is well-suited for a trip to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Facet Battlefield</color><color=0xfffffcee>. The Elf King, who are skilled in strategy, should find this interesting!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137132_5: </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee>... It was just a minor mistake, and besides, you promised not to spread that incident. I... I really didn`t mean to...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137132_6: Our agreement was not to mention the incident where you were so scared you called for your grandfather. It`s not contradictory.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137133_1: Ahem... sorry, slipped up there! Um... anyway, let </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee> handle this, it`s definitely her expertise.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137141_2: Found him, and I have good news to share. </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> is back, and she brought reinforcements, a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Legend</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137141_4: It`s true, Eloise needs you to summon that demon. </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> got a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Haka`s Feather</color><color=0xfffffcee>, which can be used as a medium for the summoning.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137141_5: I... I can`t do it, I...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137142_1: No... I just don`t want to cause the death of innocent people again. After the Tragedy of Elven, I can`t summon the courage to face that </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning array</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137142_2: I understand your feelings, but </color><color=0xffff0000>Demon Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s power is limited, and we have a Legend overseeing. So, the casualties you`re worried about won`t happen again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137142_3: I, I mean, can I trust you, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137143_1: Of course! The scales of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>victory</color><color=0xfffffcee> will surely tip in our favor!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137143_2: Good! I`ll teleport directly there now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137144_1: I dare not say we won`t encounter any unexpected situations, but what I can see is that the scales of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>victory</color><color=0xfffffcee> are slowly tilting in our favor.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137144_2: Chosen One, did you know? Although it may sound strange to say this, but your words just now were very much like my father, </color><color=0xff52c769>Oropher</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Humble yet resolute, like a ruler, convincing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137144_3: Thank you for your praise. If I understood correctly, you mean you agree?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137144_4: Of course! I`ll teleport directly there now!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137151_1: %s, guess what the real reason for the last summoning failure was?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137152_1: No, it`s because </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> didn`t place the most crucial medium, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Haka`s Feather</color><color=0xfffffcee>, into the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning array</color><color=0xfffffcee>! He only remembered it when </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee> mentioned it just now!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137152_2: ... It seems our master indeed shows signs of premature aging.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137152_3: ... And you said I was the one, but wasn`t the feather always in your possession?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137152_6: Ahem! Eloise, Chosen One, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>summoning array</color><color=0xfffffcee> has been set up. You just need to place the medium into it to initiate the ritual.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137152_7: Let`s begin! I`m prepared for battle!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137154_1: I`ll go take a look. It seemed like </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee> deliberately diverted </color><color=0xff52c769>Halma</color><color=0xfffffcee>. You all go back to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I`m worried that Haka might have unknown reinforcements.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137161_1: Chosen One? Why did you follow?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137161_2: I was a bit worried, so I came to take a look.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137161_3: Hahaha, what`s there to worry about? That </color><color=0xffff0000>demon</color><color=0xfffffcee> has been forced back to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Half Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I`m planning to open a teleportation to go in and kill him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137161_4: Did you notice any injuries on Haka during your battle?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137161_5: No injuries, but that guy`s condition is strange.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137162_1: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>His attacks are weak, but his defense is not low</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Although he can`t withstand my attacks, I`m not confident in solving him quickly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137162_2: So, do you plan to pursue him and directly enter the Half Facet to deal with him?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137162_4: Let`s return to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee> first. Things may not be as simple as we think.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137162_5: Why? I`ve hunted many </color><color=0xffff0000>high-level demons</color><color=0xfffffcee> on the Facet Battlefield!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137162_6: Let`s go. I`ll explain after we get back.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137162_7: Fine. If the explanation isn`t satisfactory, I`ll beat you up along with him!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_1: %s, what happened? </color><color=0xff52c769>Halma</color><color=0xfffffcee> said you terminated the hunting?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_2: Yes, things are probably more complicated than we thought.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_4: If I remember correctly, </color><color=0xff52c769>Black Priest Carl</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a hero of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Kings</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Even when closing the Facet Gateway, he should have the ability to protect himself even if he encounters </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_6: Haka had no injuries during the battle with Halma. This indicates that </color><color=0xff52c769>Carl</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s strength is not a threat to </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_7: </color><color=0xff52c769>Carl</color><color=0xfffffcee> once said that Negative Facet creatures are subjected to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>facet suppression</color><color=0xfffffcee> when fighting in the Positive Facet. I speculate that in the Half Facet, this suppression might not continue to exist. Therefore, Haka is very likely a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>high-level demon of the Sphere of Legends</color><color=0xfffffcee>, appearing weak against </color><color=0xff52c769>Halma</color><color=0xfffffcee>, but intending to lure him into the Half Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_8: Even if he`s a Legend, I`m not afraid of him!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_9: Yes, you`re very strong, but even in the Positive Facet, you`re not confident in quickly dealing with Haka. How can you ensure killing him? Moreover, does </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee> have other hidden tricks? These are </color><color=0xffdf85e3>unknowns</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_10: If you get trapped and can`t respond to the recall of the Facet Battlefield, it will undoubtedly have an impact on the battle situation.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_11: Hmm... </color><color=0xff52c769>Halma</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a newly promoted Legend, even if he doesn`t return to the battlefield for a short time, it won`t have a big impact on the situation.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_13: No, the Chosen One is right. We don`t know what other tricks </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee> might have. If something unexpected happens to you, the situation will become extremely unfavorable.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_14: Then, how do we deal with </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee>? If he stays hidden in the Half Facet, do we just have to endure it? We can`t recall another Legend, can we?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_15: Don`t we still have the Chosen One? %s`s growth is evident to all. The most reliable method is to have </color><color=0xff52c769>Halma</color><color=0xfffffcee> guard the Lands of Apex and Abyss while the Chosen One grows rapidly. Then, together with Halma, you can kill </color><color=0xffff0000>Haka</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137171_16: %s, is this the basis for your decision to terminate the hunting?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137172_1: So, what do I do? Keep an eye on the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>portal entrance</color><color=0xfffffcee> to the Half Facet?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137172_2: I can sense if there are anomalies in the Positive Facet. For now, you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>guard Twin City</color><color=0xfffffcee> and protect Dunn and Eve. That`s it. With Facet Gateways closed, I need to quickly recover my strength.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137181_1: Chosen One, you have grown a lot. I am pleased.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137181_2: Why do you have the demeanor of an elder? Did a unique hairstyle give you a psychological advantage in age?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137181_3: I don`t like others talking about my hairstyle!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137182_2: Anyway, your handling of this incident is </color><color=0xffdf85e3>mature</color><color=0xfffffcee> enough, oh, except for forgetting about Haka`s Feather.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137182_3: Do you still have the nerve to say that?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137182_4: Okay, okay, there`s nothing to be shy about. I can accept your imperfections.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137182_6: Cough, given your calm judgment, mature approach, and rapid promotion speed, this book, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Joey Empire</color><color=0xfffffcee>, now belongs to you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137182_7: The Covenant of Sphere of Kings?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137182_8: Yes, congratulations on taking another step forward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137184_1: The core spirit of the Sphere of Kings is </color><color=0xffdf85e3>strategy</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Remember, once you become a king, you are no longer an ordinary strong person, but a ruler and strategist. While strength is important, a king needs to consider the overall situation, become a chess player, and leverage momentum. That is the essence of strategy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137184_3: In short, for things that can be solved with your brain, don`t use your hands.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137184_4: (Yawn) I... have seen... the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Priest Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee>... beckoning to me... Phew...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137184_5: Well, go... go... I really can`t stand you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_1: Chosen One, you arrived just in time! I`m about to be driven crazy by this </color><color=0xffdf85e3>ignorant</color><color=0xfffffcee> big guy!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_3: You! You! I am the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>current head</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the great Burg family! A </color><color=0xffdf85e3>genius</color><color=0xfffffcee> chosen by Eloise! The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>founder</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Spheres! A renowned </color><color=0xffdf85e3>historian</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>collector</color><color=0xfffffcee> in the continent! Can`t you show me some respect?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_4: I agree with everything else, but I have doubts about the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>historian</color><color=0xfffffcee> part. Also, Chosen One, I`ve noticed you have some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>strange tastes</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_5: Haha, I was just joking. Speaking of which, </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>, why did you summon me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_6: I believe you`ve read the biography, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Joey Empire</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Halma said that the giants had no civilization, calling them barbarians. This kind of statement is simply a disgrace to the field of history!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_7: No, no, I`ve encountered many Legends! Their long lives tell me that long before the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, in the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Disaster Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>giants</color><color=0xfffffcee> were fierce and wild, using monster skulls as pots and monster bones as weapons.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_8: While the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>dwarves</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>humans</color><color=0xfffffcee> had developed into advanced civilizations, the wisdom of humans combined with the forging skills of dwarves allowed the two races to jointly rule this continent. At that time, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>elves</color><color=0xfffffcee> were just a natural faction living in a corner, only the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>dark elves</color><color=0xfffffcee> gained recognition from humans and dwarves due to their amazing magical talent.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_9: Nonsense! The ancient records are clear. </color><color=0xff52c769>Joey Dion</color><color=0xfffffcee> was the prehistoric giant king. Before the coming of </color><color=0xff52c769>Primever Ayr</color><color=0xfffffcee>, Joey ruled the entire continent, flourishing with the powerful strength of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>giant race</color><color=0xfffffcee>, his extraordinary wisdom and strategy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_10: At that time, the forces of humans, dwarves, and elves were all duchies under the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Joey Empire</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Thanks to </color><color=0xff52c769>Joey Dion</color><color=0xfffffcee>, although the future giant race could no longer achieve the glory of the past, they still performed courageously and strategically in the face of the </color><color=0xffff0000>Negative Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_11: Wait a minute. If I`m not mistaken, both of you are of the human race, right? Why argue endlessly about the praise or criticism of the giant race?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_12: This has nothing to do with any race. This is about respecting history. This is the bottom line as a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>historian</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_13: Well, Halma, I want to know which </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Legends</color><color=0xfffffcee> informed you about this history?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_14: Of course, it`s my brother </color><color=0xff52c769>Norgrode</color><color=0xfffffcee>! He is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>current Supreme Blacksmith</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the dwarves. I believe he has enough wisdom, and our friendship tells me that he would never deceive me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_15: I admit that the author of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Joey Empire</color><color=0xfffffcee> may have exaggerated the giants, but combining it with other historical records, I have reasons to believe that </color><color=0xff52c769>Supreme Blacksmith Norgrode</color><color=0xfffffcee> is completely smearing history out of personal grudges.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_16: I don`t think I can be the notary of this matter. Perhaps I should go find </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> to learn more about the relevant facts.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137201_17: Good! Lady Eloise should be in </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Bird Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>, we`ll be waiting for you here!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137211_1: %s, it`s great to see your strength has improved again! What brings you to me this time?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137212_2: I see. Although I personally lean towards </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s viewpoint, you know that I wasn`t born until </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primevers</color><color=0xfffffcee> arrived, so I can`t provide you with an accurate answer.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137212_4: In my opinion, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>giants, dwarves, and elves</color><color=0xfffffcee>, although they are non-human races, have all made significant contributions to the Positive Facet. There`s no need to rank them as superior or inferior. If you`re interested, I can tell you about the achievements of several great non-human individuals.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137213_1: Unlike humans, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>elves, dwarves, and giants</color><color=0xfffffcee> all have </color><color=0xffdf85e3>long lives</color><color=0xfffffcee>, leading to an interesting but tragic phenomenon. There are many revered leaders among the human race, but among non-human races, there are only a few.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137213_2: So, which individual`s story are you interested in?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137214_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Elradlin</color><color=0xfffffcee> undoubtedly possesses the most noble bloodline among the elves. He was born from the original </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Mother Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee>. To be precise, the Mother Tree deliberately gave birth to him to help the Positive Facet overcome its challenges during a difficult period.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137214_2: Noble, cold, and valuing the community, during the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>early Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, he used his extraordinary magical talents to heal numerous severely wounded heroes. It can be said that without his presence, the Positive Facet would not have been able to endure that most challenging time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137214_3: Unfortunately, he was eventually betrayed by the </color><color=0xffff0000>Naga Queen</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Of course, the Naga Queen was also severely injured in that battle, leading to her intense hatred for the elf race.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137214_4: Do you want to know about someone else`s story?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137215_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Olmir</color><color=0xfffffcee> is undoubtedly a mountain-like presence. Rumor has it that the blood of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Giant King family</color><color=0xfffffcee> flows within him. You should know that the bloodline of the Giant King can only be inherited through </color><color=0xffdf85e3>sacrifice</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and he did not receive the sacrifice of the prehistoric Giant King </color><color=0xff52c769>Joey Dion</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Therefore, Olmir`s origins are incredibly mysterious.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137215_2: Many speculated that he might be a descendant of the original Giant King. He never mentioned his own background, emerging into the world like a shooting star. What left a deep impression on me is that he loved hunting </color><color=0xffff0000>Alien Demons</color><color=0xfffffcee> and always engaged in </color><color=0xffdf85e3>hand-to-hand combat</color><color=0xfffffcee>, displaying extreme ferocity.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137215_3: His death remains a mystery. In his prime, he infiltrated the Negative Facet camp alone. After ambushing and defeating a dozen peers, he returned with a body covered in wounds and in tatters. Upon his return, he did only one thing - </color><color=0xffdf85e3>sacrificed</color><color=0xfffffcee> the bloodline of the Giant King to </color><color=0xff52c769>Yumirael</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137215_4: Do you want to know about someone else`s story?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137216_1: </color><color=0xff52c769>Kazadum</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a complete alcoholic! en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137473_3: How do you view the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Saints</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137473_6: Did I agree to you coming out?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137473_7: Then go ahead, don`t forget, I added this sphere for Dunn.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137473_8: Tch, what`s so great about it? You go, go ahead.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137473_9: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sphere of Saints</color><color=0xfffffcee> is currently the highest Sphere I can define. Saints are beyond ordinary heroes, they are influential figures who can impact the world order. However, it is not unattainable, and I believe the Chosen One is more likely to achieve it. I reached this Sphere myself at the time of my birth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137474_1: Later... in the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>early Dark Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the Negative Facet fiercely invaded, and as the balance was disrupted, the Universe Core continued to shatter, and my power gradually declined.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137474_2: </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> said that since the Dark Era, there has never been a hero who reached the Sphere of Saints. Is that true?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137474_3: Yes, the Saints I know of are only two: one is </color><color=0xff52c769>Primever Ayr</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and the other is </color><color=0xffff0000>Observer Chaos</color><color=0xfffffcee>. But I believe there are even more powerful ancient entities within the abyss of the Negative Facet, unable to awaken for some reason.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137475_1: In my view, </color><color=0xffff0000>Observer Chaos</color><color=0xfffffcee> is stronger than the </color><color=0xffff0000>Ancient Demons</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Sphere of Saints. After all, it can`t escape the suppression of the facet force. In the Positive Facet, it can only exert the power of a Saint. This also explains why Primever Ayr sacrificed himself and could only seal, not annihilate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137475_3: After Primever Ayr descended to the Positive Facet, the balance was disrupted, the Universe Core shattered into countless fragments, and the Facet Portal lost restraints. </color><color=0xff52c769>Ayr</color><color=0xfffffcee> suffered backlash from the facet force and was severely injured. Upon learning of his identity, the prehistoric giant king </color><color=0xff52c769>Joey Dion</color><color=0xfffffcee> showed enough kindness to help Ayr.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137475_4: Ayr regained his strength but found he could no longer return to the Primeval Facet. Meanwhile, the Negative Facet gradually discovered the issue with the Facet Portal. Subsequently, a catastrophe erupted, and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Portal</color><color=0xfffffcee> were pushed open, with countless creatures from the Negative Facet pouring in - </color><color=0xffff0000>demons, beasts, werewolves, naga, undead</color><color=0xfffffcee>...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137475_5: At that time, the Positive Facet was extremely weak, with only a few extraordinary beings. The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>giants</color><color=0xfffffcee>, relying on their innate power and joining forces with </color><color=0xff52c769>Ayr</color><color=0xfffffcee>, temporarily held back the assault from the Negative Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137475_6: In that great calamity, many races went extinct. </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Humans, elves, giants, dwarves</color><color=0xfffffcee> honed themselves through repeated battles. And guided by Ayr, some strong heroes were born. However, after </color><color=0xffff0000>Observer Chaos</color><color=0xfffffcee> arrived, the balance was disrupted once again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137475_7: </color><color=0xff52c769>Primever Ayr</color><color=0xfffffcee> ultimately chose to sacrifice himself, forming shackles with his own soul to seal Chaos. After his death, the primal power dispersed, and the Universe Core rapidly repaired itself. The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Portal</color><color=0xfffffcee> closed again. However, due to the existence of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> couldn`t truly return to perfection.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137476_1: I have thought about destroying that book, but after trying, I found that it cannot be destroyed, as if it possesses wisdom and life.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137477_1: Otherwise, why do you think I would allow someone who likes to contradict me to exist within my body?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137477_2:
So that`s what you think! This is too </color><color=0xffdf85e3>heartless</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
%s, let`s leave it at that. I need to have a discussion with her!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137481_1: How is it, Chosen One? How did </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> say?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137481_2: She said you are a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>foolish genius</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137481_4: She also talked about a lot of historical facts related to the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Disaster Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Don`t you want to hear?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137481_5: Yes, I am a fool. I want to hear!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137482_2: In other words, although the Positive Facet has not produced a saint, there is a chance for a Chosen One from the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>! I understand. So, our deal continues!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137491_1: Chosen One! I`ve noticed that you`ve become more charming lately!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137491_3: Well, can you do me a favor? Okay, since you`ve agreed, I won`t hold back.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137492_1: Oh, a very simple request. I`ll tell you a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>short story</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and you just need to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>comment</color><color=0xfffffcee> on it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137493_1: Rumor has it that before the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Disaster Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, Positive Facet was called the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Twin Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, where all races revered the human race, and Twin City was referred to as the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Holy City</color><color=0xfffffcee> by various races. What`s your opinion on this rumor?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137493_2: My evaluation is also simple. Are you a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>historian</color><color=0xfffffcee> turned </color><color=0xffdf85e3>novelist</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137493_3: That`s right! I also think this record is ridiculous. Give me another one!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137493_4: It is rumored that before entering the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Disaster Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the Twin Facet did not have the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Facet Portal</color><color=0xfffffcee> was wide open, and the dark realm was treated as a training tool. What do you think of this?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137493_5: Well... my evaluation is even simpler. Don`t be too absurd. How is that possible? Is the author traumatized from the battlefield, and then depicted an ideal world in the book?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137493_6: Impressive, Chosen One! It`s exactly what I thought, but... but... this book is called </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Heart of the Saint</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137494_1: Hmm, it`s the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>miscellaneous book</color><color=0xfffffcee> that records Observer </color><color=0xffff0000>Chaos</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Moreover, it also records the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Joey Empire</color><color=0xfffffcee>, so... I suspect that this is an ancient book from </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Disaster Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>. But... some of the stories in the book are too absurd, giving me a contradictory feeling.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137494_2: It`s indeed strange. Why don`t you go ask </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> about it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137494_3: I`ve been waiting for you to say that!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_1: %s, it`s really impressive how strong you`ve become!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_2: Thank you for your praise! Do you know the book </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Heart of the Saint</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_3: I`m not a big fan of reading because life is long enough, and I myself am like a book.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_4: Yes! You do resemble a book, titled </color><color=0xffdf85e3>The Snake and the Farmer</color><color=0xfffffcee>. You...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_5: Hehe, just had a strange guy pop up out of nowhere and startled me. Let`s continue.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_6: Has the balance completely tipped in favor of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>humanity</color><color=0xfffffcee> now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_7: Of course! It`s all thanks to the Chosen One! Let`s continue. Regarding what you just mentioned, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Heart of the Saint</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I don`t know. You can ask the second question now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_8: Uh, I think I`ll chat with that person. I feel like she knows more.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_9: Uh... well, it`s also time for her to come out and get some fresh air!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137501_10: Chosen One, I think we can occasionally discuss some historical issues, okay?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137502_1:
Before you raise questions, try answering mine first.
After learning about </color><color=0xff52c769>Ayr</color><color=0xfffffcee> and the history of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Disaster Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>, do you find it strange that the power disparity between Positive and Negative Facet was so extreme before Primevers` arrival?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137502_2: Hmm... it does seem strange. If the two facets were in balance, then the overall strength of Positive Facet was indeed too weak at that time. This contradicts the content mentioned in </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Heart of the Saint</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137502_3: When I delve into my memories, I find that when the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Universe Core</color><color=0xfffffcee> was born, this land already had various races, languages, and scripts.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137503_1: Yes, I once doubted it, so I sought out the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Mother Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the elves. She said, `</color><color=0xffdf85e3>The human race fell, the dark realm`s magic thoughts backlashed, and entered calamity after twilight</color><color=0xfffffcee>`.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137503_2: Her answer surprised me. If what she said is true, there was indeed a decline in civilization before the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Disaster Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137504_1: Yes, regarding this, I questioned her further, but she only answered me with `</color><color=0xffdf85e3>Eons are changing</color><color=0xfffffcee>`.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137505_1: Hmm, her meaning should be that the human race was once prosperous, but due to corruption leading to the proliferation of demonic thoughts, the Negative Facet retaliated. After a huge catastrophe, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Twilight Eon</color><color=0xfffffcee> ended, and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Calamity Eon</color><color=0xfffffcee> began.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137505_2: So, now we are in the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Calamity Eon</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dawn Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137505_4: Understood, thank you for the information! </color><color=0xff52c769>Dunn</color><color=0xfffffcee> is probably going to slap himself awake when he hears this.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137505_5: Remember to come by for discussions often.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137511_3: Does Eloise really know some prehistoric secrets?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137512_2: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Calamity Eon</color><color=0xfffffcee>... </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dawn Era</color><color=0xfffffcee>? It sounds contradictory. Is history just a cycle?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137512_3: I don`t know, but I think historians should not believe in metaphysics that cannot be explained with facts.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137512_4: I feel a sense of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>destiny</color><color=0xfffffcee> suddenly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137512_5: I want to know, where did this book come from?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137512_6: My grandfather passed it down to me. I`ve heard him mention it. It seems to have come from a fallen noble with the surname `</color><color=0xffdf85e3>Long</color><color=0xfffffcee>`. He used this book to settle a considerable debt.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137512_7: Perhaps, one day, we will know the truth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_137512_8: Well, I look forward to that day.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_13229401_1: Amitabha, young one, I see that you have a deep affinity with Buddhism. Are you willing to take refuge in the Buddhist path?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_13229402_1: Amitabha, esteemed Chosen One, if you are willing to take refuge in the Buddhist path, you can do so like me, without the need for ordination.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_13229404_1: Life is short, and we must enjoy it to the fullest. Let not the golden goblet be empty under the moonlight. Today, we have wine, let`s get drunk. May we remain intoxicated and never wake up. A good poem, a good poem... Hahaha, hiccup...

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_32287_12_1: Yes, there, you will encounter some unprecedented monsters from the Facet Battlefield.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316011_1: Chosen One, nice to meet you for the second time. I didn`t expect you to have the ability to reach the Priest Realm.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316012_1: Identity is not important. I created this realm, so I will sense it when people from another world enter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316012_2: Dunn sent me here. He said that only by completing the ritual here could the gateway to Spheres truly be opened.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316012_3: Dunn... Have you received the covenant he gave you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316012_4: If you`re referring to `Marco`s Travels`, I did receive it. Is there a problem?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316012_5: I glimpsed into the future and got to know that the Ether Spirit in the covenant is about to awaken. I`m not sure if this is good or bad. As you are the Chosen One summoned by Eloise, I feel obligated to warn you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316013_1: Yes, I foresee that the Ether Spirit will be awakened by you. It will be wielding a sword that can intimidate souls, becoming an indispensable ally for you. Currently, these are just vague outlines. Perhaps we see the sword, all puzzles will be unveiled.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316021_1: The wheel of time has begun to turn, and when the sword is filled with golden light, all puzzles will be unveiled.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316111_1: What if the future I foresaw is just an illusion created by the Negative Facet. How would you respond?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316111_2: Weren`t you going to find elves? And this joke is not funny at all.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316111_3: Elf Trahir is in Maple Forest. I`m just curious, as the Chosen One from another world, whether you really care about this world.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316112_1: Yes, after all, you all call me the Chosen One...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316113_1: No, I can switch off my phone...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316114_1: Don`t worry, I don`t want you to feel pressured. You are a traveler from another world, unlike the races here, who have no choice.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316115_1: Well, I`m going to find Elf Trahir now. I hope everything goes smoothly from now on!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316121_1: Chosen One, I foresaw that you will soon have your own Ether Spirit.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316211_1: Chosen One, it seems my previous worries were unnecessary. Enigma Domains are not a plot of the Negative Facet, and you have successfully awakened the Ether Spirit.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316211_3: Optimistic... I have witnessed too many tragedies. All experiences have taught me that optimism only numbs the heart.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316212_1: Let`s change a topic. Did Eloise tell you about the anomalies in Enigma Domains?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316213_1: Yes, compared to other half facets, Enigma Domains appear to be extremely vast, with layers of internal spaces for exploration. I foresee that the Chosen One will gain more benefits in Enigma Domains, but...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316213_3: Yes, Eloise will go deep into Enigma Domains to investigate the source of the danger. I hope you can enhance your strength as soon as possible. Perhaps when you are stronger, I can foresee more accurate scenes.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316221_1: The wheel of time has begun to turn. Chosen One, strive to level up, and I will foresee more accurate scenes.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316311_1: Chosen One, the change of the times is approaching.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316312_1: The Chosen One will truly become the hope of saving the Positive Facet. In the future, ordinary heroes will not be able to compete in this world.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316312_2: Why? Is it because of the Ether Spirit?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316312_3: Yes, although ordinary heroes can also open the gateway to Spheres, they cannot acquire the precious Covenant. And the Covenant is key to nurturing the Ether Spirit. Without the Ether Spirit, ordinary heroes cannot use the Ehtersuit.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316313_1: In addition, Eloise has made a new discovery during her visit to Enigma Domains.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316314_1: There are minerals imbued with a large amount of power in Enigma Domains. Have you not noticed them while exploring Enigma Domains?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316315_1: I think that they will be helpful to you. Frankly, I am looking forward to it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316321_1: Chosen One, I foresaw that you will soon have the ability to use the Ethercore.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316411_1: Chosen One, your growth rate is astonishing. Things are happening as I foresaw. You awakened the Ether Spirit, received Eloise`s help, obtained the Ethersuit, and then acquired the Ethercore with Bell`s assistance.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316411_3: I foresaw that a crisis is looming... Well, maybe I should be more optimistic, as you say...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316411_4: Let`s not talk about this. The discovery of the Ethersuit and Ethercore is good for the Positive Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316412_1: Bell has prepared some rewards for you, as a token of gratitude for your contributions to the discoveries.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_1316413_1: Before the crisis arrives, I will lead the Positive Facet in preparing countermeasures, and I hope you will keep going.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050012_1:
I`m the Elf Saintess, </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve Trahir</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you can just call me Eve.
It comes to another Anniversary Revelry. If I remember correctly, it`s the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>21st</color><color=0xfffffcee> year since you arrived, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050013_1: Well, for this grand revelry, </color><color=0xff52c769>Lady Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> and I have been preparing for a long time. How do you find the decorations on </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Blank Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050014_1: Thank you! There`s something I`d like your help, concerning the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Brume Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee> beneath Blank Island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050015_1: The soul of </color><color=0xff52c769>Brume King</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Brume Realm has been damaged, and the reason is currently unknown. I hope you can accompany me in exploring the truth. This journey may be quite challenging.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050021_1: Currently, all other islands are covered in mist, so it looks like we`ll have to explore </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Giant Tree Island</color><color=0xffebe0d4> first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050031_1: According to </color><color=0xff52c769>Lady Eloise</color><color=0xffebe0d4>, we need something called </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Driving Power</color><color=0xffebe0d4> to operate the airship.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050031_2: As for how to obtain the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Driving Power</color><color=0xffebe0d4>, Lady Eloise said that the Chosen One will figure it out. So, let`s set off towards Giant Tree Island!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050041_1: I am Giant Tree Island`s priest Bertram. Welcome.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050041_2: Did you know we were coming?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050041_3: Yes, Chosen One. I have received the message from the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Life Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee>, welcoming distant visitors here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050042_1: The Life Tree is an offspring of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Mother Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and I have been serving the ancient tree all my life, listening to its teachings.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050042_2: Mother Tree? No wonder I feel so familiar here. But how is this possible? The Mother Tree of the Elven Forest cannot be destroyed, and there is no record of its branches.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050043_1: I am the Elf Saintess, and you can call me Eve. Our main purpose for coming here is to investigate the cause of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>mist tides</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Brume Realm. This happens during the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Anniversary Revelry</color><color=0xfffffcee> of CO in Positive Facet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050043_3: Yes, the mist in Brume Realm is influencing the climate of Blank Island, and the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Anniversary Revelry</color><color=0xfffffcee> cannot be terminated because of this. So, </color><color=0xff52c769>Lady Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> has commissioned us to investigate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050043_4: I see. Please follow me to the treehouse. We can discuss it further there.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050044_1: So, what exactly is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Brume Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee>? What are the mist tides? And what is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Mother Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050044_2: Chosen One, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Brume Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee> is composed of hundreds of islands. Except for the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Giant Tree Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> that we are on, all other islands are covered in mist. The Giant Tree Island is spared because it is under the protection of the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Life Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050044_3: Saintess </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee>, I learned that the ancient Elf King once brought the Elf Flower here. Perhaps since then, the Life Tree has taken root here.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050044_4: I see. Lady Eloise mentioned that the mist tide is a climate phenomenon caused by </color><color=0xffdf85e3>nature spirits</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Bertram, do you know the details?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050045_1: It talks about the </color><color=0xff52c769>Brume King</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the Summoner of Storms and Mist, the Peace-loving </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Ocean Elf</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050046_1: I see! I once read that the Mother Tree was born in the forest, with the body of a spirit, empowered by faith, nurturing the Elf Race. I think the Brume King, as mentioned by </color><color=0xff52c769>Bertram</color><color=0xfffffcee>, is a similar entity to the Mother Tree.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050047_1: The mist has sealed off the sea, making boats unable to reach other islands. However, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>airship</color><color=0xfffffcee> can navigate through the clouds. The elder priest has asked you to transport the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Aquamarines</color><color=0xfffffcee> to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lighthouse Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>, where </color><color=0xff52c769>Old Cole</color><color=0xfffffcee> can disperse the mist.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050048_1: The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Aquamarine</color><color=0xfffffcee> is the energy source used by the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lighthouse Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> to disperse the mist. The mist spread too quickly this time, covering the entire area overnight. The Aquamarines stored on the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Giant Tree Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> couldn`t be sent to the Lighthouse Island in time, leading to a complete disconnection between islands.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050048_2: Bertram, I heard from Lady Eloise that the Brume Realm was also covered in mist last year, but it didn`t affect Blank Island. Do you know why?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050048_3: The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Life Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee> hasn`t provided any clues on this matter. I`ve hardly left the island in my life, so my knowledge is limited and I can`t answer your questions. Perhaps the more experienced </color><color=0xff52c769>Old Cole</color><color=0xfffffcee> might.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050048_4: Alright then, Chosen One, let`s set off towards </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lighthouse Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050051_1: Chosen One, you have completed the initial exploration of </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Giant Tree Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Every subsequent exploration will increase your </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Exploration Degree</color><color=0xfffffcee> by 10 points. Achieving a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>good ending</color><color=0xfffffcee> will earn you a star while increasing your Exploration Degree by 20 points.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050051_2: Each island has an Exploration Degree. When your Exploration Degree reaches 100, you can receive </color><color=0xffdf85e3>additional rewards</color><color=0xfffffcee>. If you can unlock all endings on all islands, you can receive </color><color=0xffdf85e3>generous rewards</color><color=0xfffffcee> from the islanders.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_1: Crossing through the thick gray mist, you arrived at a vast valley. You are very close to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lighthouse Ruins</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_2: As mentioned by the </color><color=0xff52c769>Tree Presbyter</color><color=0xfffffcee>, </color><color=0xff52c769>Old Cole</color><color=0xfffffcee> would be waiting for us in the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>valley</color><color=0xfffffcee> below the Lighthouse Ruins. Why don`t we see anyone around?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_3: He should be around here somewhere. Bertram wouldn`t deceive us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_4: An old man is slowly approaching from a distance.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_5:
Traveler, good, earlier than me.
Let`s go to the ruins for our chat.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_7: Your way of speaking is really strange.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_8:
Cole guards Lighthouse Island. This mist is tricky.
Danger is approaching. We should go to the ruins.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_9: I didn`t quite understand what he was saying, but let`s go to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lighthouse Ruins</color><color=0xfffffcee>. These </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Aquamarines</color><color=0xfffffcee> were entrusted to us by </color><color=0xff52c769>Bertram</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_11: You three enter the interior of the lighthouse ruins.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_12: The grandeur of the architecture is no less impressive than the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Secret Zone</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Elf Race.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_13: Yes, even in ruins, one can tell that this place must have been truly magnificent at its inception.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_14:
The lighthouse was built in ancient times, </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Blank Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> was given aid.
As for the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Aquamarines</color><color=0xfffffcee>, Cole will go and place them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_15: So it is a relic of the ancient civilization on Blank Island. You go first.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_16: Soon after, Old Cole returns to the interior of the ruins, looking dejected.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_17: How is it? Has the mist been dispersed?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050061_18:
The light of the lighthouse shines, but the mist has not been dispersed.
The light of the lighthouse seems to have angered the </color><color=0xffff0000>Brume King</color><color=0xfffffcee>, leaving Old Cole feeling helpless.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_1: At the entrance of the ruins came a crisp voice of rebuke, `</color><color=0xffff0000>Cole</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you bastard! Didn`t I tell you not to use the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Aquamarine</color><color=0xfffffcee> anymore?`
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_2: I told you, the last time you used the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Aquamarine</color><color=0xfffffcee> to light up the light of the lighthouse, you already awakened the will of the </color><color=0xff52c769>Brume King</color><color=0xfffffcee>. With the Brume King`s current state, do you want to kill the people of other islands too?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_3: Old Cole didn`t mean to anger the </color><color=0xffff0000>Brume King</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Old Cole just wanted to restore the glory of the lighthouse.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_4: Enough! My lovely islanders were killed because of you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_6: What? Huh? An </color><color=0xffff0000>inferior elf</color><color=0xfffffcee> with long ears? Are you travelers from another world?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_7: Long ears? Inferior elf? You, </color><color=0xffff0000>little girl</color><color=0xfffffcee>, have quite the audacity!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_8: Little girl? I`ve been alive for 1,400 years, and it`s the first time someone has dared to call me that!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050062_9: Then, I`ve been alive for 10,000 years! Come on, open your mouth, let me see if your baby teeth have fallen out yet!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_1: Boom! A loud noise came from outside the ruins, and the entire </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lighthouse Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> seemed to tremble.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_2: Oh crap! The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Brume King 7-Light</color><color=0xfffffcee> has revived! Stay here and don`t go out!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_3: </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee> obviously wouldn`t listen to a seemingly young girl. The three of you followed her to the valley.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_4: What`s going on? An earthquake? What is the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Brume King 7-Light</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_5:
The Brume King 7-Light is both the soul and the will. Even after death, it can influence the kingdom`s situation.
This is a </color><color=0xffff0000>curse</color><color=0xfffffcee>, this is a </color><color=0xffff0000>curse</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_6: In the center of the valley, a giant </color><color=0xffff0000>octopus</color><color=0xfffffcee> loomed before everyone, with </color><color=0xff52c769>Lyna</color><color=0xfffffcee> in front of it appearing as tiny as an ant. Strangely, the two seemed to be in a standoff.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_7: Which part of the Brume King do you represent?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_9: </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Sense and adaptation</color><color=0xfffffcee>? Then will your questions next be related to </color><color=0xffdf85e3>astrology</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_10:
Yes.
Why will Gemini never be lonely?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_11: Because they are good at socializing?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_12: No, because they always have two of themselves together. Answering the question incorrectly comes with a cost: death.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_13: The octopus, massive as a mountain, lightly waved its tentacles, causing </color><color=0xff52c769>Lyna</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s face to turn pale.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_14:
Next question.
Will I have health problems?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050063_15: (How did it get to the fortune-telling question?) You...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050064_1: No, you won`t have health problems.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050064_5: The giant </color><color=0xffff0000>octopus</color><color=0xfffffcee> disappeared. The light of the lighthouse gradually dispelled the mist surrounding the island.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050064_6: Traveler, do you know what you just did?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050065_1: Do you realize you nearly met your end just now? Answering the </color><color=0xff52c769>Brume King</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s question incorrectly would have erased your soul on the spot. When the Brume King 7-Light appeared on </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rift Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>, many islanders turned into mindless zombies due to wrong answers.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050065_2: </color><color=0xffff0000>Little girl</color><color=0xfffffcee>, worry about yourself. </color><color=0xff52c769>Lady Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> once said that the souls of Chosen Ones reside in the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Primeval Facet</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and there are merely their consciousnesses here, so they won`t be harmed.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050065_3: So, this Chosen One is the best candidate to save this sea area! By the way, </color><color=0xffff0000>Long Ears</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you mentioned </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> just now. Is she the World Priestess?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050065_4: Yes, </color><color=0xffff0000>little girl</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I was commissioned by the </color><color=0xff52c769>World Priestess</color><color=0xfffffcee> to investigate the cause of the mist invading Blank Island. The Chosen One was also invited by me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050065_5: Great, Chosen One, let`s hurry to the next island. This </color><color=0xffff0000>inferior elf</color><color=0xfffffcee> with long ears seems useless. Just go back to </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Blank Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050066_1:
This is the </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf Saintess</color><color=0xfffffcee> from the Positive Facet. Please show some respect.
(Eve, it seems that Lyna is not just an ordinary girl. Let`s stop arguing now.)
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050066_2: Alright then. </color><color=0xff52c769>Old Cole</color><color=0xfffffcee>, from now on, light up the lighthouse with the Aquamarine every once in a while. These two and I will go to other islands to deal with the </color><color=0xff52c769>Brume King 7-Light</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Is that okay?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050066_3: Old Cole understands, Elder of Rift, rest assured.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050071_1: Chosen One, the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Lighthouse Island</color><color=0xfffffcee> has been activated. Next, every time you dispel the mist on an island, it helps the lighthouse </color><color=0xffdf85e3>level</color><color=0xfffffcee> up once.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050071_2: After the lighthouse level increases, you may participate in the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>lottery</color><color=0xfffffcee> ritual of Brume Realm. Why not give it a try?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050081_1: </color><color=0xffff0000>Long Ears</color><color=0xfffffcee>, you mentioned earlier that the soul of the Chosen One will not be attacked, is that true?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050081_2: The </color><color=0xff52c769>Elf King</color><color=0xfffffcee> once said that the Elf Race was only referred to as Long Ears by some hostile races in ancient times, so, </color><color=0xffff0000>little girl</color><color=0xfffffcee>, who are you really?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050081_3: The environment of the Ancestor Island has become so harsh, </color><color=0xffff0000>Long Ears</color><color=0xfffffcee>, do you know why?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050081_4: </color><color=0xffff0000>Little girl</color><color=0xfffffcee>, do you know you`re being noisy?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_1: Stop arguing and let`s do a formal self-introduction!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_2: Alright, I`m Lyna, the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rift Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Elder of Rift</color><color=0xfffffcee>. A few days ago, the sea was suddenly covered in mist. Initially, no one paid much attention, but when the light of the lighthouse illuminated the mist, the </color><color=0xff52c769>Brume King 7-Light</color><color=0xfffffcee> appeared on </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Rift Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Anyone encountering it needs to answer questions, and a wrong answer means death. I passed through the mist to warn </color><color=0xff52c769>Old Cole</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and you all know what happened next.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_3: I`m </color><color=0xff52c769>Eve</color><color=0xfffffcee>, the Elf Saintess of the Positive Facet. Recently, we`re holding a Positive Facet`s </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Anniversary Revelry</color><color=0xfffffcee> on Blank Island, the mist from the Brume Realm seems to be affecting </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Blank Island</color><color=0xfffffcee>. </color><color=0xff52c769>Lady Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> commissioned me to investigate this matter. So, </color><color=0xffff0000>little girl</color><color=0xfffffcee>, what is this Elder of Rift you mentioned?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_4: You answer my question first, </color><color=0xffff0000>LONG EARS!</color><color=0xfffffcee> Or I`ll turn you into a </color><color=0xffff0000>gorilla</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_5: Oh? Cute </color><color=0xffff0000>little stupid girl</color><color=0xfffffcee>, why don`t you turn me into a </color><color=0xffff0000>gorilla</color><color=0xfffffcee> then?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_6: (Evil grin) </color><color=0xff52c769>Elder of Rift</color><color=0xfffffcee> fulfills your wish.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_7: With a bang, the graceful elf girl standing beside you turns into a brown-furred gorilla.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050082_9: </color><color=0xffff0000>Long Ears</color><color=0xfffffcee> becomes a gorilla. Much better now.
