en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050135_33:
The giant octopus disappeared. The lighthouse`s light shone through, dispersing the mist.
Seven beams of various colors rose from the seven islands, converging to form a huge ball of light. The ball of light flew off into the distance until only the sea and sky remained in view.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050135_35: Hmm, Brume King has already departed.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050135_37: I`m fine. From today on, Brume Tribe will no longer be under </color><color=0xff52c769>Brume King</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s protection. Warn all the nobles: if anyone is dissatisfied, I, Selna, will accept any challenge. Whoever has the ability to defeat me can take the throne!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050135_38: </color><color=0xff52c769>Long Ears</color><color=0xfffffcee>, look, that`s a true saintess. And then look at you, tsk tsk.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050135_40:
</color><color=0xff52c769>Chosen One</color><color=0xfffffcee>, on behalf of the Brume Realm, Selna would like to thank you for your contributions along the way.
</color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Brume Realm</color><color=0xfffffcee> will always welcome you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_33050136_1: Chosen One, it`s time for us to leave as well.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59782_1: Let me introduce myself formally. I`m Cassandra, captain of the Fifth Squad of the Half Facet Exploration Team.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59783_1: Recently, our exploration team discovered a mysterious overlapping Half Facet in the Facet Rift. Through the introduction of Lady Eloise, we have made contact with many heroes.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59784_1: The so-called overlapping Half Facet is where numerous identical Half Facets overlap, allowing outsiders with the same `key` to enter the same space. Due to this feature, many organizations have been eyeing the overlapping Half Facet lately.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59785_1: Yes, you can think of it as a qualification certificate. For example, the Yagakbu organization`s key is a silver dagger, and the Ethercore Alliance`s key is a colorful stone. These organizations all hope to have a private base of their own.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59785_2: So, what`s your purpose in coming to me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59785_3: I heard that heroes would form guilds among themselves. This overlapping Half Facet we discovered might become your Guild Camp.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59786_1: Yes. Lady Eloise is discussing this matter with leaders of different races. Once concluded, heroes might help build the site together. Prepare yourself during its clearance phase.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59791_1: I have good news to share with you. Lady Eloise and the leaders of various races have decided that a portion of the overlapping Half Facet will be allocated as the site for guild camps! This will bring many benefits to guilds.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59792_1: Of course! Let`s head to the overlapping Half Facet first. Once you go in and see it, you`ll understand.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59801_1: Welcome to the overlapping Half Facet! When we first found this space, it was all ruins and debris. However, after the transformation by the dwarf craftsmen, it has begun to take shape. Come, let me show you around.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59803_1: The three areas I introduced to you just now will be the functional areas of the future Guild Camp. I have selected several team members as temporary administrators of these areas. When the time comes, you can chat with them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59804_1: There is something I have to remind you about.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59805_1: The overlapping spaces will affect each other. For example, if you destroy the statue here, the statues in other overlapping spaces will also be damaged as a result. So, as a member of the guild, please take care of the public facilities.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59806_1: Why would I lie to you? Next, you may find that the originally intact floor suddenly cracks, or monsters suddenly appear in the empty hall... These are all effects caused by other overlapping spaces.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59807_1: Next, you can go to the temporary administrators to learn more information. If you have any questions, you can always come to me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59811_1: Hello. I`m Ga Wain, deputy captain of the Fifth Squad of the Half Facet Exploration Team.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59812_1: I served in the Facet Battlefield for six years, as a ranger, my main duty was to guard our homeland. Since you are trusted by Knight Cassandra, I hope to entrust you with a monster hunting task together.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59813_1: Precisely, any threat to the overlapping Half Facet. The World Priestess foresaw a monster invasion. Heroes must protect the camp and hunt them down.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59814_1: The overlapping Half Facet was discovered not long ago, and only sporadic monsters have entered here. You just need to assist us in clearing out the monsters regularly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59815_1: So, will you accept my task?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59816_1: Of course. The guardians of the Positive Facet never leave empty-handed. Since the deal is settled, you can go to Miss Margaret to learn about logistics matters. I`ll assign separate tasks to you for future monster clearing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59821_1: Hello. I`m Margaret, in charge of logistics management of the First Squad of the Half Facet Exploration Team. Nice to meet you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59822_1: Yes, the Half Facet Exploration Team has a total of seven squads. My captain retired officially not long ago. I heard that Captain Cassandra of the Fifth Squad is short of manpower, so I came over to help.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59823_1: What exactly is the Half Facet Exploration Team? Why have I never heard of it before?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59823_2: The Half Facet Exploration Team is responsible for exploring unknown Half Facets. We mainly operate on the edge of the Positive Facet`s unknown, as those places are easier to find Half Facet passages. So, it`s normal that you haven`t heard of us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59823_4: It`s to provide an escape route for the Positive Facet. In case the Facet Battlefield collapses, it won`t completely annihilate the civilization that has lasted until now.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59824_1: Haha, spot-on! This time I asked you to come mainly for two things. First, I`ll host crowdfunded banquets regularly after the construction. I`ve already made a rough plan, and you can come and participate then.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59825_1: As for the second thing... it sounds strange, but the infrastructure of the overlapping Half Facet always inexplicably gets damaged. I hope you can accept my commission to help with the repairs.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59825_2: Um... no problem. Cassandra may know the reason for the damage to public facilities. You can go ask her.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59825_3: I see. Anyway, thanks for your help. If there are places that need repair in the future, I`ll commission you separately. You can now go to Theodore Rick. It seems he also has something to entrust.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59831_1: Hey, you`re still as lively as ever.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59832_1: Of course not. But I often hear `Chosen One` heroes from my friends on Bird Island! Haha!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59833_1: Unlike Yagakbu, I harbor no hostility towards heroes like you. I`m here for business.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59833_2: Interesting. And how should I address you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59833_3: Sorry, forgot to introduce myself. I`m Theodore Rick, responsible for external relations in the Half Facet Exploration Team`s fifth squad.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59833_4: Hello, Theodore Rick! Margaret mentioned you have a task for me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59833_5: Certainly! Our squad has struck a deal with the Ethercore Alliance to hunt monsters in Enigma Domains. Interested?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59834_1: Absolutely! The Ethercore Alliance will reward with drop buffs for Enigma Domains!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59835_1: Great! Remember, the deal activates post-Guild Camp construction. I`ll find other rewards during that period. Okay?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59836_1: Alright! That`s settled then. If we need to hunt monsters next, I`ll commission you separately.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59841_1: Have you met the three temporary administrators?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59842_1: What do you think of them?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59843_1: Thank you for your approval. Though temporary, I`ve handpicked them. At least, their integrity can be assured.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59845_1: I`m sorry they left a bad impression. Ga Wain is traditional, Margaret is clueless, and Theodore Rick is a slick trader. But their integrity is assured.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59846_1: Rest assured, since the higher-ups decided to allocate a portion of the overlapping Half Facet as the site for guild camps. As the discoverer, I`ll take full responsibility.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59846_2: Once the Guild Camp is completed, I`ll open an exclusive shop. Quality rewards will be offered based on heroes` contributions to their guild and Guild Camp.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59847_1: When will the Guild Camp be completed?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59847_2: Very soon! But if you actively complete my daily tasks, I believe the construction speed will greatly accelerate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59851_1: There`s a group of monsters in the Guild Camp. The Fifth Squad is short-handed. Can you help us clear out these pests?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59871_1: The Guild Camp is a mess again. I`m busy organizing the banquet rules. Please help repair the camp.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_59911_1: The Ethercore Alliance has sent a new task application. Currently, we are short of manpower. Would you like to try it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_36863_11_1:
Hey, long time no see!
Welcome to the Guild Camp, my dear Chosen One.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_36863_12_1: Yes, the Ethercore Alliance has entrusted me with handling the Enigma Domains Buff transactions. I think we`ll be seeing each other quite often. So, it`s only right to get to know each other now, don`t you think?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_36863_13_1: Of course, there are also official matters! The Hunting Ground in your Guild Hall is also funded by the Ethercore Alliance... In fact, the Hunting Ground level determines the number of times the Enigma Domains Buffs can be exchanged. So, don`t forget to remind your Guild members to upgrade the Guild Buildings on time!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_36863_14_1:
That`s all, I hope your Guild continues to thrive.
(That way, I can make more profit too! Haha!)
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_26411_1: Hehehe, where did this wild brat come from? I`m gonna capture you and tame you into a battle pet!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_26412_1: Please have mercy, spare me! I`m willing to offer up my lifelong treasures!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_26412_2: A few chopping knives? Such a poor dragon.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_26413_1: Humph, you`re too weak to be my battle pet. Come back after a few more years of training.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_26413_2: Never underestimate a young adventurer`s potential!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8051001_1:
You are the first guest to Moon Palace, welcome!
May I ask, would you be willing to help us prepare for the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Moon Palace Celebration</color><color=0xfffffcee>? During the preparation, you will not only get familiar with the Moon Palace, but also receive many gifts from </color><color=0xff52c769>Chang`e</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8051002_1:
(Laughing) I knew you were kind-hearted!
We are going to make some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>osmanthus tea</color><color=0xfffffcee>, which requires </color><color=0xffdf85e3>fresh osmanthus flowers</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xffdf85e3>new tea leaves</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Please help us gather them!
</color><color=0xff52c769>Wu Kang</color><color=0xfffffcee> has plenty of fresh osmanthus flowers, and </color><color=0xff52c769>Moon Granny</color><color=0xfffffcee> should have the new tea leaves. They are both in Moon Palace, so you should be able to find them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8108001_1:
So it`s for making osmanthus tea. No problem!
These osmanthus flowers are very fresh. Take them to </color><color=0xff52c769>Fairy Magpie</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8109001_1:
You`ve come for the tea leaves, right? </color><color=0xff52c769>Magpie</color><color=0xfffffcee> already told me about this. I`ve already roasted the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>new tea leaves</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Take them now!
Remember to tell Magpie that this tea should not be brewed with boiling water. Just use warm water. And don`t forget to bring me a bottle when it`s done!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8052001_1: You`re here early today! I`m preparing to make tea. Would you like to help?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_8052001_1_1: What do you need me to do?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8052002_1:
The process of making osmanthus tea seems simple, but its rich aroma comes from fine ingredients.
We must use </color><color=0xffdf85e3>water from the Moon Pool</color><color=0xfffffcee>, boil it and cook the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>osmanthus flowers</color><color=0xfffffcee> until they change color. When the water cools to warm, add the tea leaves and let them steep. That`s how we fill the entire </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Moon Palace</color><color=0xfffffcee> with the fragrance.
Now, please go to the Moon Pool and fetch some water for me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8112001_1:
It is indeed the water from the Moon Pool. Now, what we are missing is </color><color=0xffdf85e3>firewood</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
</color><color=0xff52c769>Wu Kang</color><color=0xfffffcee> chops trees every day. It should be easy to ask him for some firewood!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8113001_1:
Firewood? No problem!
Take these firewood to </color><color=0xff52c769>Magpie</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8144001_1:
Now I can start making tea!
Thank you so much. Now you can have a rest and wait for the fragrant tea!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8144002_1:
Today`s work is done.
We`ll probably need your help in the future. Please get some rest and come back tomorrow!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8053001_1:
You`re just in time! I went to check the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>osmanthus tea</color><color=0xfffffcee> today and found it had been stolen!
Look at these scattered tea leaves on the ground!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8053002_1: The spilled tea on the ground should lead you to the </color><color=0xffff0000>thief</color><color=0xfffffcee>! Please catch it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8114001_1: It`s a fat gorilla. Teach it a lesson so it won`t dare to steal again!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8115001_1:
I knew it! It`s notorious for being a glutton in Moon Palace. Today you taught him a lesson, he should behave for a while.
But now you`ll have to come back tomorrow.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8054001_1: Try this! How does it taste?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8054002_1: You really know about tea! I remember you said you`d bring some osmanthus tea to </color><color=0xff52c769>Moon Granny</color><color=0xfffffcee> when it`s ready. I`ve already packed a pot for you. Go ahead and deliver it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8116001_1:
So it`s ready already? You are so capable! Let me taste it!
(Tasting...)
Mmm... not bad! </color><color=0xffdf85e3>The aroma is rich, and it`s slightly sweet!</color><color=0xfffffcee> </color><color=0xff52c769>Magpie</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s skills are still so good! Thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8117001_1:
</color><color=0xff52c769>Moon Granny</color><color=0xfffffcee> is an expert of tea. It`s not easy to get a compliment from her!
You also deserve credit for this osmanthus tea. Drink more!
By the way, it`s time to start making </color><color=0xffdf85e3>mooncakes</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Remember to come and help tomorrow!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8055001_1: One of the customs of the Moon Palace celebration is eating mooncakes. Today I plan to make </color><color=0xffdf85e3>custard mooncakes</color><color=0xfffffcee>. What flavor do you like?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8055002_1:
That`s great! I`m making the crust now. Please help me find some eggs to make the filling.
Moon Palace has a flock of </color><color=0xffff0000>Coo Chickens</color><color=0xfffffcee>, whose eggs are especially large. Please fetch a few for me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8055003_1: I can teleport you directly to the </color><color=0xffff0000>Coo Chickens</color><color=0xfffffcee> . Teleport now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8119001_1: You`re covered in feathers and dust. Go clean up. See you tomorrow!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8056001_1: Oh, you`re just in time. Try this freshly made custard mooncake!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8056002_1: This batch of custard mooncakes turned out especially well. The whole Moon Palace is filled with its aroma!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8056003_1:
Today we`re making </color><color=0xffdf85e3>abalone mooncakes</color><color=0xfffffcee>, so we have both sweet and salty flavors!
I need some marinated abalones from </color><color=0xff52c769>Bell</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Help me get some from her!
By the way, bring her some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>custard mooncakes</color><color=0xfffffcee> as a gift!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8120001_1: I could smell the mooncake aroma from afar! Let me taste it! I`m so hungry!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8120002_1:
This mooncake is so milky and fragrant, and the salted yolk is also very smooth! </color><color=0xff52c769>Magpie</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s skills are outstanding!
I heard she`s making </color><color=0xffdf85e3>abalone mooncakes</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I`ve already prepared some marinated abalones for her. Take them to her!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8121001_1:
Bell is so generous! The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>abalones</color><color=0xfffffcee> look top-notch!
Thank you for today. Come back tomorrow to taste the mooncakes!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8057001_1: You`re finally here. Hurry to stop them!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8057002_1:
It is normal that some like sweet mooncakes and some like salty ones. But they`re fighting over it!
What a mess!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8123001_1:
You did the right thing! These people are unreasonable. Driving them away is the best solution!
Thanks to you, my mooncakes weren`t ruined!
Have a rest. See you </color><color=0xffdf85e3>tomorrow</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8058001_1: Today we start delivering mooncakes. You`ll have to make a few trips!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8058002_1:
Moon Granny and Chang`e like </color><color=0xffdf85e3>custard mooncakes</color><color=0xfffffcee>; Wu Kang likes </color><color=0xffdf85e3>abalone mooncakes</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
Please deliver corresponding mooncakes to them!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8125001_1: Magpie`s mooncakes are the best. What flavor did you bring me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8125002_1: I love custard mooncake the most! Thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8125003_1: Abalone mooncake is too greasy. I don`t really like it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8126001_1: These specially made mooncakes are rare. Today I finally get to taste them. What flavor did you bring me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8126002_1: Custard Mooncake is my favorite flavor. </color><color=0xff52c769>Magpie</color><color=0xfffffcee> really knows me. Thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8126003_1: Abalone Mooncake is too greasy. I don`t like it much!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8126004_1: I still prefer Custard Mooncake. Thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8127001_1: I was just thinking about when I could have some mooncakes, and you brought them to me. What flavor did you bring me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8127002_1: Custard Mooncake is too sweet. I don`t really like it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8127003_1: Abalone Mooncake is really delicious! Thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8127004_1: Abalone Mooncake is still the best! Thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8128001_1: Thank you! I`m sure everyone is satisfied with this year`s mooncakes, right?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8128002_1: Thank you for the compliment! Here`s a gift prepared by Chang`e. Please accept it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8059001_1:
All the lanterns I made have been taken.
But no worries, let`s make a new one!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8059002_1:
Don`t worry. I know how to make them! Just help me gather some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>materials</color><color=0xfffffcee> for the lantern, and I`ll do the rest!
Don`t you trust my craftsmanship? (grinning)
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8059003_1:
First, find some bamboo for me. I`ll use it to make the lantern frame.
Bamboo doesn`t grow in Moon Palace, but </color><color=0xff52c769>Immortal Zhang</color><color=0xfffffcee> has traveled far and wide, collecting many rare treasures. He must have </color><color=0xffdf85e3>bamboo</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8129001_1: What a coincidence! I just brought back a lot of good bamboos! Take some to use!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8129002_1: My pleasure. Just remember to give me a lantern when it`s done!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8130001_1:
This bamboo is really good. </color><color=0xff52c769>Immortal Zhang</color><color=0xfffffcee> is generous!
Next, I`ll start making the lantern frame. Come back tomorrow to help me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8060001_1: Take a look at the lantern frame. Isn`t it beautiful?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8060002_1:
Exactly! I made the frame in the shape of little Jade Rabbit.
With the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>frame</color><color=0xfffffcee> done, we now need </color><color=0xffdf85e3>candles</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Ordinary candles burn out quickly, but the candle made from the oil of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Moon Firefly</color><color=0xfffffcee> can burn for a hundred years!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8060003_1: So please go get some </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Moon Firefly`s oil</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Moon Fireflies are very rare. Please be gentle!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8131001_1: Let me teleport you near the Moon Fireflies!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8132001_1: Great, all the materials are ready. Tomorrow you`ll have your own lantern!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8132002_1: You`re welcome! I`ll start making the lantern. Come back tomorrow to get your lantern!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8061001_1: Look, do you like this Jade Rabbit lantern?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8061002_1:
I`m glad you like it. Now you have your own lantern. Go have fun!
By the way, I heard </color><color=0xff52c769>Bell</color><color=0xfffffcee> organized a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Lantern Riddle event</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Go join in the fun!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8133001_1:
I`ve heard you`re quite talented. Today`s </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Lantern Riddle</color><color=0xfffffcee> will be a good chance for you to show off!
These lanterns have riddles on them. Go give it a try!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8134001_1:
A swimming expert, quacking all the way. As a child, it has a tail but no feet, as an adult, it has feet but no tail.
What animal is it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8134002_1: Congratulations, you got it right! Keep guessing!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8135001_1:
Red cheeks, round and cute. Give it a kiss, crisp and sweet!
What fruit is it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8136001_1:
Not scallion, not garlic, layer upon layer wrapped in purple.
What vegetable is it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8145001_1:
Lantern Riddle is just for fun. Enjoy yourself!
Tomorrow we`ll have </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Lantern Floating</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Remember to join us!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8062001_1: Look how beautiful the Milky Way is! Lights flicker, stars twinkle!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8062002_1: Go float a lantern, and then make a wish. You`ll surely be safe and smooth in the future!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8138001_1:
We`ve drunk osmanthus tea, eaten mooncakes, and floated lanterns. This </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Moon Palace celebration</color><color=0xfffffcee> is perfect.
Now there`s only one last event left. Come back tomorrow and you`ll find out!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8063001_1:
Moon Worship is very ancient. We pray to the moon for blessings, hoping to receive its protection.
But this ceremony hasn`t been held for many years. </color><color=0xff52c769>Chang`e</color><color=0xfffffcee> wants to revive the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Moon Worship</color><color=0xfffffcee> this year, so we must prepare well.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8063002_1: For the Moon Worship, we need to prepare fresh flowers and fruits. Please gather some for us!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8064001_1: You dressed up so nicely today!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8064002_1: Everything is ready. We can start the Moon Worship now. Please stand within the circle, and bathe in the power of the Moon.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8142001_1: The Moon Worship has ended successfully. All this wouldn`t be possible without your help. May you be safe and smooth in the future!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8139001_1: Next, let`s gather some more </color><color=0xffdf85e3>fresh fruits</color><color=0xfffffcee>!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_8141001_1: Thank you! Once we finish setting up the ceremony site, we can hold the Moon Worship tomorrow. Remember to come!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_88312_3: Him? Their bloodline is an aberrant branch of the Mochizuki Family. Our family has produced Ninjas for generations. Only their line seems to have mutated blood, unable to adapt to the physical modifications required of Ninjas.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_88312_4: I see. Could you elaborate on the Susanoo Trial you mentioned?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_88312_6: The Susanoo Trial has a fearsome name in the Ninja world, Battlefield of Despair. To the strong, it`s hunting grounds. To the weak, it`s certain death. Those who survive invariably grow into major figures of the Ninja world.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_88313_1: It`s precisely such cruel trials that allow Ninjas to achieve repeated merits on the Facet Battlefield. You outsiders needn`t worry. en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_88313_3: Without Eloise and Sarutobi Sasuke`s tacit approval, how could a mere Archer steward interfere in Ninja affairs?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_88313_4: Alright. Regarding the Susanoo Trial, are there any special considerations I should know?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_88313_5: Of course. Chosen Ones are special compared to other classes. Naturally, there are special considerations.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9041001_2: In a thousand years, you`re the first to accomplish such a feat, proving you`re worthy of the Serpent`s lineage power.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9041001_3: Today I shall bestow upon you this oceanic treasure. May the Serpent`s power protect you forever.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9044001_1: Three thousand years of karma cycling, and finally the one to break the deadlock appears... I sense the Kylin lineage flowing in your veins.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9044001_2: Today I shall bestow upon you this netherworld treasure. May the Kylin`s power protect you forever.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9046001_1: The karmic flames burning for millennia have transformed into red lotuses beneath your wings. From now on, your wingbeats will stir the eight-direction fire veins...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9046001_2: Today I shall bestow upon you this earth-core treasure. May Bi Fang`s power protect you forever.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9047001_1: My child is cursed by a vile foe, trapped in a common fox`s body!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9047001_2:
Since you carry our lineage, please use it to break the curse and grant my child rebirth.
You shall be richly rewarded!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9048001_1: Many thanks for your aid. This treasure is now yours.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9048001_2: This debt of gratitude is etched upon the moon, never to be tarnished.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9049001_1: That towering tree is the Fate Oak. Touch the old marks at its roots to awaken this karma and find the opportunity I left for you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9051001_1: This karma is settled, yet the fate written in your stars is just beginning a new chapter...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9053001_1:
Mortal, never forget this sight.
War brings no glory. What fallen souls desire is but a wisp of hometown smoke.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9055001_1:
These ten-thousand-year shackles are finally broken!
Thank you for granting us new life!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9055001_2: Now we bestow upon you this celestial treasure. May you inherit our destiny to protect all living things.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103451701_1: The Serpent clan is finally reborn, though greatly weakened. May you lead them back to glory!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103452101_1:
Kylin:
As the saying goes: When Kylin appears, peace reigns. Though I`m an auspicious sign, some things remain beyond my power. If I cannot protect the people, my heart will never rest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103452301_1: Sigh... Once I could burn the heavens, now just a wisp of spirit remains, barely able to light a lamp...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103452501_1: I`ll train hard to become the strongest fox ever! Then no one can seal me again!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103452601_1: All phenomena of the world flow through my heart. If you have any doubts, come to me anytime.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103453001_1: Summoning wind and rain is just pastimes of old. Now I only hope this world still has room for me to stretch.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103453001_1_1: I`d love to spar with you someday!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103453201_1: Daily I patrol the skies, witnessing all changes below. Yet I wonder, why do mortal lives, so brief, always shine with such bright laughter?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9120001_1:
Wind Plain is a serene and enchanting place, home to many rare seedlings. Unfortunately, I can`t gather them all alone.
Would you be willing to help collect some for me? I would be most grateful!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9120001_3:
By Moonlit Lake in Wind Plain, there`s a flower that blooms with a faint blue glow only in the early morning mist, called the Azure Aster.
It`s an essential ingredient for my Soothing Sachets. I beg your help!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9121001_1: The Azure Aster should be enough. Take it to Liora.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9122001_1:
Excellent! The Azure Aster is in perfect condition, as if it still carries the freshness of the lake!
Please accept the gift.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9123001_1:
I heard that old Gardener Carl in the forest grows a rare Moonlit Lily. Could you ask him if he`s willing to sell seeds?
Tell him I`m willing to trade three Flame Roses! You`ll be well rewarded if you succeed.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9124001_1:
Moonlit Lily? Hmph, I don`t just give those away... But since Canary is offering Flame Roses in exchange, I might consider it.
Tell her I`ll need two days to prepare the seeds.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9125001_1: Wonderful! With the Moonlit Lily, my shop will attract more customers. Here`s your reward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9126001_1:
I heard that a few extremely rare Flame Flowers have appeared in Maple Forest. I came all this way just to catch a glimpse. Unfortunately, the terrain is treacherous, and I can`t collect them alone...
Would you be willing to gather some for me? I would be deeply grateful!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9127001_1: The Flame Flower should be enough. Take it to Liora!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9129001_1:
Recently, the roses in the fields outside town have suddenly withered. I suspect there`s a problem with the water supply. Could you check with Farmer Hank to see if he knows what happened?
You`ll be handsomely rewarded!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9130001_1: Ah, those flowers? It`s the wastewater discharged from the upstream mine! I warned them long ago... Tell Canary that unless the mine stops operations, the fields are doomed.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9131001_1: Just as I feared... We`ll have to find a new source of flowers. Here`s your reward, and please help spread the word - we must stand against the mine`s misdeeds!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9132001_1:
Legend says that in Love Canyon there`s a meadow blessed by moonlight. At night, the Moonlit Grass there glows softly. I want to use it to cultivate new flower varieties, but I`m tied up with other matters.
Would you be willing to gather some for me? I would be deeply grateful!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9133001_1: This Moonlit Grass should be enough. Take it to Liora!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9134001_1:
So this is Moonlit Grass? Even more beautiful than the books describe! Thank you.
Please accept the gift as a token of gratitude!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9135001_1: See that young knight? His name is Leon. Every day he buys a bouquet of violets - I suspect it`s for someone special. Could you follow him secretly and find out who receives the flowers? I want to prepare a surprise bouquet.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9136001_1:
Please keep it quiet... The flowers are for Sister Mary at the church. She always says violets soothe the patients!
But since Canary wants to help... I won`t stop her. I was also thinking of sending a special bouquet myself.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9137001_1: I see! Tomorrow, I`ll prepare a basket of mixed herbal flowers. Please deliver it for me and say it`s ‘A Blessing from Spring`!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9138001_1:
Though this desert seems barren, the harshest places nurture the hardiest life - like the Sand Lotus. It blooms briefly at noon under the strongest sun, absorbing the essence of the heat, and is a rare remedy for heatstroke.
But the desert is perilous, and I cannot traverse it alone. Would you gather some for me? I would be deeply grateful!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9139001_1: The Sand Lotus should be enough. Take it to Liora!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9140001_1:
This Sand Lotus is of excellent quality - perfect for making the finest remedy for heatstroke.
Please accept the gift.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9141001_1:
Some pesky little bugs have been nibbling on my prized orchids in storage. I know a special scent made from Sunfire Daisy and Silver Mint can drive them off, but I`m not sure of the right mix.
Hunter Barton in town deals with all sorts of pests in the wild - he might know the best recipe.
Could you ask him for me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9142001_1:
Pest control? Ha! You`ve come to the right person. Tell Canary to dry the daisy petals and grind them into powder, then mix with fresh mint juice. Three parts powder to one part juice, scatter it in the corners, and those critters will be gone in no time.
Oh, and remind her to check the next batch of timber she brings in - bugs might have hitched a ride with the wood.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9143001_1: Three parts dried daisy powder to one part fresh juice? Got it! And check the timber... many thanks to Barton for the tip, and to you for running this errand. Here`s your reward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9144001_1:
Don`t be fooled by the island - hidden here are a few waterborne seedlings that grow nowhere else. They`re excellent for medicine and perfumes. Alas, I can`t swim, so I can`t gather them myself.
Would you fetch some for me? I`ll see you well rewarded!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9144001_2:
On the shallow flats to the east grows a tiny white flower. It usually hides beneath the water, but under the moonlight, it peeks out, petals sparkling as if they`ve soaked up the silver glow. We call it the Moonlit Waterlily.
It calms the mind and is very rare. Mischievous water imps often linger there, so please be careful.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9145001_1: The Moonlit Waterlily should be enough. Take it to Liora!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9146001_1:
Fresh Moonlit Waterlily, still dewy! Tonight I`ll sleep soundly for sure!
Please accept the gift.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9147001_1:
I`m compiling a new book on the language of flowers, but there`s one ancient bloom - the Stardust Hibiscus - whose meaning I`ve never been able to confirm. The records are vague.
They say the oldest lady in town, Gwendolyn, once received this flower in her youth. She may still remember its meaning.
Would you ask her for me? It`s very important.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9148001_1:
Stardust Hibiscus... ah, what a distant and enchanting name.
(Her eyes grow hazy) My husband gave me one many years ago... He said its blossoms were like scattered stars, a promise that ‘though apart, we share the same sky, until we meet again.`
Ah, that romantic fool... Tell Canary its meaning is `Hope of Reunion`.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9149001_1:
`Hope of Reunion`... how beautiful, filled with warmth and strength. Thank you, and my thanks to Lady Gwendolyn as well. At last, my flower book has its perfect final page.
Please accept this gift. May you, too, soon reunite with the one you long for!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9008001_1: Chosen One, have you heard of </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9008001_3: It is the mysterious essence hidden within all things, the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>origin of power</color><color=0xfffffcee>, and a gift of life itself.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9008001_4: Legend tells that the ancient </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>World Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee> nurtured countless </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolons</color><color=0xfffffcee>, radiant as stars, once coveted treasures sought by heroes and sages.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9008001_7: I implore you to seek the truth behind the World Tree`s decline.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9008001_8: Before you depart, seek out the dwarf </color><color=0xff52c769>Bell</color><color=0xfffffcee> in Love Canyon. His research on Eidolon and the ancient tree is unparalleled; he may guide you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_1: Ha! Another one pushed along by fate. Did </color><color=0xff52c769>Eloise</color><color=0xfffffcee> send you?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_2: I heard you are quite knowledgeable about </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I wish to learn more.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_3: My dealings with </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon</color><color=0xfffffcee> go beyond mere research...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_4: Here, the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Vial</color><color=0xfffffcee>, my masterpiece! It can bind a </color><color=0xffdf85e3>monsters` Eidolons</color><color=0xfffffcee>, make them obey. The </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>ancient World Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee>, without Eidolon nourishment, will eventually rot into worthless wood.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_5: Can this thing truly restore the World Tree?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_6: Absolutely! But the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Vial</color><color=0xfffffcee> is </color><color=0xffdf85e3>tempered with holy water</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Only through the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Elves` secret incantations</color><color=0xfffffcee> can the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>power within the Eidolon Vial</color><color=0xfffffcee> be activated.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_7: Once activated, the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Vial</color><color=0xfffffcee> will feed the power of each bound Eidolon back to you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_8: Sounds promising! Have you investigated the withering World Tree?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_9: The corrupt aura permeating the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>depths of Love Canyon</color><color=0xfffffcee> is precisely the cause of the World Tree`s gradual decline.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_10: Take the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Vial</color><color=0xfffffcee>; it will guide you to find </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Elves` traces</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Regarding Eidolons, those </color><color=0xff52c769>Elves</color><color=0xfffffcee> know far more than I do.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9009001_11: Thank you! I`ll keep an eye out!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9010001_1: Such sweet </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon</color><color=0xfffffcee>... Not enough... Far from enough! I need more power! For revenge!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9010001_3: Another fool seeking death? Perfect! Become fuel for my power!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_1: I am Irandir... The one you just met was my twin brother, </color><color=0xfff05050>Mavien</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_2: You`re brothers? But why did he become like this?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_3: We were twin sons, sharing life and glory. But </color><color=0xfff05050>Mavien</color><color=0xfffffcee> stole and practiced </color><color=0xffdf85e3>forbidden arts</color><color=0xfffffcee>, committing an unforgivable sin.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_4: He was exiled from the forest. I couldn`t stop him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_5: But he still uses </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Magic</color><color=0xfffffcee>, even harming living beings!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_6: I`m sorry. I didn`t think </color><color=0xfff05050>Mavien</color><color=0xfffffcee> truly bargained with a devil. He obtained </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>pages from the Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> and studied the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Magic</color><color=0xfffffcee> on them to enhance his power.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_7: I tried to stop him, but he ambushed and gravely wounded me. This </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Magic</color><color=0xfffffcee> corruption... I cannot confront him directly for now...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_9: I sense it... The craft of </color><color=0xff52c769>Dwarven artisans</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Don`t be surprised; every </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Vial</color><color=0xfffffcee> whispers to me. As Elves, we are born to listen.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_10: Bell did mention that </color><color=0xffdf85e3>the Eidolon Vial requires Elven power to activate.</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_11: The </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Vial</color><color=0xfffffcee> is a slumbering vessel. The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Elves` secret incantations breathe a soul into it</color><color=0xfffffcee>, giving formless Eidolons a shape that can be bound.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_12: How does one bind an Eidolon?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_13: To counter </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Dark Magic</color><color=0xfffffcee>, pure </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Power</color><color=0xfffffcee> is needed. Mavien`s forbidden arts are heretical, but Eidolon Power itself is one of the world`s origins.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_14: I know an ancient, orthodox method... Deep in this canyon dwell </color><color=0xffdf85e3>creatures corrupted and enraged by dark power</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9012001_15: They hold twisted </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolons</color><color=0xfffffcee> within. I will guide you to safely absorb and wield this power. It`s our only hope against Mavien!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_1: (Panting) Strange... Your body carries none of that nauseating dark stench.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_2: I am no ally of the Dark Elves. On the contrary, they owe me much debt.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_3: Many friends were killed by the Dark Elf. He slaughtered all my nest-mates, not even the young were spared...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_4: Since you are untouched by darkness, I offer my Eidolon.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_5: I beg you, avenge me! Make those fallen pay in blood!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_6: I accept your final wish, and your power. The Dark Elf will pay for every drop of innocent blood.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_7: (Smiles) Thank you, stranger. Let my hatred burn on...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9418001_8: With this precious Eidolon, next, I shall guide you on how to use them correctly!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9015001_1: I can feel the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Power</color><color=0xfffffcee> within you growing... You learn quickly. But...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9015001_2: Too late... That vile dark power has surged! </color><color=0xffff0000>Mavien</color><color=0xfffffcee> succeeded!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9015001_3: His power now far exceeds before!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9015001_5: (Interrupts, urgent and serious) Your current strength isn`t enough to face him!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9015001_6: Only by raising your </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>Eidolon Power</color><color=0xfffffcee> to a higher level is there a chance! Remember the method I taught you! Time is short, I can feel his killing intent... He will come for us soon!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9015001_8: The </color><color=0xffdf85e3>higher the level</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the dark creature, the stronger the Eidolon power within. I`ve observed that the </color><color=0xffff0000>Revenants</color><color=0xfffffcee> and </color><color=0xffff0000>Elite Snakemen</color><color=0xfffffcee> in this canyon possess high-quality Eidolons. You may hunt them to absorb their Eidolons.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9016001_1: Truly the Chosen One! Your comprehension of Eidolon far exceeds my expectations! Next, complete the Eidolon upgrade to possess even greater Eidolon Power!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9018001_1: Eloise? What are you doing here!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9018001_2: My apologies for the delay. Regarding how to handle these pages, I wish to invite you both to Twin City for a proper discussion.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9018001_4: Shh! Not so loud... There are `ears` here that we cannot see......
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_1: Sorry for making you come to Twin City. Mavien made a deal with a devil; he must have Negative Facet `</color><color=0xffdf85e3>ears</color><color=0xfffffcee>` planted on him for eavesdropping...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_2: Though he is dead, </color><color=0xffdf85e3>those things</color><color=0xfffffcee> won`t vanish immediately.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_3: I see! Is there something special about these </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>pages</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_4: </color><color=0xffff0000>Mavien</color><color=0xfffffcee>`s demise halted the spread of the World Tree`s corruption. Its power is gradually recovering...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_5: Could the </color><color=0xffdf85e3>pages of the Forbidden Book</color><color=0xfffffcee> have a deeper connection to the </color><color=0xfffe8d2b>World Tree</color><color=0xfffffcee>?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_6: The pages are inscribed with </color><color=0xffdf85e3>ancient Elvish</color><color=0xfffffcee>, sealing a form of </color><color=0xffdf85e3>Eidolon Power</color><color=0xfffffcee>. And the Forbidden Book might be the key to unlocking it...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_7: But this is mere conjecture. We need more evidence.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_8: Your conjecture is correct, World Priestess. Some Elves still worship the doctrines left by </color><color=0xffff0000>Mavien</color><color=0xfffffcee>. I cannot oppose this undercurrent alone...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_9: But what if we join forces?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9019001_10: I would be glad to cooperate with you, Irandir.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9497001_1: Greetings! I am the Arch Blacksmith, sent by the High Priest to assist you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9497001_2: Beneath that Ancient Froststone over there, starlight glimmers. It may hide a Twinkling Shard! Take this hammer and smash open the froststone!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9499001_1: Now that you`re here, would you mind smashing more froststones for me? The Frost Iron in froststones is useful to me. I`ll reward you well!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9486001_1: You`re truly reliable! I can never have too much Frost Iron! Here`s your reward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9487001_1: Greetings! I am the Arch Ward Master, sent by the High Priest to assist you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9487001_2: This maze is filled with magical arrays, extremely dangerous and hard to navigate. But the chest at the end may contain a Twinkling Shard! Proceed with extra caution!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9489001_1: There might be more fragments of that manual in the treasure chest. If you`re willing to fetch them for me, I`ll reward you generously!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9491001_1: Wonderful! These manual fragments will greatly benefit me! Please accept this reward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9492001_1: Greetings! I am the Arch Alchemist, sent by the High Priest to assist you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9492001_2: The Twinkling Shard may have fallen into my Alchemy Cauldron. If you wish it to yield the shard, you must demonstrate alchemical mastery that leaves it awestruck.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9492001_3: Remember, </color><color=0xfff05050>add ingredients once, then control the heat once!</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9493001_1:
Only the finest alchemist deserves my treasure!
    </color><color=0xff52c769>The cauldron is empty. What will you do?</color><color=0xfffffcee>
Step 1 (In Progress) -- Step 2 (Pending)
     </color><color=0xff52c769>Please proceed with caution in your alchemy to avoid failure.</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9493002_1:
Great! Just one step left. 
   </color><color=0xff52c769> The cauldron burns fiercely. What`s next?</color><color=0xfffffcee>
Step 1 (Added Ingredients) -- Step 2 (In Progress) -- Step 3 (Pending)
    </color><color=0xff52c769>Please proceed with caution in your alchemy to avoid failure.</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9493003_1: Such alchemical mastery, truly worthy of a grandmaster! Please accept this Twinkling Shard!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9494001_1:
There might still be precious elixirs hidden in that cauldron. Please give it another try!
Remember, </color><color=0xfff05050>add ingredients once, then control the heat once!</color><color=0xfffffcee>
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9495003_1: Such alchemical mastery, truly worthy of a grandmaster! Please accept this elixir!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9496001_1: As expected! This elixir is extraordinary too! Please accept this reward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103497301_1: I am the Arch Blacksmith, sent by the High Priest to aid you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103497501_1: I am the Arch Ward Master, sent by the High Priest to aid you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103497701_1: I am the Arch Alchemist, sent by the High Priest to aid you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9156001_1: Save me... I`m a cultivator sent by Elf King to purge this corruption. The demonic miasma here is too strong... I can`t hold on much longer.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9156001_3: Heal my wounds.... I need your strength to complete my mission!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9158001_1:
Thank you. I feel much better!
Lord Lorth`s corruption is consuming this forest. We must act quickly.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9158001_2:
These Demonseal Stones can suppress the demonic energy. Could you place them on the forest altars?
This will stop the corruption from spreading.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9160001_1: So you`ve found out. My plan succeeds regardless!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9160001_2: My wife... she died saving me from the corruption. I couldn`t accept her loss. I had to try.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9160001_3: I poured everything into it, drew upon the forest`s power. Finally, I did it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9160001_5: I don`t know... But she`s back now. Whatever price I pay, I won`t regret it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9161001_1: Why am I here? The forest... What happened to it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9161001_3: No! Eiselle, you`ve made a terrible mistake! Draining the forest`s power will bring ruin upon us all. This land cannot fall to corruption. My very existence is a mistake. I must end this myself!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9161001_4: But I just brought you back! Don`t leave me again!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9161001_5: This isn`t true revival... Something terrible shares my body! I can`t contain it much longer!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9163001_1: What have I done... Sacrificed the forest for selfish love... Doomed my beloved again...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9163001_2: You should have respected her wish.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9163001_3: You`re right. I sought power blindly, ignoring her will and this land`s sanctity. My arrogance brought ruin.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9165001_3: You... you hurt him! This is my fault! I disobeyed the elders` warnings!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9166001_5: Only the legendary Sacred Fruit can purify him.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9166001_6: But I fear he`s given up hope after so long...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9166001_7: If Arboris joins your search for the Sacred Fruit, we might reverse his transformation in time.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9167001_1:

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9167001_2: Eldwin told me everything. Arboris, why won`t you return to your true form?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9167001_3: It`s not despair... The Sacred Fruit is impossibly rare. I`ve searched for it every single day.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9167001_5: It grows deep in the forest, somewhere I can no longer reach. If you can bring it to me, I`ll follow you forever!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9169001_1: The true Sacred Fruit! You actually found it! Thank you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9170001_1: I`m back! I have to tell Eldwin and my friends! They`ll be so happy! I can be a Woodwalker again!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9171001_1: Flee... quickly! Greedwolf has known about the Sacred Fruit and seeks to destroy it!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9171001_2: Arboris, the Sacred Fruit`s power resides in you. Protect it at all costs!!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9173001_1: He was my proudest student. The forest`s most loyal guardian.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9173001_2: Arboris has fulfilled his duty. Now it`s our turn. We protect this forest—so his sacrifice wasn`t in vain.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9173001_3: Perhaps the World Tree seed you brought back is his final gift to us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9174001_1: We meet again! Since Arboris`s sacrifice, Flickerwood slowly heals, but something still troubles me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9174001_2: (Pointing) See those violet mists around World Tree? They are Lord Lorth`s watching eyes. Unchecked, they`ll drown the forest in darkness again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9174001_4: I`ve prepared a magic array around the Demon Eye. Activate it to force the Demon Eye out.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9174001_5: My apprentice Celeste and her daughter monitor the Demon Eye. Seek them for details.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9175001_1: Frantically) Please! Save my daughter! That monstrous Demon Eye has trapped her!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9175001_3: We are witches guarding this land. Demon Eye tempted my daughter, seeking to shatter the World Tree`s roots.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9175001_4: Thankfully, she regained consciousness just in time to maintain balance
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9175001_5: But now, she`s bound to it and can`t escape. Please save her!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9177001_1: My poor daughter! Is there truly no way to save her?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9177001_3: Me! Let me do it! If it saves her, I`ll pay any price.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9177001_4: But this is incredibly dangerous. You might...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9177001_5: (Steadfast) I know. But she`s my daughter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9177001_6: Then I`ll open the barrier. Be ready!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9180001_3: Don`t blame yourself. My mother sacrificed herself for me and this forest. I`ll continue protecting it just as she did.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9180001_4: May the World Tree watch over you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9181001_1: Suyi`s judgment proves true. You`ve gathered all Seeds of Life in such a short time. Your deeds have earned the forest`s blessing and relieved World Tree`s burden.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9181001_2: Now, it`s time to save the true World Tree.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9181001_4: The true World Tree resides in celestial heights, still corrupted by Lord Lorth. Without full purification, the Demon Lord will return, bringing doom to Flickerwood and Elf Kingdom.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9181001_6:
We`ll open a portal using all elves` power. Through it lies World Tree.
Defeat the Demon Lord, reclaim the Heartwood, and World Tree shall be purified.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9184001_1:
Honored friend, thank you, for everything.
Your coming was dawn`s light dispelling darkness over forest and sky.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9184001_2: , Elf King, guardian of these woods, offer the highest honors.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9184001_3: I merely did what was right.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9184001_4:
Your humility honors the ancient prophecy: `When darkness shrouds the land, a hero from afar shall bring the light.`
Today, that prophecy is fulfilled. And you are that hero.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9184001_6: Accept the forest`s blessing. May it guide your future journeys.
en.STR_BLACK_9806001_2: When you open your eyes again, you have taken Albert`s form.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9806002_1:

It seems the secret art worked. Your current appearance is exactly as he looked in his youth.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9806002_3: Everything you see and hear now is the memory he cherishes most, and the one he struggles most to resolve. My spiritual energy won`t last long here. The path ahead is yours alone.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9806002_4: I have to live through his past?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9806002_5:
Remember, you are not just a spectator. You are Albert now.
Experience the joys and pains he felt. Only then can you help him find his lost belief and break through his inner demon. I will be waiting for you in the real world.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9808003_1: These bamboo strips are evenly thick and thin. Perfect for making a Cuju ball!

en.STR_BLACK_9809002_1: You skillfully wind the Bamboo Strips,

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9810001_4: Anyway, go call Damon. He said he was going to the mill at the east end of the village to help his dad carry wheat. We`ll meet at the usual spot!

Albert? You`re looking for Damon?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812001_2: Where there`s a will, there`s a way!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812001_3:

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812002_1:

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812002_2: I`ll go invite her right now.

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812004_1:

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812004_2: I`m going to make it happen!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812004_3:
Alright! I believe you! Actually, I don`t think there`s anything wrong with having a dream. At least you know where you want to go.
Come on, let`s go to the village entrance and find Armin. He`s probably there practicing again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9812005_1: Damon has been going on about Cuju for a while now. Go talk to him!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9813001_3:
Someday, when I make enough money, I`ll take all of us to the capital to watch the Cuju Tournament!
I almost forgot. Kaine is waiting at the southern clearing. Let`s hurry over!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9816002_7: Please teach me how to play!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9817001_5:
First, go buy a glossy, golden drumstick from Aunt Wang. Then, go to Uncle Li and get a jar of aged cellar wine.
Without these two things, I won`t accept you as a disciple.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9818001_1:
Fragrant, sizzling drumsticks! Shiny and golden!
Albert? Want one?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9818001_2: Give me the biggest drumstick you have!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9818001_3:
You`re actually spending money today?

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9823001_6: Before, it was a wish. Now, it`s certain. With this talent, you are the one true king on this pitch!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9829001_4: Confidence is good! For this Rural Cuju Tournament, you need to submit a registration form first. Go sign up, then form a Cuju team. Leave the rest to me!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9830001_2: I want to give it a try!

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9831001_5:

en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9832001_3: With my master teaching us, there`s no way we`ll lose!
