en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9843001_9: I am grateful for your instruction!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9843001_10: The three of us have taught you all our skills. Now, it`s up to you to comprehend them!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9843001_11: I will not let you down!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9844001_1: Through this training, you`ve absorbed the lifelong learning of my three disciples. If you can integrate these three skills, you`ll be ready for the International Cuju Tournament.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9844001_2: Remember, winning and losing are trivial matters. Don`t lose your integrity. Respect strong opponents, show compassion to weaker ones, and stand up against injustice.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9845001_1: Albert, your footwork, character, and vision have all come a long way on this journey.\nBut one final trial stands between you and true graduation.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9845001_3:
A pack of black bears has taken up residence in the cave behind the village. The leader, Mighty Bear, is particularly fierce.
If you can make it through the cave using only your kicking skills, defeat the Mighty Bear, and retrieve something for me, you`ll have truly graduated.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9845001_4: What do I need to retrieve?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9845001_5:
My stinky socks.
When I went into the mountains to gather herbs a few days ago, those beasts snatched them. They may be old, but those socks were personal items from my younger days. They hold great meaning!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9846001_1: Good! Albert, you haven`t disappointed me. Your footwork is refined, and your heart is steady. The small world of Qingshi Village can no longer contain you.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9846001_2: Go, show the world that Qingshi Village can produce a true Cuju master!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9846001_4: Your companions are waiting for you at the village entrance. Go say goodbye to them. I won`t see you off.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9820001_1: Good wine! So satisfying! The taste brings me back to the tournaments of yesteryear.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9820001_2: Remember, Cuju isn`t just about winning. It`s about the heart that never gives up.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9820001_3: One day, you`ll take this ball and go see the real world.
en.STR_BLACK_9820002_1: Albert kneels solemnly and bows with great respect.
en.STR_BLACK_9820002_2: Brooke looks at Albert, the corner of his mouth curling into a meaningful smile.
en.STR_BLACK_9820002_3: He looks at him like a child who doesn`t yet know his place in the world,
en.STR_BLACK_9820002_4: and also like a promising sapling the world has yet to discover.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9833001_1: The champion of this year`s Rural Cuju Tournament is Albert and his team from Qingshi Village! According to the rules, the champion receives a Cuju manual as a prize!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9833001_3:
Child, you have an extraordinary talent and an excellent teacher. Your footwork is agile, your kicks are precise, and you stay calm under pressure.
If you can participate in the International Cuju Tournament, I`m sure you`ll shine.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9833001_4: The International Cuju Tournament... Could I really do it?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9847001_1: Albert! You`re so cool! When you get to the capital, you have to get me autographs from all those superstar players!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9847001_2: Albert, don`t go easy on those foreign players. Use that `Stillness` move and knock them over! Show them what Qingshi Village is made of!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9847001_3: Albert, this is a new Cuju ball we all stayed up late making for you. If you ever miss home, just look at it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9847001_4: Albert, according to my calculations, your chances of winning the championship have risen to thirty percent. Stay safe on your journey. We`ll be waiting for good news!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9847001_5: I will not let you down!
en.STR_BLACK_9847002_1: The gentle breeze of Qingshi Village stirs the dreams of a young man.
en.STR_BLACK_9847002_2: The war drums of the International Cuju Tournament sound in the distance.
en.STR_BLACK_9847002_3: And as this ancient training comes to a close,
en.STR_BLACK_9847002_4: the sleeping Albert slowly opens his eyes at last...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103559401_1:
Suyi:
    Cuju chases the wind. Winning and losing are both a joy.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103559501_1:
Kaine:
    A young man of Qingshi Village should chase the wind with Cuju and live up to his youthful spirit!
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103559501_1_1: The youth should be this wild and free!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103559901_1:
Damon`s Dad:
    My Damon was born with the talent to play Cuju!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103560001_1:
Damon:
    I just love Cuju. I feel empty if I don`t play for a day!
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103560001_1_1: Loving sports is a great thing!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103560101_1:
Thea:
    The wind in Qingshi Village is the gentlest. It`s so peaceful just staying here quietly.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103560101_1_1: It`s such a peaceful little village.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103560201_1:
Armin:
    When playing Cuju, I calculate positioning; when counting money, I keep things clear. I enjoy both.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103560201_1_1: Sounds like you`re a data-driven player.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103560301_1:
InnerDemon:
    The more you cling to it, the harder it is to escape the cage inside your heart.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103560301_1_1: I won`t fall for your tricks.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103560501_1:
Brooke:
    On the pitch, it`s not just about physical strength. It`s about brains and big-picture thinking.
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103560501_1_1: As expected of a true master.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103560601_1:
Aunt Wang:
    Freshly cooked, hot drumsticks! Tender and flavorful. Come have a taste!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103560701_1:
Uncle Li:
    Home-brewed, pure grain wine. Smooth and fragrant. Want some?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103561101_1:
Melon Seller:
    Watermelons for sale! Guaranteed ripe and sweet. Free if not sweet!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103561201_1:
Registration Steward:
    The Rural Cuju Tournament is over. Please come again next time!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103561301_1:
Match Referee:
    Rules come first. Focus on Cuju. Do not foul or crash into anyone!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103561401_1:
Auburn:
    Once I unleash my Snake Coil Steps, no one on the pitch can steal my ball.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103561801_1:
Beau:
    With my Mirage Steps, trying to catch my shadow is already a challenge.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103562301_1:
Arya:
    When I guard the goal, I`m as still as a mountain. No one gets an easy shot past me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_1: Chosen One, have you noticed? The martyr spirits of the Dune Wanderers in Valhalla seem no longer at rest.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_2: The martyr spirits? Aren`t they just legends now?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_3: That`s how it should be. But lately, their blade hums echo through the void, as if calling out for something... Perhaps the ripples of fate, or perhaps unfinished obsessions.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_4: What do you think it means?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_5: The spirits of Dune Wanderers do not stir without reason. If you seek the truth, you should go see Song Qing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_6: They say he once brought back a Star Lantern from the Eastern Continent, one that can reflect the homeland of the soul.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_7: But when he unfurls the dust-laden scroll for you, what you step into will be more than mere memories...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_8: If this is the only way to uncover the mystery, I`m willing to try!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9079001_9: Remember, that place is the home of the brave and the faithful. Those who enter must face the trials of fate.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_1: So Eloise has already mentioned me to you... Chosen One, you`ve come for those restless martyr spirits as well?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_2: She said the Star Lantern in your hand can take me to their homeland.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_3: That is a land soaked in chivalry, where the obsessions of the spirits still echo through the mountains. But stepping there is not just sightseeing.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_4: I need to know the truth. Why are those spirits restless?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_5: The spirits of the Wanderers value karma above all. If they stir, it means an unresolved bond has been disturbed or someone is trying to rewrite their legends.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_6: Rewrite legends? Who would do such a thing?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_7: Perhaps greedy fools, or perhaps something more dangerous. But rather than guessing, why not see for yourself? Are you ready?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9801001_9: Then take one step forward, and you shall enter the jianghu!
en.STR_BLACK_9801002_1: The lantern glows. You board the carriage and follow Song Qing into the desert...
en.STR_BLACK_9801002_2: But unluckily, you are caught in a sandstorm and lose your way...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080001_1: Where is this? How did I end up here...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080001_2: I don`t know who brought me here. Maybe I should ask around!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_1: Oh, you`re awake! Are you feeling alright?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_2: May I ask where this is?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_3: This is </color><color=0xff00ff00>Duststorm Inn</color><color=0xfffffcee>. Our </color><color=0xff00ff00>Madam Hua</color><color=0xfffffcee> saved you. You`re lucky to be alive. That sandstorm was no joke!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_4: Sandstorm? Sorry, I can`t seem to remember.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_5: Can`t remember? Did you hit your head?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_6: Madam Hua was out with a caravan when she found you barely alive and brought you back.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_7: We didn`t think you`d wake up, but you sure have some luck!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_8: I see. May I meet her?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_9: Of course! She is out front checking the goods!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9080002_10: Thank you! I`ll go thank her right away.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081001_1: Lone smoke rises straight in the desert, the setting sun rounds over the long river... So this is the view...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081001_2: There`s a woman in red at the inn entrance checking goods. Could she be Madam Hua?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_1: Ten bolts of silk, twenty chests of tea... Huh? What are you doing out here? Have you rested enough?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_2: I`m fine now. Thank you for saving me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_3: You`re lucky. Around </color><color=0xff00ff00>Skydust Pass</color><color=0xfffffcee>, only </color><color=0xff00ff00>Duststorm Town</color><color=0xfffffcee> still has some people. But why are you here alone? Looking for someone or doing business?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_4: To be honest, I woke up with no memory...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_5: Is that so? That`s troubling... Do you have any belongings with you? Maybe they can help you recall something.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_6: I have a letter and a blade.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_7: Let me see... Where did you get this glaive? Ah, I forgot, you don`t remember!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_8: This is a glaive, a weapon unique to the desert wanderers. The letter mentions General Liu Yi and the Deserted Garrison.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_9: I don`t recall any of this...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9081002_10: It`s a long story. Stay at the inn for now. Ask around in Duststorm Town, and you`ll learn about the connection between </color><color=0xff00ff00>General Liu Yi and Dune Wanderers</color><color=0xfffffcee>.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082001_1: The market is lively and bustling. I`ll ask the vendors.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_1: Fresh flatbread! Care to try some?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_2: I`d like to ask about General Liu Yi.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_3: General Liu! He was the general of the </color><color=0xff00ff00>Protectorate</color><color=0xfffffcee>. After the Protectorate withdrew, he stayed behind with the Deserted Garrison.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_4: If it weren`t for General Liu and the Garrison, this place would have been overrun by other tribes long ago!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_6: Of course! He`s the true general in our hearts.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_7: After the Protectorate left, the tribes fell into chaos, each trying to seize power. Those were dark days. Trade stopped, and the roads were buried in sand.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_9: General Liu stepped in. At first, he tried to mediate, but the tribal chiefs didn`t take him seriously.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_10: So he led the Deserted Garrison into battle. They were formidable, almost always victorious!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_11: But then... alas... Young hero, if you`re not buying flatbread, don`t hold up my business!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9082002_12: Sorry to bother you. Thanks for the information!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083001_1: The vendor stopped mid-sentence. Did something happen to the Deserted Garrison later? I should ask someone else.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_1: Traveling far and wide, you can`t go without a good horse! I have the finest steeds here. Care to take a look?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_2: Do you know why the Deserted Garrison disappeared?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_3: You`re not from around here, are you? Locals all know the story.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_4: If you want to know why the Garrison fell, you have to mention Galehowl, the chief of the Wolf Gang.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_6: He`s a menace! He couldn`t beat General Liu in a fair fight, so he played dirty, siding with the </color><color=0xff52c769>Usun Tribe</color><color=0xfffffcee> and ambushing the Garrison!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_7: The battle at Wolf Vale was a tragedy... Curse those villains! They destroyed the Garrison!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_8: It`s in the past... Don`t dwell on it.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9083002_9: Forget it! What would an outsider know?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084001_1: It seems everyone holds General Liu and the Garrison in high regard... Oh, there`s an </color><color=0xff52c769>exotic maiden</color><color=0xfffffcee> up ahead. Maybe I should ask her what she thinks.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_1: Now that the Deserted Garrison is gone, these raiders are getting bolder.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_2: You know about the Deserted Garrison?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_3: Of course. Thanks to them, the desert knew peace for a while, though it didn`t last... Ah, why am I telling you all this?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_4: Times have changed. The Garrison may be gone, but the Dune Wanderers are here! They`re brave, wise, and uphold justice. They protect us too!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_6: Yes! You know them! It seems they`re gaining fame.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_7: I was saved by them by chance. I learned they were actually the remnants of the Deserted Garrison.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_8: Oh dear, I`ve said too much! Please don`t tell anyone!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_9: Don`t worry. I`ll keep it a secret.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_10: Thank you! It`s getting late, young hero. You should head back. Nightfall is dangerous! I must be going too. Farewell!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9084002_12: Night is falling. The vendors are packing up. Howls echo in the distance. Time to return to the inn.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9086001_1: Wolf Vale lives up to its name. Those howls are spine-chilling!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9086002_1: Bones litter the ground, along with mutilated corpses. Green will-o`-the-wisps flicker everywhere...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9086003_1: A pack of Dune Wolves is surrounding a White Haired Elder. I have to help him!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9087001_1: Wolf Vale is truly perilous. Let me check on that man.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9087002_1:
Heavens be praised! What perfect timing, young hero!
I`m </color><color=0xff00ff00>Shajia</color><color=0xfffffcee>, from the Yuezhi tribe. Thank you for your help!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9087002_2: Why are you alone in Wolf Vale?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9087002_3: I have no choice. I need to reach Howling Ridge to find someone, and Wolf Vale is the only path.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9087002_4: What a coincidence! I`m heading to Howling Ridge too.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9087002_5: What a fortunate coincidence! If you don`t mind, we can travel together. Wolf Vale is truly dangerous...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9087002_6: I was just thinking the same!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9088001_1: Deep claw marks scar the stone pillars. I wonder who left them...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9088002_1: Vultures soar overhead, casting giant shadows in the moonlight...
en.STR_BLACK_9088003_1: After a long trek, the two of you finally reach Howling Ridge...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9088004_1: The night wind whistles through the cracks, sounding like sobs. The herdsmen say it`s the ghosts of ancient battlefields...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9089001_1: There are two people ahead. Let`s go ask them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9089002_1: You two actually crossed Wolf Vale at night? And that old man doesn`t look like he`s from the Central Plains! Who are you?!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9089002_3: Looking for someone? Sneaking around at night, you`re clearly up to no good! Take this!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9089002_4: Why draw your blade without warning?!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9090002_1: As the princess of the Yuezhi tribe, how could you flee from the peace delegation?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9090002_2:
Peace through marriage doesn`t bring true peace. I refuse to be a pawn.
Uncle Shajia, please believe in my choice.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9090002_3: I heard you`re looking for someone. Who is it? Perhaps I can help.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9090002_5: What a coincidence! Master Yan saved my life years ago. I`ll take you to him right away!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9091001_1: The journey was perilous. Thank you for delivering the message. Though young, you carry justice in your heart and courage beyond your years. You have the spirit of a Dune Wanderer.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9091001_2: When our master founded the Wanderers, his goal was to exorcise evil, uphold justice, and right all wrongs in the world.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9091001_4: Haha, exactly! I didn`t expect the old man`s name to still be known out here. He`d be boasting for days if he knew!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9091001_5: But the raider problem is urgent, so I can`t chat long. I need to plan. If you have more questions, feel free to talk to the other Wanderers.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9092001_1: Ever since Galehowl took over the Wolf Gang, they`ve grown bolder by the day! Let`s see how long I can tolerate this!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9092001_3: Galehowl is cunning and treacherous. He allied with the </color><color=0xff52c769>Usun Tribe</color><color=0xfffffcee>, using their </color><color=0xff52c769>power</color><color=0xfffffcee> to expand the Wolf Gang.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9092001_4: He even stumbled upon the ruins of the ancient Loulan Kingdom and found a secret martial arts manual. He`s been flaunting his power ever since.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9092001_5: That`s quite a stroke of luck. Thank you. I`ll go talk to the others!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9093001_1: You may not know this, but when the </color><color=0xfff05050>Protectorate</color><color=0xfffffcee> withdrew, only General Liu stayed behind. He founded the Deserted Garrison and protected this land.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9093001_2: Later, Galehowl and the </color><color=0xff52c769>Usun</color><color=0xfffffcee> ambushed the Garrison, crippling them. They never recovered and soon vanished.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9093001_3: That Galehowl is truly despicable! Thank you. I`ll continue asking around.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9094001_1: Soon after the Garrison fell, General Liu founded the Dune Wanderers. The Wanderers have no sect, no identity. They hide among the people, walk through the world, and draw their blades when they see injustice.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9094001_2: A brilliant shift from light to shadow!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9094001_3:
Your words and deeds remind me of us.
The way of the Wanderers doesn`t care about status. If you share the same sense of justice, you are already one of us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9094001_4: Young hero, if you ever become a Wanderer, you will surely be a guardian of justice for all.
en.STR_BLACK_9095001_1: At dawn, the Wanderers set out.
en.STR_BLACK_9095001_2: The morning light shines on faces unafraid of death...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9095002_1: This is a chokepoint on the way to Duststorm Town, perfect for an ambush!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9095002_2: We`ve set our trap. Now we wait for the enemy!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9095002_3: If we win today, you`ll have done a great service!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9097001_1: I didn`t expect to find a clear spring in the middle of the desert. What a rare sight!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9097001_2: There`s a White Haired Elder ahead. Let me ask him about General Liu.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9097002_1: Desert winds raise dust and smoke, the hidden spring mirrors a faithful heart...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_1:
So the Wolf Gang is stirring trouble again. They never give up.
Back then, the Deserted Garrison was shattered, and I was severely injured. I retired here to heal.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_3: That same year, Galehowl allied with </color><color=0xff00ff00>Kalma</color><color=0xfffffcee> of the Usun Tribe and learned his dark arts, blood-drinking rituals to maintain his savage vitality.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_5: Perhaps the heavens took pity on my broken body, and I came to understand the way of meridian unlocking, a path to health and strength.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_6: I combined it with the glaive techniques and created a system called Meridian Awakening. That was the birth of the Dune Wanderers.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_7: Master, could you take a look at this letter and blade?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_8: Both are from me! The one who gave them to you must have seen the chivalry in your heart. They sent you across the desert for a reason.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_9: They saw the justice within you and brought you here with great expectations.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_11: Perhaps this is the bond between you and me...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_12: Heaven values life. You carry justice in your heart, and you are destined to bear the weight of protecting the people. Are you willing to join my lineage and become a true Dune Wanderer?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_14: The way of the Wanderers knows no ranks. If you share the same sense of justice, you are already one of us.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9098001_15: I`ve heard those words before... Master, I am willing!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9099001_1: I never thought my journey in the desert would make me a Dune Wanderer... But the crisis isn`t over. I must do my part!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9099002_1: Though Wushuang gave it their all, Galehowl escaped. A crafty rabbit has many burrows. He must have other hiding places.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9099002_2: I heard Yan Wushuang mention the Loulan Ruins.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9099002_3:
The ruins of Loulan... I`ll send someone to investigate.
For now, your priority is to grow stronger.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9099002_4: Our enemies are more than just Galehowl and the Wolf Gang. Behind them lies the Usun Tribe.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9099002_5: Kalma, the Usun general, is a master of dark arts and commands a fierce army of slave soldiers. We cannot afford to be careless.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9099002_7: The Meridian Awakening system has three sets of skills, requiring three vessels and twenty-seven acupoints. Time is short, so I will teach each of you one set. You can refine them later.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9100001_1: I`ve confirmed that Galehowl has fled to the Loulan Ruins. He`s likely waiting for reinforcements from the Usun.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9100001_3: Your skills have improved greatly. Together, you can defeat him. Head to the Loulan Ruins immediately before reinforcements arrive!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9100001_4: I`ll stay at Spring Post to gather the remaining disciples. When you return, we will face the Usun together!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9101001_1: There`s a formation here. We`ll need to take down the bandits guarding its core before we can enter.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9101001_2: Let`s split up and meet ahead.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9101002_3: The </color><color=0xfff05050>[Glyphs]</color><color=0xfffffcee> in the formation complement our cultivation. Embed them at key acupoints, and your meridians will flow like starlight, reaching new heights!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9102001_1: Galehowl is vicious. Everyone be careful!
en.STR_BLACK_9102002_1: A firework bursts over Spring Post. The dying Galehowl lets out a mad laugh...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9102003_1: That`s a Usun signal! Could it be...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9102003_2: No! It`s a diversion! Hurry back to Spring Post!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9103001_1: The Usun were here! Find the Master!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9103002_1: I underestimated them. I didn`t think they were after me.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9103002_2: It`s our fault for revealing your location!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9103002_3: This isn`t your fault. I planned too late, and this is the result.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9103002_4: Ayiguli, I`ve heard the Yuezhi have a secret art that can briefly restore life. Is that true?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9103002_5: Yes, it can restore a person`s state, but only for the span of half an incense stick.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9103002_6: I`ve fully mastered Meridian Awakening. That`s enough time to face Kalma. Please, use your art to restore me!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9104002_1: Observe the way of heaven, follow its will! Meridians connect the four seas, acupoints pierce yin and yang!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9525001_1: The timing is just right... Kalma and Galehowl are gone. I can rest easy now...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9525001_2: Little Hua, you`ll be the head of the Wanderers from now on. Don`t just focus on business...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9525001_4: Ayiguli, the Yuezhi need you. Go back and help your people. The peace of the desert needs you...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9096001_1: Galehowl`s dark arts are vicious. Everyone, be extremely careful!
en.STR_BLACK_9118001_1: Under the setting sun, Ayiguli says her farewells and rides off into the distance...
en.STR_BLACK_9118001_2: Amid the swirling desert sands, her slender figure vanishes beyond the horizon...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9118002_1: What are your plans now? Will you come back to Duststorm Town with me?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9118002_2: I wish to return to where I came from, to Valhalla. The spirit of the Wanderers should not be forgotten. I want to bring their stories back so that future generations may know them.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9118002_3: If our master were here, he would surely applaud your resolve. You must know, once you leave, we shall never meet again.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9118002_4: Though we may never meet again, the way of justice will live forever in our hearts.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9118002_5: Heroes have always emerged in youth. Go and do what you must. Duststorm Inn will always be your stronghold.
en.STR_BLACK_9085001_1: In the dead of night, a knock comes at the door...
en.STR_BLACK_9085002_1: Hua Yingyue arrives with a grave expression. She seems to have something urgent.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9085003_1: Young hero, have you heard that the </color><color=0xff52c769>Usun tribe</color> <color=0xfffffcee>is about to hold a bizarre ritual, one that gathers killing intent. Rumor has it that the Usun General aims to use this to enhance his power.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9085003_3: The Wolf Gang has always done the Usun tribe`s bidding. I expect they`ll come to Duststorm Town to capture people!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9085003_4: But the townsfolk are no match for them, and the Protectorate has already withdrawn. Even if we send for reinforcements, it would be too late!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9085003_6: I have a friend who can handle these raiders. But he is at Howling Ridge, and to reach him, we must cross the perilous Wolf Vale. This journey is extremely dangerous. Young hero, are you willing to...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9085003_7: Madam Hua, you have already done me a great kindness. I will not hesitate to step forward!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9085003_8: You are a young hero of gratitude and justice, truly the spirit of a Wanderer. You remind me of my friend. Still, Wolf Vale is treacherous. Please take care of yourself, and may you return safely!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9119001_1: The Star Lantern`s oil is nearly spent. Suyi has ordered me to take you back to Valhalla at once.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9119001_3: Go. Take the spirit of Wanderers with you. That is what matters most.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9802001_1: Welcome back, Chosen One. I sense a different aura about you. Tell me... Are the Wanderer Spirits at peace?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9802001_2: Their chivalry has never faded. But some regrets can never be undone.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9802001_3: Valhalla`s mirror sometimes reflects fragments of other worlds. I have seen your journey... Now, those restless spirits may finally find peace.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_9802001_4: They do not need peace, they need remembrance. I will carry on their legacy here, so that all who come after may find their own true path of chivalry!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103456401_1: Skydust Pass stretches endlessly under a veil of sand, desolate and barren. Duststorm Town is the only place where travelers can rest...
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103456501_1: Freshly baked flatbread! Care to try some?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103456601_1: The Western Regions are vast. Why not buy a fine steed to make your journey easier!
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103456601_1_1: Let me have a look first!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103456201_1: The jianghu is vast, not to be traversed in a matter of days. It is deep, not to be understood in a few words. Where would you like to go?
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103456301_1:
Greetings, traveler. Will you be dining or staying the night?
You`ve come to Duststorm Inn. Rest easy, for across all of Skydust Pass, there`s no cozier place!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103456701_1: The princess has changed. I can`t tell if it`s for better or worse... ah!
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103456701_1_1: She`s grown. That`s a good thing!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103456901_1: My lifelong wish is to bring peace to the Western Regions. Do you think I can achieve it?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103456901_1_1: Of course, I believe in you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103457101_1: I have just unlocked the Conception Vessel. I wish I could unlock all three meridians!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103457201_1: Master always says that a Wanderer`s martial arts rely on `insight.` But I just can`t seem to grasp it... Am I really lacking in understanding?
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103457201_1_1: Don`t lose heart. One day, it will all become clear to you!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103457301_1: Haste makes waste. The path of cultivation should never be rushed!
en.STR_DLGSELECT_103457301_1_1: Don`t make excuses for being lazy!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103457401_1: The martial arts of a Wanderer cannot be mastered by diligence alone. Without insight, you will never grasp its true essence.
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103457501_1: This is the Western Protectorate. Do not linger!
en.STR_NPCDIALOGUE_103457001_1: There`s a fine wine in the Western Regions called `Grape Gold`. I secretly hid two jars. Let`s drink together another day!

ar.STR_SCRIPT_227_4: شخص أخر يريد كنزى. تعال واثبت أحقيتك به!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_276_9: إنهم فقط جزء من المشهيات التى أعددناها هذه المرة.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_276_10: عال إلى عالم المشهيات لتجرب المزيد!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_300_21: حان وقت استلام الجوائز من سناء!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_312_1: ياللهول... لقد أُصبت أنا أيضا بالقوة الشريرة!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_313_2: لم أظن أننى سأصاب بالقوة الشريرة!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_314_3: أشعر أن دمى ينساب بسرعة... أنا أموت...
ar.STR_SCRIPT_114_5: هاها! أشعر وكأن بإمكانى الطيران عندما تهب الرياح.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_114_7: كم أود أن يكون لدى قدمين فقط.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_115_4: لقد أكلت أكبر عدد من البسكويت!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_115_14: لا أعرف ما سبب غضب الملكة الحمراء كل يوم.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_116_5: لابد أننى جننت! كيف أجرؤ على إفساد هذا الحب الرائع؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_117_2: الأحلام كالدوامات. بعدما تنجرف ورائها من الصعب أن تستيقظ!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_117_3: هيا أيها الرجل الثور! هذا الشاب الأحمق صار ملكك.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_118_9: هل يمكننا رؤية الأميرة بعد ذلك؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_118_10: ربما الفقاعات التى حولنا هى الأميرة؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_118_12: لا أريد أن تصبح أميرتنا فقاعات.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_118_14: البحر الغامض، من فضلك حول الهواجس الوهمية إلى فقاعات!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_119_4: الفقاعة الوهمية، من فضلك استعد شكلك الاصلى!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_119_11: فتاة حمقاء، لقد أخبرت الأمير بكل شيء.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_119_13: كلا، لا تحتاج للإعتذار. فعلتها بإرادتى.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_120_10: ملكنا منزعج مؤخرا. لا أجرؤ على الحديث معه.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_120_12: إذا أمسكت به، سأضربه بشده على ركبتيه!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_120_14: هل سمعت بذلك؟ عن هذا الجالفر؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_120_16: ألم تستطع العثور على مجرد رجل واحد؟#09
ar.STR_SCRIPT_120_17: من فضلك أعطنى المزيد من الوقت! سأمسك به!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_121_6: أنت أيها الضئيل! يمكننى هزيمتك بإصبعى الصغير!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_121_8: جالفر, يجب أن أريك عاقبة عصيانى!

ar.STR_SCRIPT_113_4: كلا! هذا محبط للغاية! لا أريد هذا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_113_5: حسنا، ماذا عن هذا؟ حورية البحر الصغيرة والأمير عاشا بسعادة للأبد.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_113_6: هذا جيد! يجب أن يظلا معا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_113_8: أكره أن يستعرض الناس حبهم! وأنت غيرت قصتى! لن أغفر لك ذلك!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_113_10: أنت تتفاخر! لا يمكنك هزيمة الامير!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_113_11: لقد نجحت بإستفزازى! بما أنك تحب القصص، ماذا لو حولتك إلى كتاب قصة؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_113_15: حولت الساحرة الامير إلى كتاب قصة حب. من يمكنه إنقاذه؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_253_7: اتمنى أن يجد أحد الجنيات ويعيد أرض العفريت...
ar.STR_SCRIPT_256_3: الرومانسية، الشجاعة، المثابرة وقوة الحب هى كل ما تحتاجه!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_385_1: الهجوم على غفلة ليس عادة جيدة.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_387_1: سوف أمزق من وضعنى فى الصندوق لأشلاء!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_389_2: سوف أظهر قوتى الحقيقية هذه المرة!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_148_12: #24#24#24ولكنى أود تمضية يوم مرح الاطفال مع لينى.#13
ar.STR_SCRIPT_148_13: مازلت أتذكر أنك كنت تشد شعرى ونحن صغار.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_148_15: أتمنى لو يمكننا العودة لطفولتنا. أعدك أننى لن أشد شعرك حينها.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_148_18: قطار مرح الأطفال السريع سيصل للمحطة! الوجهة هى حديقة مرح الأطفال!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_148_20: حديقة مرح الأطفال مفتوحة للجميع! استمتع وفز بأطنان الجوائز!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_284_3: لا تقلق. سوف ألقى عليك تعويذة لتتمكن من التنفس تحت الماء.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_285_1: إذا هذا هو شاطئ الصيف الجميل!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_285_12: أراهن أنك لا تحمل ضغينة ضدى!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_285_14: هاهاها لا أحد سيأتى من أجلك!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_285_20: سوف تدفع ثمن ذلك! لن أرحمك!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_292_5: أورفى! يوريديس! أنا سعيد جدا لرؤيتكما معا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_293_7: أغنى عن ضى الصباح، أغنى عن الزهور وأغنى عن المطر...
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_5: أيها البطل الشاب، هناك شيء خاطئ في ساقى. هلا أرسلتنى للمنزل؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_6: ولكن... حان وقت معادى مع يوريديس...
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_8: زوجتى المسكينة مازلت فى انتظارى بالمنزل... ماذا علىّ أن أفعل؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_9: حسنا، أظن أننى يجب أن أعتذر ليوريديس. ستتفهم.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_10: شكرا على مساعدتك لى. لدىّ هدية من أجلك.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_12: ابنى العزيز، لكى أشكرك على طيبتك، قررت أن أعطيك عربة ذهبية.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_13: لقد كان هذا اختبار من والد أورفى!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_295_15: أنا متأكد أن بإمكانك التعامل مع ذلك!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_296_4: بفضل مساعدة القيثارة الذهبية، سوف أُخرج يوريديس من العالم التحتى!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_296_5: العالم التحتى ليس مكان يمكنك أن تدخل وتخرج منه كما تريد!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_296_6: دعنى أتعامل مع هذا الأمر من أجلك يا ملك الجحيم!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_296_7: دعنى أتعامل مع هذا الأمر من أجلك يا ملك الجحيم!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_297_7: كم أن هذا محزن... لقد فشلت!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_297_8: لا! لا! لا! الأمر ليس كذلك!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_297_11: تقبل الأمر أيها البطل الشاب. يجب أن تغادر الآن!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_298_6: انظر ماذا فعلت! هل تخليت عن يوريديس؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_298_8: إذا ابتهج! بالشرق الأقصى هناك جنية تدعى الفتاة النساجة والتى يمكنها مساعدتك!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_298_10: لكى تتوجه للشرق، يجب أن تهزم الوحوش بممر النجوم.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_298_11: لا أخاف أى شيء طالما ان بإمكانى إنقاذ يوريديس!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_291_3: هذا رائع للغاية. سيعيد زوجة أورفى من العالم التحتى بالتأكيد!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_291_4: اذهب! أيها البيجاسيوس الذهبى، تأكد من إعادة زوجتى لى!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_291_6: لقد عدت يا أورفى يا عزيزى! أنت نجحت!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_291_7: بفضل مساعدة هذا البطل الشجاع والفتاة النساجة!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_291_9: شكرا جزيلا. أود أن أفعل لك شيء فى المقابل!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_291_10: دع البيجاسوس الذهبى الخاص بى يكن جسر الغراب الخاص بك ويساعدك أنت وزوجك للعودة معا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_286_1: لقد أفسدت جسر الغراب الخاص بى! من أنت؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_286_2: لا أعلم لما أنا هنا، أنا أريد استعادة زوجتى فقط...
ar.STR_SCRIPT_286_3: ياله من رجل عاطفى... دعنى أتحقق من ذكرياته.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_286_4: سأحبك بإخلاص فى الأوقات الجيدة والأوقات الصعبة وسأكون هنا من أجلك دائما.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_286_5: سأثق بك وأحترمك وأضحك وأبكى معك للأبد.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_286_8: القيثارة الذهبية، هل فقدت لمعتها أيضا؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_286_9: أليست هناك طريقة لأبقى زوجتى هنا معى؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_508_1: أيها اللورد الخادم، هل تعتقد أن باسم محتال؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_508_2: نظام المجال حقيقي. أما بالنسبة لكون باسم محتال أم لا، أنا لا أعرف.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_508_3: في الواقع، أنا مستفيد من نظام المجال.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_509_1: من أنت؟ ماذا تريد؟ أين هو ديفس؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_509_2: أيها الإخوة، هذا الرجل العجوز هو باسم! مزقزه إربا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_511_3: بما أنك لا تتحدث، دعنا ندخل مباشرة في صلب الموضوع.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_511_5: ارجع وأخبر باسم أنني لا أحب تعذيب الضعفاء.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_512_1: أيها الزعيم، لقد جمعتنا هنا. ماذا يحدث في المدينة؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_512_3: دع هؤلاء القادمين الجدد الذين قمنا بتجنيدهم مؤخرا يحرسون البوابات.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_512_5: نعم، لقد حصلت مؤخرا على شيء لا ينبغي لي الحصول عليه. أحتاج إلى تمويه.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_513_1: لدينا دائما شيء لنحميه، حتى لو كلفنا الأمر حياتنا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_518_1: في الشتاء، كلانا نشأ في جزيرة الطيور. هل من الضروري القيام بذلك؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_518_2: خائن! أعرف كل شيء عن تعاونك مع المختار!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_521_1: هذا كل شيء في الوقت الراهن. السؤال الأخير قاطعه علوان.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_521_4: لا يبدو الأمر كذلك. دعونا نتوقف هنا الآن! تعال وابحث عني في المرة القادمة من أجل صعود المجال.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_523_1: قلب عالمى، من فضلك وجه قوتك إلى هذه المصفوفة السحرية.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_524_1: هذه المرة، ليس لديك مكان للهرب!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_525_2: أرجو أن تنقل طلبي إلى الكاهن المرموق.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_525_4: من فضلك افتح بوابة النتوء من أجلى!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_532_3: حسنا، سأقوم بنقلك مباشرة إلى هناك.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_533_1: بعد ذلك، ركز ونشط الصفحة المحظورة!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_535_1: تم بناء النموذج الأولى لمصفوفة الاستدعاء.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_535_2: جيد! سأضع المادة وابدأ الطقوس لاستدعاء الشيطان.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_535_4: لا... لا أعرف، ولكن لنواجه الأمر أولا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_539_1: لم أعثر على هاكا، ولكن البوابة بحالة جيدة. لنذهب!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_540_2: لم أتوقع أن يتواصل هاكا مع هذا العدد من نصف النتوءات. لنستمر.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_542_8: لا أعرف إلى متى ستدوم المباركة.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_545_1: أنا، جراهام، كنت مخطئ. لقد حررت نفسى أخيرا.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_546_1: هل هذه هى الفتاة التى ذكرتها؟ إنها فاتنة بالفعل!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_546_2: هذا منتج فاخر من غابة القيقب، أنت لا تفهم شيء!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_547_2: كيف تجرؤ على المجيء إلى مخبأنا!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_547_5: أنا عميل سري أرسله شخص مهم من قلعة العنقاء!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_550_2: أداة قبيلة اللغز المقدسة ليست ملكك!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_558_3: جراهام، ثق فى نفسك، أنت لست ميت.
ar.STR_SCRIPT_562_1: أنا أحذرك، لا تصعد على السطح مرة أخرى!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_562_8: عليك اللعنة! سطحى على وشك الانهيار!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_562_9: إذا كان لديك الشجاعة، دع حراس المدينة يقبضون علي!
ar.STR_SCRIPT_565_1: أين الدراج المتحول؟ هل هو نائم فى مكان ما؟
ar.STR_SCRIPT_566_2: هل هناك شياطين يختبئون في الداخل؟
